text.body: <1> gītābhāṣyam tātparyacandrikayā śrīḥtātparyacandrikā śrīmānveṅkaṭanāthāryaḥ kavitārkika kesari| vedāntācāryavaryome sannidhattāṃ sadāhmati|| yatiparibṛḍho yadgītānāmadarśayadañjasā nigamapariṣannedīyāṃsaṃ nirāmayamāśayam| jananapadavīyātāyātaśramāpaharāṃ dhiyaṃ janayatu sa me devaḥ śrīmān dhanañjayasārathiḥ|| anucitapadavībhiścintayitvā prayātānyalamalamatimātratrāsacintāviṣādaiḥ| upaniṣadamudārāmudvamanpāṇḍavārthaṃ śaraṇamupagatānnastrāyate śāṅrgadhanvā|| santaḥ sāralihaścittatamaḥ pramathinīmimām| bhajantu bhagavadgītā bhāṣyatātparyacandrikām|| śrīmadgītāṃ vyācikhyāsuḥ, avighnaparipūraṇapracayagamanārthaṃ paramācāryasya saṃgrahaślokanirmāṇamukhena tadarthopadeṣṭutāṃ tadanuvṛtteḥ svācāryasaṃprīṇanatāmapyanusandadhānaḥ paramācāryabhajanarūpaṃ maṅgalamācarati -- yatpadāmbhoruhetyādi| yacchabdena sarvottarācāryaguṇapauṣkalyahetukāṃ prasidiṃdha sūcayati|ambhoruhaśabdena bhogyatvapratīterbhaktirūpatvaṃ dhyānasya vyajyate| yāmunācāryasya,droṇācāryasya ekalavya ivāhamityabhiprāyeṇa dhyānaśabdaḥ| sakṛtsandarśanena prāyaśaḥ kalmaṣāṇi vidhvastāni, tanmūlanirantarasmaraṇena teṣāṃ savāsanonmūlanaṃ kṛtamityabhiprāyeṇa ' dhyānavidhvastāśeṣakalmaṣaḥ' ityuktam | vastutām ' asti brāhṛeti cedveda santamenaṃ tato viduḥ' ityādyuktaprakārām| ahaṃ vastutāmupayāta ityāścaryagarbham| evamaniṣṭanivartaneṣṭaprāpaṇarupopakārasmṛtipreritavāgādi tritayakaraṇakaḥpraṇāmaḥ śiṣyaśikṣaṇārthaṃ śrotṛṇāṃ phalasiddhyarthaṃ ca granthe niveśitaḥ| tena svācāryavattadācāryaparamparāyā api bhajanamatyādareṇa karaṇīyamityapi śikṣatam| tathā ca śrūyate,' sa cācāryavaṃśo jñeyo bhavati, ācāryāṃṇāmasāvasāvityā bhagavattaḥ' iti|| athābhimataparadaivatasyabhagavataḥsvarūparūpaguṇavibhavādibhāvanāvarṇanābhyāmarthādabhaṅguraṃmaṅgalamācaran, 'svadharmajñānavairāgyasādhyabhaktyekagocaraḥ| nārāyaṇaḥ paraṃ brāhṛgītāśāstre samīritaḥ' iti saṃgrahānurodhena vyākhyeyaśāstrapradhānapratipādyaṃ ca saprakāraṃ darśayan, śāruāprāmāṇyasthāpanāya vaktuḥ svataḥsarvajñatvaparamakāruṇikatvasādhuparitrāṇonmukhāvasthatvasarvaśaktitvādinā bhramavipralambhapramādāśaktayādyabhāvapradarśanenāptatamatvaṃ samarthayan, apavargapradhānacaturvargopāya bodhātmakamavāntaraprayojanam apavargadaśānubhāvyasaprakārabhagavatsvarupaṃ ca paramaprayojanaṃ prakāśayan, śaṃkarādipatkṣe śāstropadeśārambhādyanupapattervakṣyamāṇaāyāḥ svapakṣe prasaṅgābhāvāya śastropadeśaśādyanukūlajīvaparamātmapāranārthikathanena śāstrāranbhaṃ samañjasayan, kāraṇaśodhakopāsanabhedābhedaghaṭakavacasāṃ sarveṣāmapi mikhyatāṃ khyāpayan, guṇatanujanivibhavaviharaṇādividhiniṣedhopaniṣadāmalpakśrutakumativihitapratāraṇakṛtakalahakūlaṅkaṣāṃ viṣayavyavasthāmapi sthāpayan, avāptasamastakāmasyāpi līlāmātravihitanikhilavyāparatvena śārīrakadvitīyādhyasiddhaṃ virodhaparihāramupalakṣayan,jitjñāsyajagatkāraṇaparabrāhṛbhūtadevatāviśeṣamapi sarvaśākhāpratyayasāmānyaviśeṣādinyāyaiḥ trimūtryaikyasāmyottīrṇavyaktyantaratvavyudāsena nirūpitākāraṃ nirdiśan 'bahu syām' itisaṃkalpamārambhyasārathyacaryāparyantasya sarvasya jagadvyāpārasyāśritārthatayā vyājamātralābhādapi paramapuruṣārthabhūtasvātmopalambhakādhyātmaśāstrāvataraṇādinā ca saulabhyātiśayamuddhoṣayan, prāpyatvopāsyatvaikāntaparatvasaulabhyasthāpanaupayikaguṇa varga dvaye jagatpatitvasarvatjñatvasarvaśaktitvasarveśvaratvādikaṃ paramarāruṇikatvaśubhāśrayatvāśritārthāvatāratvavirodhi nirasanaśīlatvāsecanakadarśanatvādikaṃ codāharan, pañjamavedaparamapratipādyasya bhagavato nārāyaṇasya prāktanodantaṃ gītopaniṣadupadeśena saṃgamayati -- śriyaḥ pati rityādinā avatārayāmāse tyantena| tatre tyādinā cakāre tyantena dvitīyena vākyena bubhutsordhṛtarāṣṭrasya jñātāṃśaniṣkarṣaḥ| evaṃ jñātvāpī tyādinā tu tṛtīyena vākyena śāruāopoddhātārambhabhūtapraśnasaṃgatiḥ| atra divyātmasvarūpavyatiriktaṃ samastamapi nāraśabdārthatayā vivicya darśayiṣyan,tadayanaṃ svarūpamanyapadārthatayā uttarapadārthatayā vā samāsadvaye'pi pradhānabhūtaṃ prathamaṃ niṣkṛṣya darśayati -- śriyaḥ patirityādinā|| viśeṣajñaptaye bharturabhigamyatvasiddheye| samastamaṅgalāptyai ca prathama śrīrihodinā| 'eṣa nārāyaṇaḥ śrīmānkṣīrārṇavaniketanaḥ| nāgaparyaṅkamusṛjya hragato madhuraṃ purim ' 'artho viṣṇuriyaṃ vāṇī' ityādikamiha bhāvyam| katipayaheyanivartakatīrthasevādivyudāsāya nukhileti viśeṣaṇam| atra heyaśūnyatvamarthasidadham| na hi paragatanikhilaheyanirākaraṇasamarthaḥ svagataṃ heyaṃ kṣamate| yadvā heyavirodhisvabhāvatayā heyaśūnyamityarthaḥ; tadā nikhila śabdaḥsarvācidgataṃ vikārādikaṃ sarvacidgataṃ kleśādikaṃ ca saṃgṛhṇāti| kumatiparikalpitamaṃśabhedenākalyāsparśamapākartuṃ kalyāṇaikatāna śabdaḥ| ata eva 'jñānānandaikasvarūpaḥ' ityanenāpaunaruktayam| athavā sāmānyaviśeṣanirdeśarūpatvād punaruktiḥ| yadvā kalyāṇaikatānaḥ kalyāṇaguṇānāmevāśrayabhūta iti vakṣyamāṇaguṇaprapañjasya saṃgrahaḥ|| trividhānāṃ cetanācetanānāṃ parādhīnatvādisāmyādevaṃbhūtaṃ vastvantaraṃ nāstītyabhiprāyeṇāha -- svetareti | etena jñānabhogasāmye'pi sarvaprakārasamatvaniṣedhaḥ| 'nityaṃ vibhuṃ sarvagatam' 'viśvamevedaṃ puruṣaṃ ityādiprasiddhaṃ trividhaparicchedarāhityaṃ prādhānyataḥ pṛthagāha -- ananteti| anantaṃ trividhaparicchedarahitam| 'atraiva deśe'sti, atra tu nāsti' iti deśaparicchedaḥ; 'atra kāle'sti, atra tu nāsti' iti kālaparicachedaḥ;'idam idaṃ na bhavati' iti vastuparicchedaḥ, alpavarṇasvarṇavat svarupāpakṛṣṭatvādikaṃ vā| evaṃvidhaparicchedatrayarāhityaṃ nāma sarvadeśasarvakālavyāpitvasarvāntaryāmitvarūpam| vastuparicchedarāhityaṃ hi samastavastusāmānādhikaraṇyayogyatvādikam; na punarmithoviruddhavividhavastutādātmyaṃ svavyatiriktasamastavastumithyātvaṃ vā, ubhayoratyantāsaṃbhāvitatvāt| vistarastu śatadūṣaṇyāṃ kṛto'smābhiḥ| ānandasya jñānaviśeṣatvāt jñānānandaśabdayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyamupapannam| tarhi ānandaśabdasya viśeṣaśabdatvāt 'ghaṭadravyaṃ' ityādivat 'ānandajñānam' iti vaktavyamit cet,tanna; bahulagrahaṇena sarvopapatteḥ| yadvā ānandaśabdasya anukūlavedanīyeṣu jaḍeṣvapi prayogattadviśeṣaṇatayā jñānaśabdasya pūrvatvopapattiḥ| svarūpaṃ pratīdaṃ viśeṣaṇadvayaṃ vā|| svābhāviketi| svarūpāpekṣayā guṇavigrahādināmapṛthaksiddhisāmye'pi vigrakhādidhāraṇaniyamanādau jñānādiguṇagaṇāpekṣatvapradarśanāya uttarottarasugrahatvasddhaye ca prathamaṃ guṇoktiḥ| samastaguṇabṛndapradhānatayā ṣāḍguṇyasya svarūpeṇopādānam; itareṣāṃ ca sauśīlyādīnāṃ prabhṛti śabdena saṃgrahaṇaṃ kṛtam| tavānantagumasyāpi ṣaḍeva prathame guṇāḥ| yaistvayeva jagatkukṣāvanye'pyantarniveśitāḥ' iti hrāhuḥ| saṃhmatisṛṣṭisthitihetubhūtasaṃkarṣaṇādivyūhatraye jñānabalādi dvandvatrikasya yathākramaṃ tattatkāryaviśeṣonmukhatvenāvirbhāvaviśeṣāt jñānabaletyādikramaviśeṣaḥ kṛtaḥ| svataḥ sarvaṃ sarvathā sarvadā sākṣātkaroti, tathā sākṣātkṛtaṃ ca sarvaṃ dhārayati, dhārayanneva niyacchati,dhārayanniyacchaṃ ścāśithilo bhavati, aghaṭitaṃ ca ghaṭayati, tatra ca sahakārinirapekṣo na kenacidabhibhūyate kiṃtu sarvābhibhūrbhavati,iti ca gaṇakramapāṭha vivakṣā| svābhāvikatvamananyādhīnatvam| muttanityayorapi hi tādṛśaṃ jñānādikaṃ tadanuguparamātmasaṃkalpādhīnam| anavadhikatvamatrotkṛṣṭāvadhirāhityam| dvābhyāṃ viśeṣaṇābhyāṃ 'parasya śaktirvividhaiva śrūyate, svābhāvikī jñānabalakiriyā ca' ityāmnāte paratvasvābhāvikatve pratiguṇamanvite pradarśite| asaṅkhyeyaśabdena mahodadhiśabdena ca 'yathā ratnāni jalādherasaṅkhyeyāni putraka | tathāca guṇā hranantasya asaṅkhyeyā mahātmanaḥ' ityādi smāritam| kalyāṇaśabdena guṇaniṣedhavacanānāṃ heyaguṇaviṣayatvamutsargā pavādanyāyasiddhaṃ sūcitam|| atha kāraṇopasanādiprakaraṇeṣvaruābhūṣaṇādhyāyādiṣu ca pratipannaṃ vilakṣaṇavigrahayogaṃ darśayati -- svābhimateti| abhimate'pyananurupatvasya anarūpe'pyanabhimatatvasya loke dṛṣṭātvāttadubhayavyavacchedāya svābhimatānurūpetyuktam| ekarūpetyanena vyūhavibhavādyavasthāsvapi heyapratyanīkatvānandāvahatvamumukṣūpāsyatvaprāpyatvādisvabhāvaparityāgo'bhihitaḥ| yadvā vyūhādipariṇāme satyapi paramavyoma nilayasya vigrahasya prācīnasaṃsthānāvasthitiruktā| 'sāvayavatvādanityam' ityādīnāṃ dharmigrāhakabādhādibhirābhāsatāmabhipretya acintyatvoktiḥ| eko divyaśabdaḥ saṃsthānavailakṣaṇyaparaḥ, paramavyomavartitvamātraparo vā; itarastvaprākṛtatvaparaḥ| vicitrāvatārayogaḥ, pratikṣaṇamapūrvavadanubhāvyamatvam vaṭapatraśayanaviśvarūpādyavasthāgatamāścaryaṃ ca, adbhutaśabdena vivakṣitam| nityatvaṃ kālāparicchinnatvam| tathā cāmānanti rahasyāmnāyavidaḥ, 'nityāliṅgā svabhāvasaṃsiddhirindriyākārāṅgapratyaṅgavyañjanavatī' iti| śrīpauṣkare ca, 'nityasiddhe tadākāre tatparatve ca pauṣkara|yasyāsti sattā hmadaye tasyāsau saṃnidhiṃ vrajet' iti| niravadyatvaṃ jarādirāhityam| uttarottaraniravadyaśabdeṣu pūrvaparvebhyaḥ sugrahatvaṃ vā vivakṣitam| śubhāśrayatvabhogyatvādyupayuktamaṅgalaguṇayogoniratiśayaujjvalyetyādinoktaḥ|niratiśayatvaṃ svāpekṣayā utkṛṣṭarāhityam, anuttamatvavat| tacca prati guṇamanvetavyam| aujjvalyaṃ bhāsvaratvam| sauvdaryaṃ avayavaśobhā| 'sarvagandhaḥ' iti śrutiranukūla gandhaviṣayā; ruākcandanādi cātra kṛtakaramityabhiprāyena saugandhyaśabdaḥ| saukumāryaṃ mahābalatve'pi 'puṣpahāsaḥ' iti nāma duhānaṃ mārdavam; yathoktam,'sukumārau mahābalau' iti| lāvaṇyaṃ samudāyaśobhā| yattaducyate bhagavacchāruo, 'viśvamāpyāyayankāntyā pūrṇendvayutatulyayā' iti| 'bhūyiṣṭaṃ teja evādbhirbahulābhirmṛdūkṛtam| cakṣurānandajananaṃ lāvaṇayamiti kathyate' iti hrāhuḥ | yauvanaṃ kaumārānantaryopalakṣaṇīyaḥ svabhāvaviśeṣaḥ, na tu kaumārānantarabhāvinyeva daśā; tadyauvanasyānāditvāt, devādiṣu ca keṣāṃcit yuvatvenaivotpattidarśanāt| ādiśabdena śubhāśrayaprakaraṇeṣūktāḥ sarve vigrahagapaṇāḥ saṃgṛhitāḥ|| evaṃ svarūpatadguṇau vigrahatadguṇau ca pratipādya,vigrahāśritamābharaṇavargamāyudhavargaṃ ca darśayati -- svocitetyādipadadvayena| pūrvoktavilakṣaṇavigrahaviśiṣṭaṃ svarūpamiha svaśabdārthaḥ| atra 'āyatāśca suvṛttāśca bāhavaḥ parighopamāḥ| sarvabhūṣaṇa bhūṣārhāḥ ' ityādi bhāvyam| kiriṭahārādirūpeṇa vaividhyam| ekajātīyoṣvapi maṇikāñcananādidravyaviśeṣavarṇasaṃsthānādiviśeṣaviśiṣṭavyaktibhedādvaicitryam| aparimitetyasaṃkhyeyatvokteḥ anantatvamāścaryaviśeṣaṇam| anavadhikāścaryarasāvahatvamanantāścaryatvam; athavā anantāni āścaryāṇi saṃsthānaviśeṣasaugandhayasukhasparśatvādīni yeṣāṃ bhūṣaṇānāṃ tāni tathoktāni| nityaniravadyaśabdau pūrvavat| aparimitatvamasaṃkhyeyatvameva,na tu hyasvagadīrkhādiparimāṇavirahaḥ| yadvā anantetyasaṃkhyeyatvam, aparimiteti ca vigrahānurūpamahatvaṃ, vivakṣitam| bhūṣaṇāyudhayordivyatvamaprākṛtatvam| pūrvoktaguṇavigrahābharaṇaviśiṣṭaḥ 'svānurūpa' ityatra svaśabdārthaḥ| asaṃkhyeyeti| pañcāyudhatvaprasiddhiḥ prādhānyāditi bhāvaḥ| acintyaśaktīti| kuṭhāraṭaṅkakuddālādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ kṛcchrasādhyaṃ sālaśailavasudhātalavidāraṇam ekena hi maheṣuṇā kṛtamiti bhāvaḥ| niratiśayakalyāṇatvaṃ niratiśayānandāvahatvam, bhūṣaṇakoṭāvapyanupraveśāt; yadvā loke yānyāyudhalakṣaṇāni maṅgalāvahatāya prasiddhāni, taiḥ sarvaiḥ saṃpūrṇatvam|| pūrvaṃ svarūpanirūpakatayā sāmānyato'bhihitāṃ śriyaṃ vibhūtimadhye'pi sthitāṃ viśeṣato darśayannārthāttatsvarūpādikamapyāha -- svābhimateti | svarūpaṃ svāsādhāraṇadharmaviśiṣṭaṃ śriyo divyātmasvarūpam| rūpaṃ divyavigrahaḥ| rūpānantaro guṇaśabdastadgataniratiśayaujjvalyasaundaryādiparaḥ| vibhavaśabdaḥ parijanaparibarhādiparaḥ| paratvasaulabhyaupayikaguṇavargadvayam aiśrvaryaśīlapadābhyāmupalakṣitam| tataścādiśabdaḥ pratyekamanvayāt jñānaśaktyādikaṃ vātsalyādikaṃ ca saṃgṛhṇāti| aiśvaryaśīlādergaṇatvānaucityāt, anavadhikātiśayatvasyāpi gaṇaviśeṣaṇatve pratayekaṃ guṇānāmutkarṣasyāśābdatvāt, guṇaviśeṣaṇatayaiva samāsa ucitaḥ | svarūpam,rūpam,tadguṇaḥ,vibhavaḥ,aiśvaryādiguṇagaṇaśca,iti dvandvaḥ| svarūpādipajcakaṃ bhagavadabhimatānurūpaṃ nityaṃ niravadyaṃ yasyāḥ, sā svābhimatetyādiguṇagaṇetyantanoktā| svarūpam,rūpam,tadguṇaḥ,vibhavaḥ,aiśvaryam,śīlam, ityādiguṇagaṇa iti yojanāyāṃ svarūparūpayorapi guṇānupraveśaprasaṅgaḥ| svarūpādeḥsarvasya paramātmābhimatatvaṃ vyaktam| svarūpasya nityatvaṃ nirvikāratayā sarvakālavartamānatvam| nitavadyatvaṃ pūrvaṃ paramātmasvarūpe pratipāditaprakāram, tadvat pitṛtvaprayuktakadācitkoṣmalatvādirāhityaṃ vā| anurūpatvaṃ tu yathāpramāṇaṃ prāgvadeva kalyāṇaikatānatvādkam| ' śāntānanta'ityādikamiha bhāvyam| rūpasya nityatvamavatārādidaśāyāmapi paramapadanilayabhagavadekāsanasthitasya tathāvasthitatvam| anurūpatvaṃ ca,'asyā devyā yathā rūpamaṅgapratyaṅgasauṣṭhavam| rāmasya ca yathā rūpaṃ tasyeyamasitekṣaṇā' 'viṣṇordehānurūpāṃ vai karotyeṣātmanastanum' ityādipratipāditam| vigrahaguṇānāṃ nityatvaṃ nāma aujjvalyādeḥ kadācidapyapakarṣādyabhāvaḥ| niravadyatvaṃ ca duṣprekṣatdirāhityam| anurūpatvaṃ, 'ghanakanakadyutī yuvadaśāmapi mugdhadaśām' ityādyuktaprakāram| vibhavasyānurūpatvaṃ, 'devatiryaṅmanusyeṣu punnāmā bhagavān hariḥ| strināmnīlakṣmīrmaitreya nānayorvidyate param' ityājibhiranusaṃdheyam| anavadhikātiśayatvavacanādīśvarakhyatiriktāśeṣagocarasiyāpi tadaiśvaryasya īśvarābhimatatvānna dvairājyādidoṣaḥ| 'asyeśānā jagato viṣṇupatnī'iti viṣṇupatnītvaveṣeṇa hi sarvasya jagata iyamīṣṭe| 'īśvarī sarvabhūtānām' ityatra tu,yadyapi sarvabhūtānāmiti pratisambandhinirdeśāt strīpratyayānusāreṇa īśvarapatnīti vivakṣā na śakyā| tathāpi vākyāntarabalādarthasya tathātvasiddhiḥ| niravadyatvaṃ bhagavadaiśvaryaikarasatvaṃ vā nigrahādiprasaṅgābhāvo vā| pratikūla daṇḍatvaṃ hi puṃsvānurūpaṃ tadvallabhasyaiva bhāgaḥ| śūlasya nityatvaṃ mahattve satyapi mandaiḥ saha nūranrdhasśleṣe kadācidapi svotkarṣaprakāśanābhāvaḥ; niravadyatvaṃ tatra vipralambhābhiprāyādivirahaḥ| anurūpatvam, anavadhikātiśayatvaṃ ca, 'tulyaśīlavevṛttām' ityādyuktaprakāram| evaṃ śriyaḥ pṛthaṅnityasvarūpaguṇavibhavaiśvaryaśīlādipratipādanena jñānādiguṇavadapṛthaksiddhaśaktimātratvam, vyūhaviśeṣatvam, svarūpaikyam, anyadapi, vadante nirastaḥ| śaktitvavādastu patnītvena kāryopayuktaviśeṣaṇatvābhiprāyāḥ| prayujyate hi śāstreṣu sarvatra stripuṃsātmakeṣu dvandvāntareṣvapi stryaṃśe śaktiśabdaḥ|ekatvavādāstu samastaprañcapratiyogikaikaśeṣitvāśrayatvena,viśiṣaṭaikyena, nityaparijanaviśiṣṭatāṃ darśayati -- svasaṅkalpeti| svarūpaṃ dhamryaṃśaḥ| sthitiḥ apracyutatayāvasthānam| pravṛttiḥ vyāpāraḥ|nityānāṃ svarūpasthityoḥ paramātmasaṃkalpānuvidhāyitvaṃ nāma baddhamuktaprakṛtiprākṛtakālādiṣvapi bhāvyam| tacca sarvaṃ prapañcayiṣyate| śeṣatā śeṣavṛttirityarthaḥ| aśeṣaśeṣatā yathābhimatākāratā| atra 'śarā nānāvidhāścāpi dhanurāyatavigraham| anvagacchanna aśeṣaśabdena saṃgṛhrante;teṣāmaśeṣāṇāṃ paramātmānaṃ prati śeṣatā śeṣabhāvaḥ| evamuktaprakārāyāṃ śeṣatāyāmitaraparityāgena tadekāvalambinī prītireva rūpaṃ svarūpaṃ svabhāvo vā yeṣāṃ te aśeṣaśeṣataikaratirūpāḥ| te ca sarve nityāḥ| svarūpanityatvasya sarvātmasādhāraṇatvāt muktavatkadācidāvirbhūta svarūpatvamiha nityaśabdena vyudasyate,nityāsaṃkucitajñānādiguṇā ityarthaḥ| tata eva niravadyāḥ kleśakarmasvātantrayābhimānādidoṣātyantābhāvavantaḥ|eṣāṃ jñānasya niratiśayatvaṃ paramātmajñānatulyatvam| kriyayā niratiśayatvaṃ svacchandānantakaiṅkaryātmakatvam| aiśvaryasya niratiśayajñānakriyaiśvaryādirananto guṇagaṇo yaṣāmiti vigrahaḥ| te ca aparimitāḥ asaṅkhyeyāḥ sūrayaḥ| 'sadā paśyanti sūrayaḥ, tadviprāso vipanyavojagṛvām̐saḥ samindhate' ityādyanusandhānenāha -- anavaratābhiṣṭatacaraṇayugala iti | vipanyavaḥ viśeṣeṇa stutiśīlāḥ| 'paṇa vyavahāre stutau ca|pana ca|' abhiṣṭutetyabhirviśabdārthaḥ| stutiśīlatvādanavaratatvoktiḥ|| stutiviṣayatva śārīrakabhāṣye samarthitau | ato'tra "kiṃ tadbrāhṛ' ityukte ahameva brāh metyāvyā khyānāt svetaraviṣayabrāhṛśabdaḥ paramaśabdaviśeṣitākṣaraśabdānuguṇyācca prakṛterīśvarāccānyasmin pariśu ddhātmanyu pacārādvartate | paścāccāyameva "avyakto'kṣara ityuktaḥ' iti vakṣyate| na cāsau ślokaḥ paramātmapara iti śaṅakanīyam, "ye cāpyakṣaramavyaktam ', "ye tvakṣaramanirdeśyam' ityādiṣvivātrāpi akṣaraśabdasya bhagavadvyatikariktaviṣayatva pratīteḥ| saṃsiddhiśabdaśca paramagatiśabdanirdiṣṭa prāpyavilaśakṣaṇāṃ samīcīnāṃ sidiṃdha svarasata upasargaśaktyā vyanakti | ata eva svabhāvādiśabdā adhikāri trayajñātavyopādeyavastuviśeṣaparā uktāḥ | evaṃ svavākyaparyālocanayā pūrvādhyāyaprakṛtaparāmarśena ca praśna prativacana vākyānāmadhikāritrayaviṣayatve siddhe tadanantarāṇāmapi granthānāṃ yathāsaṃbhavaṃ sarvaviṣayatvaṃ yuktam | prakrānte cādhikaritraye yadvṛttatrayeṇānūdyamāne kaivalyabhāgavatprāptikāmayoranantaraṃ spaṣṭamabhidhānāt abhyāsa ityādikaṃ pariśeṣādaiśvaryārthiviṣayam | yaccaiśvaryārthināṃ paramapuruṣaviṣayāntimapratyayasāpekṣatāyāṃ pramāṇaṃ nāstīti -- tadapi na, śrīmadbhāgavate purāṇe dhruvacarite taddaṣṭeḥ, bhakiṃta harau bhagavati pravāhan ityādinā | ato yathokta evārthaḥ | yadyapi brāhṛpuruṣaparagatyādiśabdairiha sarvatra paramātmabhajanatatprāptayādireva pratīyate; tathā'pijhrtāvatāṭa evādhikāriviṣayatvaṃ vaktuṃ na yujyate,pūrvatra prayāṇakāle bhrūmadhye prāṇāveśasya tatraiva paramātmadhyānasya ca vihitatvāt; anantaraṃ ca hmadi dhyānasya mūÐdhna prāṇāveśasya ca tatkāla eva vidhānāt | tadidaṃ dvayaṃ parasparaviruddhaṃ kiṃ kālabhedāt vyavasthāpyeta, adhikāribhedādvā? tatra na tāvat kālabhedaḥ śrutaḥ; pratyuta kālaikyameva śrūyate | ataḥ pariśeṣāt siddho'dhikāribhedaḥ | kiṃca "śataṃ caikā ca' ityā dibhirmūrdhanyanāḍā niṣkramaṇaṃ mokṣahetuḥ, anyābhirniṣkramaṇaṃ phalāntaraheturityavagate, prayāṇakāle bhrūmadhye mūÐdhna ca prāṇāveśasyotkramaṇaśeṣatayā tattaddeśagatānāḍakramaṇe pratīte siddhayedadhikāribhedaḥ | pūrvatra cādhyāye, "caturvidhā bhajante mām' iti ślokayoryacchabdābṛtyādhikāribhedapratītirbhāṣye pratipāditā; sā cātrāpi sphuṭā; aṇoraṇīyāṃsamanusmaret yaḥ' "yaḥ prayāti tyajan dehaṃ' , " yo māṃ smarati nityaśaḥ' i ti | etadakhilamabhipretyoktam evamaiśvaryārthina ityādi | uktaścādhikārī ananyacetāḥ ityucyata iti paroktaṃ nirākurvan ananyacetāḥ iti ślokasyārthamāha atheti | nityaśaḥ ityanenātmānubhāvādiphalāntaravyavadhānanairapekṣyaṃ vivakṣitamityāha udyogaprabhṛtīti | anyathā satatamityanena punirukti saṃkocakleśo vā syādityabhiprāyeṇāha satataṃ sarvakālamiti | ananyaceta śśabdenābhipretaṃ smṛterbhaktirūpāpannatvaṃ darśayati atyartheti | ananyacetastvādeva smaraṇasyācchidravatvam | ut kaṇṭhane'pi ca smāritaḥ prayujyate -- bhrātarau smaratāṃ vīrau ityādiṣu | nityayuktasya yo ginaḥ ityuktānuvājadaḥ phalasyāvyavahitatvadyotanāya | atra ahaṃśabdeneśvarasya pratyagartho'bhipretaḥ | tena tadvi śeṣaṇabhūta ākṣarīdiphalaprāptivyavacchedo vivaśakṣita ityabhiprāyeṇāha ahameveti | tadeva vivṛṇoti na madbhāva iti | bhagavatprāpteḥ phalāntarebhyo'tiśayitaphalatvāt tatprāptau prayāsātirekasaṃbhāvanāvyavacchedāya sulabhapadamityabhi prāye ṇāha suprāpaśceti | akṛcchre prāpya ityarthaḥ | "īṣaddussuṣu kṛcchrākṛcchrārtheṣu khal' ityanuśi ṣyate | āśritavatsalasyeśvarasya saulabhyaṃ rāgaprāptamityāha tadviyogamiti | uktasyātivādamātratvaśaṅkāvyudāsāya śrutimūlatāmāha yameveti | atra varaṇaśabdena kimucyate? na tāvat śeṣatvaśarīratvādyākāreṇa svīkāraḥ; tasya nityasiddhatvāt | na ca tadviparītaḥ; viruddhatatvādeva | na ca prāptipradānam; tena labhya ityanena paunaruktyaprasaṃgāt | na cānyo'tra prakāraḥ; asaṃbhāvādityatrāha ma tprāptaya nuguṇeti | vipāko'tra dhruvānusmṛtirupatvadarśanasamānākāratvādirūpaḥ | tadvirodhino duṣkṛtarajastamorāgadveṣamohādayaḥ | atyarthamatpriyatvaṃ niratiśayabhaktitvam | ādiśabdena, paramapadaparyaṅkāsattiparyantaṃ yanmadhyo'pekṣitam, tat sarvaṃ vivakṣitam | ahameveti | paramakāruṇikasya mamaivāyaṃ bhara ityabhiprāyaḥ | 'tasyāhaṃ sulabhaḥ' ityāderuktārthaparatvasthirīkaraṇāyāsyaivārthasya vakṣyamāṇaṃ vistaramudāhmadaśrut yupabṛṃhaṇarūpaṃ darśayati vakṣyate ceti || 14 || itaḥ pūrvaṃ trayāṇāmadhikāriṇāṃ kecana vedyopādeyabhedāḥ pratipāditāḥ; ataḥ paramadhikāraupayikatayā'vaśyavedyasya phalasya sthirāsthiratvalakṣaṇaviśeṣaṃ darśayatītyāha ataḥ paramiti | atra jñāninastāvat apunarāvṛttirucyate māmupetyeti ślokena | duḥkhānantyasya sarvapramāṇasiddhatvādduḥkhaśabdasya nirviśeṣaṇasya saṅkocāyogāt nikhiletyuktam | janmanaścāśāśvataśabdanirdiṣṭamasthiratvaṃ janmāvinābhūtadehamogādyasthiratvarūpamiha vivakṣitam | janmaśabdo vā'tra janimaccharīraparaḥ | mahātmanaḥ iti stutimātrādapi māhātmyasyātra saṃsiddhihetutvamucita mit yabhiprāyeṇāha yata iti | mahāmanastvaṃ jñānināṃ prākprapañcitamihānūditaṃ darśayati yathāvasthitetyādinā | ābhilaṣitasya phalasya siddhivyapadeśaucityāt paraṃmaśabdasvārasyācca paramasaṃsiddhirupaṃ māmityuktam | paramasaṃsiddhirūpaṃ paramapuruṣārtharūpamityarthaḥ | samīcīnasiddhiḥ saṃsiddhiḥ || 15 || aprasaktasya pratiṣedhāyogāt pratiṣedhyasya prasaṅginaśca āsannavartina upādātumucitatvāt naśvaraphalabhūtaiśvaryārthināṃ janmamātraṃ tanniṣedhamukhena sūcitam; atastatrāpi hetureva kevalaṃ vaktavya ityabhiprāyeṇāha aiś varyagatamiti | māmupetya tu iti bhagavataḥ pratiyogīkaraṇāt āṅo'trābhividhiparatvābhiprāyeṇāha brāhṛloketi | prakṛ tyākhyūbhagavanmāyāmahodadhau brāhṛāṇḍairapi yadā budbudāyitam , tadā kaiva kathā tadantavartināṃ lokānāmityabhip rāyeṇa brāhṛāṇḍadoravartina ityuktam | tena paramākāśavyavacchedasiddhiśca | aiśvaryānityatāpratipādanaparatvāyoktam bhogaiśvaryālayā iti | bhuvanaśabdasamabhivyāhmatasya lokaśabdasya jana viṣayatvāyogāt lokasya gamanābhāvena punarāvṛtterapyabhāvāt punarāvartiśabdena pravāhato vināśamātraṃ lakṣyata ityāha vināśina iti | punarāvartiśabdasyājahallakṣaṇāvṛttestallokagatapuruṣapunarāvṛttireva vā dvāram | phalitamāha ata iti | māmityatra tuśabdena dyotitān apunāvṛttihetuviśeṣān darśayati māṃ sarvajñamityādinā | asarvajñamasatyasaṅkalpaṃ kāryakoṭidhaṭitaṃ nirghṛṇaṃ rajastamomūlarāgadveṣādinānāvikāraśālinaṃ kañcana kṣudradaivataṃ prāptānāṃ hi tadanyena tenaiva vā punarāvṛttiḥ syāditi viśeṣaṇānāṃ tātparyam || 16 || saharuotyādiślokatrayasya piṇḍitārthamāha brāhṛlokaparyantānāmiti | hiraṇyagarbhādisvātantrya siddhasatyalokādisthairyaśaṅkāvyudāsāyāha paramapuruṣasaṅkalpakṛtāmiti | īśvarasvātantryameva hranyūnāniti riktadinīrātryādivicitravyavasthāyāṃ kāraṇam | tathā cocyate, kālasya hi ca mṛtyośca mānave, tadye yugasaharuāṃ tu brāāhṛṃ puṇyamaharviduḥ | rātiṃra ca tāvatīmeva te'horātravido janāḥ || iti, tatra ya ityeva pāṭhāt yathākramamanvayaḥ | iha tu saharuoti śloke yat ityasyāhaśśabde naiva hranvayo ghaṭate | tataśca te ityasya ye iti padamapekṣitam; tatrāpi ye viduste'horātravido janāḥ, ta evaṃ vidurityanvayaḥ evaṃ kālavyavasthāyāṃ prāmāṇikatvapratipādanāparo'tra svīkārya ityabhiprāyeṇāha ye manuṣyādīti | anūdyamānamahorātraveditvaṃ yathāprasiddhi sarvaviṣayameva bhavitumarhati; tena caturmukhasyāpi manuṣyādi tulyatā dyotitā syādityabhiprāyeṇa manuṣyādītyādikamuktam | brāhṛśabdasyātra paramātmaviṣayatvabhramav yudāsāya caturmukhaśabdaḥ | tasyaiva hi saharuāyugapratiniyatāhorajanīvibhāgaḥ prasiddha iti bhāvaḥ | saviśeṣaṇau vidhiniṣedhau viśeṣaṇamupasaṃkrāmataḥ iti nyāyāt, "ye'horātravido janāḥ' ityahorātraveditāṃśasyānūditatvācca saharuāyugaparyantāvedanamevātra vidheyamityabhiprāyeṇa tat caturyugasaharuāāvasānaṃ vidurityuktam | saharuāyugāniparya ntaṃ yasya tat saharuāyugaparyantam | yugaśabdaścātra pramāṇāntarānusārāccaturyugaparaḥ || astvevaṃ caturmukhasyāho rātravyavasthā; tataḥ kiṃ prastutasyetyatrottaram avyaktāditi ślokaḥ | tasyārthamāha tatreti | ayamabhiprāyaḥ -- atra vyaktiśabdastāvanna mahadādiviṣayaḥ, caturmukhātprāgeva tadutpatteḥ | ataścaturmukhasṛjyamātraviṣaya evāsau | vyajyanta iti vyaktayaḥ | tatrāpi satyalokādeḥ pratikalpaṃ pralayābhāvāt trailokyāntavartidehendriyādivastumātraviṣayatvameva ravīkāryam | teṣāṃ cotpattiḥ brāhṛśarīrādeva | tataścātra avyaktaśabdo'pi na mūlāvyaktaviṣayaḥ; api tu tadupādānakabrāhṛśarīraparaḥ | śarīre cāvyaktaśabda prayogaḥ sūtre'pyupapāditaḥ, sūkṣmaṃ tu tadarhatvāt iti | evaṃvidhasṛṣṭipralayakāraṇaviśeṣaṃ tadanuc chedācca sṛṣṭipralayasantānānucchedam akṛtābhyāgamakṛtavipraṇāśaprasaṅgaparihārām uktasyārthasya sarveṣpi kalpeṣu abhivyāÏpta yathāpūrvakalpanaṃ ca bhūtagrāmaḥ iti ślokaḥ pratipādayatītyabhiprāyeṇāha sa evayamiti | bhūtaśabdo trācidviśiṣṭakṣetrajñaparaḥ | sṛjyatvasaṃhāryatvahetubhūtamavaśatvaṃ karmanibandhanameva hītyabhiprayeṇa karmavaśya ityuktam | aharāgame iti padaṃ bhūtvetyatrāpyanuvaryanīyamityabhiprāyeṇa aharāgame bhūtvetvanya uktaḥ | idaṃ ca nainitikapralayapratipādanaṃ śrutyādisiddhaprākṛtapralayāpyupalakṣaṇam; tena satyalokavināśasiddhiḥ; ābrāhṛbhuva nallo kāḥ iti hrupakrāntamityabhiprāyeṇāha tatheti | yadvā rātryāgamaśabda eva brāhṛṇo'ntimarātryā gamamapi śaktyā saṃgṛhṇāti | pṛthivyāditattvānāmeva vilaye tadārabdhānāṃ brāhṛlokabrāhṛśarīrabrāhṛāṇḍādīnāṃ kā kathetya bhiprāyeṇa pṛthivītyādikśrutirudāhmatā | tamovasthāciddravyasyaikībhāvo hi parasminneva deve śrūyate | atrāpi 'ahaṃ kṛtsnasya jagataḥ prabhavaḥ pralayaḥ' ityādikaṃ hrucyata ityabhiprāyeṇa mayyevetyuktam | evaṃ "yo brāhṛā ṇaṃ vidadhāti pūrvam ' iti krameṇa punarbarahṛā disṛṣṭiḥ, punaśca tatpralaya ityādikamapi bhāvyam | īdṛśasṛṣṭipralayapratipādanasya prakṛtopāyogaṃ darśayati evamiti | sarveṣu sṛṣṭipralayaprakaraṇeṣvidameva tātparyaṃ bhāvyam | madvyatiktasya kṛtsnasyetyanena "ahaṃ kṛtsnasya 'iti prāguktaṃ smāritam | uktaṃ ca mokṣadharme'pi, "nityaṃ hi nāsti jagati bhūtaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam | ṛte tamekaṃ puruṣaṃ vāsudevaṃ sanātanam' paraityātiślokadvayasyārthamāha atheti| ayamabhiprāyaḥ -- bhagavantaṃ prāptānām apunarāvṛttiḥ prāgevoktā; avyaktātparatvena nirdiṣṭo'kṣaraśca jīva eva bhaviturmarhati, apareyamitastva nyām' ityādipratyabhijñānāt | vaktavyā ca kaivalyārthināmavarohābhāvadapunarāvṛttiḥ | ata eva tatparamevedaṃ ślokadvayam iti || avyaktasyaiva pūrvaprakṛtatvāt, atrāpi avyaktādityeva padaccheṃdaḥ | tasya cāpekṣayā paraśabdānyaśabdābhyāmapyanvayaḥ | tatra ca paunaruktyavyudāsāyotkṛṣṭatvābhidhānamukhena puruṣārtha rūpatvaparaḥ paraśabdaḥ | tata eva ca svarūpabhedasya siddhatvāt anyaśabdaḥ prakārānyatvaparaḥ | sa ca prakārabheda ścetanatvarupa eva pramāṇasiddhi ityabhiprāyeṇāha tasmāditi | bhāvaśabdo'tra padārthamātravācī | vyaktaḥ iti padacchedo na yuktaḥ; avyakto'śakṣaraḥ iti atraivābhidhānāt; dugrrahe ca jīve vyaktaśabdaprayogānupapatterityabhip prāyeṇāha kenaciditi | nanu jīvasyāvyaktatvamayuktam; pratyakṣānumānāgamaiśvaryaṃthāsaṃbhavaṃ tadvyakteḥ, anyathā khapupatvaprasaṅgādityatrāha svasaṃvedyati | pramāṇāntarāṇi hi sādhāraṇyena tatpratipādakānīti bhāvaḥ | nitya t ve dvatīyādhyāyoktahetusmāraṇam utpattivināśānarhatayeti | bhūtaśabdo'tra mahābhūtaparaḥ, tadvināśe'pyāt masthiti vacanena nityatvasyānāyāsalābhāt | tatra sarvaśabdābhiprāyavaśādeva sakāraṇatvaṃ sakāryatvaṃ ca siddhamityabhiprāyeṇāha viyadādīti | prasakto hi nāśo jīve niṣedhyaḥ; prasaṅgaścātra naśyatpadārthānupraveśavaśāt; yathā tileṣu dahramāneṣu tadanupraviṣṭaṃ tailamapi dahrate | tataśca sarveṣu bhūteṣu naśyatsvivatsyaiva sāmathryalabdhamuktaṃ tatra tatra sthito'pīti | yassa sarveṣvityatra sa ityasya prayojanamāndyāduttaratrāpekṣitatvācca ,so'vyakto'kṣara ityanva ya uktaḥ; yadvā'yamadhyāhāraḥ | ukta ityasya kutretyākāṅkṣāyāmāha ye tviti | anayoḥ prakaraṇayorakṣara śab dasya jīvaviṣayatvaṃ tatraiva vyaktam " uttamaḥ puruṣastvanyaḥ' ityādibhedavyapadeśāt | ato'trāpyadhyāye "akṣaraṃ brāhṛ paramam ' "avyakto'kṣaraḥ' ityakṣaraśabdābhyāṃ pariśuddhajīva eva vyapadiśyate | ye tvi tyatrākṣarā vyaktaśabdayodrvayorapi " avyakto'kṣara ityuktaḥ ' iti tadubhayanirdeśācca tattatprakaraṇopabṛṃhaṇīyaśrutyabhiprāyeṇa tadupādānāt " nihatāḥ pūrvameva' itivat svasaṅkalpārohādveti | āhurityatra katrrapekṣāyāṃ "yadakṣa raṃ vedavido vadanti ' iti prasaktamucitaṃ ca kartṛviśeṣamākṛṣyāha taṃ vedavida iti | "sa yāti paramāṃ gatim' iti sāmānyanirdeśa etena viśeṣita iti darśayati ayameva yaḥ prayātītyādinā | yadvā atra "tamāhuḥ paramāṃ gatim' iti nirdeśaḥ "sa yāti paramāṃ gatim' iti pūrvoktapratyabhijñāpanārtha iti bhāvaḥ | tatra ākṣaraparamagatiśabdayoḥ prayogayogyatāṃ darśayati prakṛtīti | anivṛttihetutvenāyamartha ukta ityabhiprāyeṇa evaṃbhūtaṃ svarupeṇāvasthitamityuktam | taddhāma paramaṃ mama iti, saṃbandhamātravidhānasya prāgeva siddheḥ sthānas ya ca sthānisāpekṣatvaniyamāt "ya ātmani tiṣṭhan ' ityādyuktamadhiṣṭheyaṃ sthānaparyāyaṃ dhāmaśabdena vivakṣitamityāha niyamanasthānamiti | atra kimaparaṃ niyamanasthānam, yadvyava cchedāya paramaśabdaḥ ittayāha -- acetaneti | atra paramadhāmatvavyapadeśāt pariśuddhātmaviṣayatvaṃ siddham | tata ścāśuddho jīvo'pyapara eva vivakṣita ityāha -- tatsaṃsṛṣṭeti | yadi mukto'pi paramātmāparatantra,tarhi svatantreṇa paramātmanā punarapi saṃsāragarte prakṣipyetetyatrāha tacceti | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ -- avidyādirhi saṃsārakāraṇam, na tu pāratantrayam; avidyādeśca prakṣayāt īśvarakāruṇyādīnāṃ ca svābhāvikatvānna muktasya saṃsāragandha iti | yadvā na kevalaṃ bhagavatprāptireva apunarāvṛttirūpā, kiṃtu pariśuddhajīvaprāptirapi avarohaṇābhā vāt tatheti bhāvaḥ | niyamanasthānamityāśritaviśeṣaṇopādānājhrnupapattayaṭarucerāha atheveti | astu dhāmaśabdastejaḥparyāyaḥ prakāśapakṣe tat paramaṃ dhāma mama maccheṣabhūtamiti vākyārthaḥ | yadyapi apareyam ityādinā prāgeva svaśeṣatvamuktam, tathā'pi samaṣṭicetanamātraviṣayatvaṃ tatra pratīyate; iha tu muktasyāpisvaśeṣatvamucyata itpaunaruktyam || 20 || 21 || puruṣasya iti śloke tuśabdenārthāntaradyotanāt, ananyayā bhakttyetyasya sāmathryāt, puruṣaśabdasya paramātmani puriśayatvapūrṇatvapūrvasadbhāva purudānādibhirnimittaiḥ, "saharuāśīrṣā puruṣaḥ' ityādiprayogaprā curyāt paraśabdena viśeṣaṇācca pūrvoktātaphalādadhikaphalopadeśārtho'yaṃ śloka ityabhiprāyeṇāha jñānina iti | bibhaktam | vivecakairiti śeṣaḥ | vilakṣaṇamiti vā'rthaḥ | gaganādyantassthitāvapi gaganādeḥ paratvābhāvāt tat siddhayarthaṃ yasyetyādiprasiddhavannirdeśo'tra pūrvoktaparatvapara iti darśayati matta iti | anuvādapurovāda yoraikāthrya miti bhāvaḥ | "yasmātparaṃ nāparam' ityārabhya "tenedaṃ pūrṇaṃ puruṣeṇa sarvam' iti śrutismāraṇāya yena ca pareṇa puruṣeṇetyuktam | bhakterananvayatvaṃ kīdṛśamityātrāha ananyacetā iti || 22 || yatra kāle tvityādeḥ yogayukto bhavārjunetyantasya tātaparyamāha atheti | atra dhūmādimārgakathanaṃ heyatvārtham; arcirādimārgopadeśastu tadanusandhānārtha eveti tatraiva tātparyamiti bhāvaḥ | nanu paramapuruṣā rthaniṣṭha syaiva hrarcirādigatiḥ, tat kathamatra sādhāraṇyamucyata ityatrāha dvayorapīti | ātmaniṣṭhasyāpyapunarāvṛtteḥ pūrvoktatvāt tasyāpyarcirādikaiva gatiriti darśayitumāha sā ceti | sādhāraṇyāpunarāvṛttyoḥ śrutimeva darśayati yatheti | aṅgiphalamevāṅge'pi nirdiṣṭuṃ yuktam, tathā'pyaṅginā sahāṅgasya tulyatvena pṛthaṅnirdiṣṭasya tatphalanirdeśo na yukta iti bhāvaḥ | etena prathamaṣaḍkoditpratyagātmavedanādatratyākṣarayā thātmyānusandhānasya bhedo'pi darśitaḥ | "tadya itthaṃ viduḥ' ityasya pratyagātmaniṣṭhaviṣayatvaṃ kathamityatrāha pañ cāgnividyāyāṃ ceti | " āpa puruṣavacaso bhavanti ' iti trivṛtkṛtānāmabhidhīyamānatvādbhūtāntarasaṃsargasiddhiḥ | apamevāttyātmasvarūpapariṇāmavyudāsāyoktam | evaṃvidhaśarīrasaṃbandhamātrasyāpyaupādhikatvapradarśanāyāha puṇyapāpahetuka iti | 'ramaṇīyacaraṇā ramīyāṃ yoniṃ ... ... kapūyacaraṇāḥ kapūyāṃ yonim' ityādivacanānna kevalācidviṣayamidaṃ prakaraṇam | 'tadya itthaṃ vidurye ceme'raṇye śraddhā tapa ityupāsate' ityuktayadvṛttadvayasya te'rciṣamityekena tadvṛttena pratinikdeśādubhayorgatiraviśiṣṭeti jñāpanāya, 'tadya itthaṃ viduḥ', 'te'rciṣam' itivyavahitamupāttam |itdaṃśabdānūditaṃ prastutākāraviśeṣaṃ darśayati vivikte iti | nanu 'tatpuruṣo'mānavaḥ sa enān brāhṛ gamayati' itrcirādinā gatasya brāhṛprāptiḥ śrūyate; tat kathaṃ kevalātmopāsakasya brāhṛprāpakārcirādiprāptirityatrāha ātma yāthātmyeti | ayaṃ pajcāragnividyāniṣṭho na kevalātmopāsakaḥ, apitu brāhṛātamakasvātmānusandhāyīti bhāvaḥ | anyathā tatkratunyāyavirodha ityabhiprāyeṇāha tatkratunyāyācceti | cakāra itara tarayoge | yathāvasthitātmānusamdhānasya paraśeṣatokarasatvānusandhānarūpatve pramāṇamāha ya ātmanīti | ādiśabdena 'patiṃ viśvasya' ityādivākyaśataṃ gṛhrate | atra śārīrakabhāṣyādivirodho manderāśāṅkitaḥ | iha tāvat śrutusūtrabhāṣyādiṣvanyatra ca paramātmātmakasvātmānusandhātṛtvamarcirādigatiścāviśeṣeṇocyate | tasyāśca brāhṛgamayitṛtvasya śrutyādiṣu iha ca 'tatra prayātā gacchanti brāhṛ brāhṛvido janāḥ' iti siddhatvāt pajcāgnivido'pi paramātmātmaprāptirasyeveti svīkartavyam | tatra prāptau jñānināṃ paramātmā svaviśiṣṭo bhogyaḥ; akṣarayāthātmyaniṣṭhānāṃ tu svasvarūpameva pūrvaṃ bhogyam; vas vādipadaprāptipūrvakabrāhṛprāptisādhanamadhuvanadyādinyāyādantato brāhṛprāptiḥ īdṛśaparvakramapratiniyamaśca prācīnāpekṣa ābhedāt, sa ca prācīnakarmaviśeṣāditi "caturvidhā bhajante mām ' iti prāgeva darśitaḥ | na cātra jijñāsoranya evātmayāthātmyaviditi bhāṣyate, jijñāsuvedyatayoktasvabhāvavisargayoḥ atra ca pañcāgnividyodāhara ṇāt | madhye ca kaivalyārthina eva mūrdhanyanāḍā niṣkaraṇam; anāvṛttiścoktā | ātmayāthātmyākṣarayāthātamyaśabdayoścātra na bhinnārthatatvam; tasyopāsane kiñcidasti viśeṣaḥ -- akṣarayāthātmyavidaḥ paramātmaśarīrabhūtasavātmopāsakāḥ , jñāninastu svātmaśarīrakaparamātmopāsakā iti | ayameva viśeṣaḥ, "tat yaya itthaṃ vidurye ceme' raṇye iti vibhāganirdeśābhipreta iti bhāṣyādiṣūktaḥ | sāre tu, ubhe'pi hi paripurṇaṃ brā hṛopā sate mukhabhedena; svātmaśarīrakaṃ brāhṛ kecana, brāhṛātmakasvātmānamitare iti | ata eva, "saptame prakānto jijñāsuḥ paramātmaprāptikāmajñānivyatiriktatvādabrāhṛātmakasvātmanusandhāyī ' iti na bhramitavyam | tasya codarakoṭimātre niveśaḥ svātmanubhavavilambavimukhajñānivyatirekāt | arcirādigatiniṣedhastu brāhṛātmakatvānusandhānarahitasvātmopāsanaviṣayaḥ | idamapi bhāṣyādiṣu vyaktamevoktam, tasmādacinmiśraṃ kevalaṃ vā cidvastu brāhṛdṛṣṭayā tadviyogena ca ya upāsate, na tānnayatisa; api tu paraṃ brāhṛopāsīnān, ātmānaṃ ca prakṛtiviyuktaṃ brāhṛātmakamupāsīnān ātivāhiko gaṇo nayati ityādibhiḥ | yatpunarucyate, ye tu śiṣṭāruāyo bhaktāḥ phalakāmā hi te matāḥ | sarve cyavanadharmāṇaḥ iti; tatrāpi ātma mātrānubhavasukhasya asthiratvādeva cyavanadharmatvamucyate | na tāvatā punassaṃsāraprasaṅgaḥ, indralokātparibharaṣṭo mama geya "pracyuto vā eṣo' smāllokādagato devalokam ' ityādiṣvivoterottarātiśayitacapadaprāptāvapi pūrvapadabhraṃśamātrāt cyavanadharmatvācoyukteravirodhāt | parimitasukhānubhavavilambena tadānīṃ niratiśayasukhānubhavādbhraṣṭatvenāpi nindopapatteśca | upāsanadaśānubhūte paramātmani phaladaśāyāṃ kiñcitkālamanubhavavicchedādvā prāptabhraṃśalakṣaṇaṃ cyavanadharmatvātvam | " pratibuddhastu mokṣabhāk ' iti cāvyahita mokṣabhāktvaṃ pratibu ddhasyocyate; na tāvatā'nyasya mokṣabhāvaḥ; bhuktvā ca bhogān vipulāṃstvamante matprasādataḥ | māmānusmaraṇaṃ prāpya mama lokamavāpsyasi || ' itivat avirodhāt | yathā ca mumukṣoreva kasyacinmadhye brāhṛkāya niṣevaṇam | utkrāmati ca mārgasthaḥ śāntīnirāmayaḥ ityādinā brāhṛkāya niṣevaṇasaṅgānmuktasya devayānena mārgeṇa paramākāśagamanamucyate -- tadvadihāpi svātmanubhavasthānātpracyutasya parama vyomādhirohaḥ syāt | arcirādigatiścāsyāvāntaraphalānubhavāt paścādvā, gatimadhye vā, dakṣiṇāyanasamṛtasya candramasatsāyujyatvat viśramamātrarūpo'yamāvāntaraphalānubhava ityubhayathā'pi na virodhaḥ |etena paścādevāsyāparatīkālambanatvamityapi nirastam; madhuvidyāvadeva prathamamapi tadupapatteḥ | smaranti ca svātmānubhavasthānaṃ muktisthāvādarvācīnam yogināmamṛtaṃ sthānaṃ svātmasantoṣakāriṇām | ekāntinassadā brāhṛdhyāyino yogino hi ye | teṣāṃ tat paramaṃ sthānaṃ yadvai paśyanti sūrayaḥ || iti | amṛtasthānavartināṃ ca muktatvavyapadeśo jarāmaraṇādivirahāt punarjanmahetubhūtapuṇyapāpavigamācca | asti ca parityaktasthūladehānāmapi tattudupasanāviśeṣādhīnamapavargadarvācīnaṃ phalam | tacca prakṛtilayācadiśabdena sāṅkhayāḥ paṭhanti, dharmeṇa gamanamūdhrvaṃ gamanamadhastācadbhavatyadharmeṇa | jñānena cāpavargo viparyayādiṣyate bandhaḥ || vairāgyāt prakṛtilayaḥ saṃsāro bhavati rājasādrāgāt | aiśvaryādacavidhāto viparyātatadviparyāsaḥ iti | "viparyayādiṣyate bandhaḥ'; sa ca trividhaḥ prākṛtiko vaikṛtiko dākṣiṇikaśceti | tathā prakṛtāvātmajñānāt ye prakṛtimupāsate; teṣāṃ prākṛtiko bandhaḥ | yaḥ purāṇe prakṛtilayān prakṛ tyocyate, pūrṇe śatasaharuāṃ tu tiṣṭhantyaktacintakāḥ iti | vaikāriko bandhaḥ teṣām; ye vikārāneva bhūtendriyāhaṅakārabuddhīrupāsate puruṣabuddhayā; tān pratīdamucyate; yaśā daśa manvantarāṇīha tiṣṭhandriyacintakāḥ| bhautikāstu śataṃ pūrṇaṃ saharuāṃ tvābhimānikāḥ | bauddhā daśasaharuāāṇi tiṣṭhanti vigatajvarāḥ te khalavamī videhā yeṣāṃ vaikṛtiko vandhaḥ iti | evamavyaktāditatvacintākānāmiva pratyagātmatattvacincakānāmapi taducideśakālaṃ tato'tiśayatvaṃ phalamupapadyate | ata eva bhūmavidyāyāṃ pratyagātmamātropāsakasyāpyativādi tvamuktam | brāāhṛātkasvātmānusandhāne tu brāhṛprāptau viśramādapunarāvṛttiriti viśeṣaḥ | ata evākaṣarānubhavasyān tattve tadarthinaḥ kathamaiśvaryarthivat apavargādhikāryantaratvamityapi nirastam, bāhrāntarabhoktavyavibhāgāt āvṛttyanāvṛttiyogya tābhedācca tadbhedopapatteḥ | vilambākṣamāṇāṃ punariyaṃ,niṣṭhā, "sarvadharmāṃśca saṃtyajya sarvakāmāṃśca sākṣārān | lokavikrāntacaraṇau śaraṇaṃ te'vrajaṃ vibho' iti | "kaivalyaṃ bhagavantaṃ ca manatro'yaṃ sādhayiṣyiti ' ityādiṣvapi kaivalyaśabdena ātmamātrānubhavasukhaṃ tadapekṣibhiḥ prāpyamucte | etaccāntarāyakoṭiniviṣṭatvādāditaḥ sāvadhānā jñāninaḥ pariharanti | kecittu brāhṛānubhavavaimukhyena nityamātmānubhavasukhamicchanti; na tatra bhāṣyatākārādisaṃpradāyaṃ pramāṇaṃ yukiṃta vā paśyāmaḥ | niśśeṣakarmakṣaye svābhāvikarūpābirbhāvena brāhṛānuvāvaśyambhāvāt, karmaśeṣayoge tu saṃsāra prasaṅgācca | jarāmaraṇādihetubhūtasarvakarmavināśāsaṃsāraḥ, tāvanmātreṇa ca muktatvavyapadeśaḥ | brāhṛānubhava prati bandhanakakarmaṇastvavināśāt tadanubhavābhāva iti cet -- astvevam ; etatkarma parastādapi na naṅkṣayatītyatra na niyāmakatmasti ityeṣā dik | paraprāptyādirahitanityakaivalyakalpanā | sūtrabhāṣyaśrutismṛtyādyabādhane na sidhyati || ato'dhikāribhedena hravasthābhedamāśritāḥ| anyāmapi gatiṃ pratīcīṃ pratyapādayatan || tatrāvṛttiparaprāptivairūpyāderayogataḥ | asmaduktaṃ śrutismṛtyoranapāyaṃ rasāyanam || arcirādigatimāhegati kathamucyate? yatra kāle iti kālaviśeṣo hrupakramyata ityatrāha atra kālaśabda iti | śārīrake dakṣiṇāyanādimṛtasyāpi mokṣa uktaḥ, ataścāyane'pi dakṣiṇe iti | atra ca, śuklakṛṣṇe gatī hrete iti anantarasāvocyate; anyathā agnijryotiricyā tinā ca virudhyeta | "nete sṛtī pārtha jānan' iti ca mārgavācinā śabdenopasaṃhyiyata iti bhāvaḥ | yatra kāle prayātā iti vyavahitena saṃbandhaṃ darśayan, yogināmāvṛttiḥ kathamiti ca śaṅkāṃ pariharan, yatra kāle iti ślokasya vākyārthamāha yasminniti | atra yoginaḥ jñāninaḥ, puṇyakarmasaṃbandhinaśca | sasarūpāṇāmekaśeṣa ekavibhaktau ityanuśāsanāt | yadvā puṇyakarmāṇa ityadhvāhmatam | "te'rciṣabhisaṃbhavantayarciṣo'harahna āpūryamāṇapakṣamāpūryamāṇapakṣāt yān ṣaḍudaṅṅeti māsāṃstān, māsebhayassaṃvat saram' ityādiśrutyanusāreṇoktaṃ saṃvatsarīdīnāṃ pradarśanamiti | etadvaiśadyamarcirādipāde | tatraiva saṃgṛhītaṃ varadagurubhiḥ, arcirahassitapakṣān udagayanābdamarudarkendūn | api vaidyudavaruṇendraprajāpatīn ātivāhikān āhuḥ || iti | agnijryotiriti | agnirūpajyotiri tyarthaḥ | tena devayānaprathamaparvasthārcivivakṣā | ata evāgnijyotiṣorbhinnadevatātvaṃ kālābhimāniviśeṣatvaṃ ca vadantaḥ pratyuktāḥ || 23-24 || pitṛlokāderiti ādiśabdena ākāśacandragrahaṇam | yogino dhūmādimārgaḥ punarāvṛttiśca kathamucyata ityatrāha atra yogaśabda iti | atra yogiśabda upāyamātravācī; yadvā saṃbandhamātravācī; dhūmādisāmathryāttu puṇyakar masva rūpasaṃbandhiviśeṣasiddhiriti bhāvaḥ | atha ya ime grāme iṣṭāpūrte dattamityupāsate te dhūmamabhisaṃbhavanti ityādikā śrutiratropabṛṃhitā || 25 || uktamārgadvaye śrutiprasiddhiḥ pradaśryate śuklakṛṣṇe iti ślokena | atra śuklapakṣakṛṣṇapakṣānvayādvā, śuddhayaśu ddhivivakṣayā vā, abhigantṛsvarūpasyābhigantavye āropādervā, gatyoḥ śuklakṛṣṇaśabdopacāraḥ | atrādhikṛtavargadvayaviṣayajagacchabdābhipretapradarśanaṃ jñānināṃ vividhānāṃ puṇyakarmaṇāṃ ceti | iṣṭāpūrte dattamit yupāsate ityuktatattatakarmaniṣṭhabhedābhiprāyeṇa vividhaśabdaḥ | hiśabdena śrutiprasiddhidryotiteti śrutāvityuktam | śāśvatatvaṃ pravāharūpeṇānādyantatvam || vyavasthitatvam..... naite sṛtī iti ślokena | yadyapi mārgacintanamapyupāsanavat paramapuruṣaprāptyarthameva; tathā'pi mārgajñānaṃ hi abhiganturavyākulagamanārthamiti loke siddham | atrāpi tathopakāraḥ saṃbhavanna paritāyājaḥ; tatprasādādāveva hi tatsiddhirapītyabhiprāyeṇāha etāviti | kaścaneti | kaścidapītyarthaḥ | na muhrati "tatprakāśitadvāraḥ ' ityādiprakāreṇa spaṣṭamārgo bhavatītyarthaḥ | mārgadvayajñānaṃ heyamārgapravāhaṇārthamityabhiprāyeṇāha api tviti | gatijñānasya phalamupadiśya tasmāditi hetutayā parāmṛśya sākṣādyogavidhānasyāsaṅgatatvāt yoga śabdo'tra dhyānamātraviṣayaḥ; tacca dhyānaṃ prastutagaticintanarupameva bhavitumarhatītyabhiprāyeṇāha tasmāditi ||27|| idaṃ viditveti sāmānyato nirdeśādaviśeṣaccaikaprakaraṇabhūtādhayāyadvayārtho gṛhrata ityabhiprāyeṇāha atheti | vedeṣvityapi yajñādivat phalakāraṇatayopādānm; na tu pratipādakatayā; tadā yajñādiphalavyatiriktaviṣayatayā saṅkocanīyatvāpātāt | vedābhyāsasya ca duritakṣayādiphalapradatvaṃ śrutyādi siddham | yajñādiphalānāṃ pratipādakatayopādāne prastutādhyāyadvayārthasyāpi vedārthasvāt tato'pi saṅkocaḥ syāt | tadetatsarvamabhipretya vedābhyāsetyuktam | dāne ceti cakārasyānuktasamuccāyakatvapradarśanāya p rabhṛti śabdaḥ | puṇyaphalamityatra puṇyaśabdena phalaviśeṣaṇatayā yajñādīnāmeva sāmānyato nirdeśaḥ phalasya ślāghyatā pradarśanārthaṃ ityabhiprāyeṇa yajñādiviśeṣyatayā puṇyoṣvityuktam | adhyāyadvayoditaṃ bhagavanmāhātmyamiti |sapta māramabhe pi bhagavanmāhātmyaṃ prakrāntam; tadanubandhādanyatsarvamuktamiti bhāvaḥ | paraṃ sthāsapaitīti yogānuṣaṭhāna sādhyasya sākṣātphalasya pṛthagucyamānatvāt tadviṣatve paunaruktyāt, adhikapuṇyaphalaprāptivivakṣāyāṃ lakṣitalakṣaṇāpātāt, saṃsāranivṛttimātraparatve'pi puṇyaphalaśabdena pāpaphalasyāpi lakṣiyitavyatvāt tatsarvamatye tītyetat tadvivekamūlaviraktabhiprāyam | atiśayitaphalavedanaṃ hi manaḥ prītiranāyasāt ityādinyāyena phalāntaravaitṛṣṇyaheturityahetubhiprāyeṇāha etadvedaneti | bhagavanmāhātmya jñānasya parasthānaprāptihetutve prāgukta jñānaviśeṣarūpadvārapradarśanaṃ yogī ityanena kriyata ityabhiprāyeṇa jñānī ca bhūtvetyuktam | paratvaṃ de śakāla yogādibhiḥ, "ādityavarṇaṃ tamasaḥ parastāt ' , "tadakṣare parame vyoman ' , "ete vai nirayāstāta sthānasya paramātmanaḥ ' ityādeḥ | ādyam anādimityarthaḥ | ādau bhavaṃ kāraṇaṃ brāhṛ' iti paroktaṃ tu sthānaśabdavaighaṭādapayuktam || 28 || || iti śrīmadgītābhāṣyaṭīkāyāṃ tātparyacandrikāyām aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ || 8 || <9> || atha śrīmadgītābhāṣyaṭīkāyāṃ tātparyacandrikāyām navamo'dhyāyaḥ || svamāhātmyaṃ manuṣyatve paratvaṃ ca mahātmanām | viśeṣo navame yogo bhaktirūpaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || iti saṃgrahaślokamapi vyākurvan tadanusāreṇāṣṭamanavamayossaṅgatiṃ ca darśayati upāsaketyādinā | viśe ṣāḥ jñātavyepādeyabhedāḥ | paramapuruṣamāhātmyasya jñānināṃ viśeṣasya ca prāgeva pākṛtatvāt tatprabhāvaviśa odhana mātramatropāsanātatphalānupraviṣṭatayā kriyateḥ adhyāyapradhānarthastūpāsanasvarūpaniṣkarṣa ityabhiprāyeṇa viśodhyeti vicchidya bhaktirūpasyetyādi pṛthaguktam | bhajanāpāsanaśabdayorasminnevādhyāye prakaraṇāntareṣu ca samānaviṣayatayaiva prayogavaśāt śratisiddhopāsanasyaivātra bhaktiśabdena viśeṣaṇaṃ kṛtamityabhiprāyeṇa bhaktirūpasyopāsanasyetyuktam | atra idaṃ tu te guhramitamamiti jñānasyopakrāntatvāt, manmanā bhaveti copasaṃhyiyamāṇatvāt, madhye ca bahuśo bhajanasyaivābhyasyamānatvāt, pratyakṣarūpatvaniratiśayapriyatvakīrtanayajananamaskārarūpatvādīnāṃ cāpūrvāṇāṃ bhaktisvarūpānupraveśināṃ prakārāṇāṃ pratipādyamānatvāt, svarūpatassāghyatayā niratiśayaphalapratipādanāt, rājavidyaityādinā praśaṃsārū pārthavādadarśanāccātropakramopasaṃhārāditātparyaliṅ gaiḥ guṇavattvanairguṇyābhyāṃ viśeṣaṇam | etaccetyādikaṃ pūrvavat | siṃhāvalokitakenāha tapodāne ca tatheti | manovṛttiviśeṣāvityarthaḥ | uktamātravyudāsāyopalakṣaṇatāmabhipretyāha evamādyā iti | abhiprāya'pi bhāva śabdaprayogādatra bhāvaśabdasya manovṛttiviṣayatā | sarveṣāṃ kartṛkaraṇādīnāṃ pravṛtteḥ svādhīnatve kaimutyārthamāha pravṛttinivṛttihetava iti | matta evetyatra paroktasannidhamātrādivyudāsāya pañcamyavagataṃ hetutvaṃ vyāpāramukhene tyāha matsaṅkalpeti | pṛthagvidhānāṃ parasparavirūddhānāmapyahameko heturiti evakārībhiprāyaḥ || sṛṣṭisthitihetutayā prasiddheṣu iti "maharṣīṇāṃ bhṛguraham ' iti tatpradhānatvaṃ hi vakṣyate | "sapta brāāhṛṇa ityete purāṇe niścayaṃ gatāḥ ' ityādismāraṇāya saptaśabdaḥ | ārṣaivaraṇe varaṇīyānāṃ gotrāṇāṃ pravartayitāra pratikṣaṇamāpralayāditi | utpādakāḥ pālakāśceti maharṣīṇāṃ manūnāṃ ca yathākramaṃ nirdeśaḥ | utpādikāḥ ityādistrīliṅgapāṭhe tu tattatprajābhiryathāsaṃbhavamanvayaḥ | mama yo bhāva sya eva yeṣāṃ bhāva iti | bhāvasāmānādhikaraṇyaphalitoktiriyam, madhyamapadalopī vā samāsaḥ |rājño bhāva eva kiṅkarasya bhāva itavat abhiprāyasāmyāpekṣayā'yaṃ vyapadeśa iti darśayati manmate sthitā iti | svakalyāṇetyādisaṃgrahaśloke tvayamevārtho yathākramamuktaḥ; tadanusāreṇa padārthavākyārthavāha vibhūtiraiśvaryamityādinā | sarvasya sadāyatto tpattisthitipravṛttitā rūpāṃ vibhūtimiti | tannirūpyatvāt dramiḍabhāṣyoditeṣu ṣaṭsvartheṣu siddhāntatvena bhāṣyakāraparigṛhītāḥ trayo'rthāḥ | tathā hi vedārtha saṃgrahe darśitam , gambhīrāmbhassamudbhūtasumṛṣnālaravikaravikasitapuṇḍarīkadalāmalāyatekṣaṇaḥ iti | idaṃ ca varadagurubhistattvasāre prapañcitam | nārāyaṇavaśabdena paratattvanirṇayaikaparanārāya ṇānuvākasūcanam | śrīmān kṣīrārṇavaniketanaḥ ityārabhyām, hyīśca te lakṣmīśca patnyau, amabhaspāre, yamantassamudre ' ityādikaṃ smāritam | utsṛjyāgataḥ ityavatāramātratvaṃ vivakṣitam; kṛṣṇāvatāradaśāyāmapi kṣīrārṇavagatānāgaparyaṅkaśāyivigrahasya tatraiva sthitatvāt | sākṣādi ti | na tvaupacārikaḥ, ātmāntaravyavahoto vetyarthaḥ | tatheti prakaraṇāntaratvavyaktyartham | devarṣi nāradastathā ' iti vyākhyeyavibhāgāvagamāt uktavākyopādānamapi tathāvibhāgena kurmaha iti ca darśitam | tatra kṛtsnamityādi nārāyaṇasyaiva sarvāśrayatvāt, sarvaprakārātiśayayogitvādvā | tatpuṇyamityādikaṃ brāhṛ śabdānurodhena nārāyaṇaviṣayaṃ vā, prakaraṇaviśeṣeṇa tadāśritasthānapraśaṃsanaṃ vā | svayameveti |svatassarvajño brāhṛādīnāmapi gurustvamevetyarthaḥ | bhūmirāpaḥ ityādiṣu sarvaśeṣitvaṃ sarvakāraṇatvaṃ sarvaśarīritvamit yādikamuktam || saṅgatyarthamāha ata iti | āptamairāmnāyairmaharṣibhiḥ bhavatā'pi coktatvāditi bhāvaḥ | ṛtaṃ manye ityasyābhipretamāha na praśaṃsādyabhiprāyamiti | anyeśaṣu hi tadguṇāropeṇena praśaṃsetyabhiprāyaḥ | mā mitya nena "śiṣyaste'haṃ śādhi māṃ tvāṃ prapannam ' ityādikamabhipretam | vadiriha śiṣṭamanuvadan śās yarthe vartamāno dvikarmakaḥ | evaṃ śiṣṭasyānubhāṣaṇaṃ śāsanaviśeṣaprārthanārtham | ananyasādhāraṇamanavadhikāti śayamiti viśeṣaṇābhyāṃ samādhikarāhityam, svabhāvikamiti ananyādhīnatvaṃ vivakṣitam | ato na vidurit yanvayaḥ | "jñānaśaktibalaiśvaryavīryatejāṃsyaśeṣataḥ | bhagavacchabdavācyāni vinā heyairguṇādibhiḥ || iti bhagavatparāśaravacanānusāreṇa devādibhiravedyatvāya bhagavacchabdārthe darśayati niratiśaya jñānetyādinā | vyaktiśabdo'tra kimātmikaivaiṣā bhagavato vyaktiḥ ityādiṣviva na vigrahādi paraḥ, aprasaktatvāt, anantaraṃ ca apṛcchayamānatvāt; ataḥ, "vaktumarhasyaśeṣeṇa ' ityanantaraṃ vivakṣoḥ, "anye tvatpratipādanaprakāramapi na jānanti, kiṃ punaḥ pratyakṣādivat prakāśanamityartho'pekṣitatvāt svīkāryaḥ ' ityabhiprāyeṇāha vyañjanaprakāramiti | "akṣarakṣarayovyaktim i itivat | parimitajñānā iti hi śabdatātparyoktiḥ || devādīnāṃ bhagavadvaibhave vaktṛtvayogyatā pratikṣiptā; atha bhagavata eva svavaibhavacanayogyatāmāha svayameveti ślokena | atra puruṣottameti saṃjñā; śeṣaṃ tu tatsaṃjñānvayaupayikaguṇaparamiti vibhajanāya pūrvameva he puruṣottametyuktam | atra "tvameva tvāṃ vettha yo'si " iti śrutismaraṇādyabhiprāyeṇa ātmāna mityasya tvāmiti pratipadam | svayamevetyanena phalitoktiḥ svainaiva jñāneneti | ātmanā anyairananu gṛhīta ityarthaḥ | yathā'nyeṣāṃ, "mattassamṛtijrñānam ' iti, na tathā'styeti bhāvaḥ| yadvā ātmanetyasya vyākhyā jñāneneti; ātmā jīve ityārabhya "yatne'rke'gnau matau vāyau ' iti pāṭhāt | bhāvanaśabdasya cintādyarthaparatvavyudāsāyāha utpādayitariti | bhūteśajagatpatiśabdayoḥ paunaruktyaśaṅkā vyudāsāya niyantṛtvamasvāmitvakathanam | rakṣaṇe vyutpannasyāpi patiśabdasya śeṣitve rūḍhiḥ | "sa kāraṇaṃ karaṇādhipādhipaḥ , tamīśvarāṇāṃ paramaṃ maheśvaraṃ taṃ daivatānāṃ paramaṃ ca daivatam | patiṃ patīnāṃ paramaṃ parastāt vidāma devaṃ bhuvaneśamīḍam || iti śrutisiddhāścatvāro'rthāḥ bhūtabhāvanetyā dibhiścaturbhiḥ pratipādyanta iti jñāpanāya daivatānāmapi paramadaivateti śrutigataiḥ padairyākhyātam | devaśabdasya jātiviśeṣavācakatvena pratisaṃbandhiśabdatvābhāvāt dvatīyo devaśabda utkarṣaviśeṣaviṣayatayā aupacārika iti mukhyagauṇānugatamupacārinimittaṃ darśayati yatheti | anyonyavailakṣaṇyasyākiṃcikaratvāya, atyantavailakṣaṇyajñāpanāya ca mṛgapakṣimisarīsṛgṛhaṇam | yathā devādīnāṃ kīṭaḥ, tathā paramātmano devā api | kīṭāḥ samastāḥ surā dṛṣṭe yatra... iti hrāhuḥ | saundaryasauśīlyeti vigraha guṇānāmātmaguṇānāṃ copalakṣaṇam || ātmaśabdo'nyavibhūtitvavyudāsārtha ityāha tvadasādhāraṇya iti | vibhūtayaḥ iti prathamāntatvena vaktumarhasītyanena anavayāyogāt vibhūtayo yā iti yacchabdādhyāhāraḥ | yadvā divyā hi, ato'vaśyavakta vyāḥ; ataḥ tāḥ vaktumarhasīti vākyāvṛttijñāpanārthaḥ | arhasīti yogyatvanirdeśena tatprārthanaṃ vivakṣitam | īśvareṇāpyaśeṣeṇa vaktum, arjunena ca śrotum aśakyatvāt vacanataḥ prasādataśca prakāśanamātramiha prāthrya te; "na hi te bhagavan vyaktim ' iti hi pūrvamuktamityabhiprāyeṇāha tvameva vyañjayetyartha iti | bahuvacanāsaṅkocāt aśeṣeṇeti nirdeśācca ānantyamiha vivakṣitam, "nāstyanto vistarasya ' ityādyuttaravaśāccetyabhiprāyeṇa anantābhirityuktam | vipūrvo bhavatiḥ bhāvapratyayānto niyamanavācītyuktam | na cātrārthāntaraṃ dhaṭate, niyantavyasāmānādhikaraṇyādyabhāvādityabhiprāyeṇa yairniyamanaviśeṣairityuktam | prabhūtaniyamanaviṣaye kautukātirekādyotanāya viśeśabdaḥ | tṛtīyāyā iha karaṇādyarthatvāyogāt itthamabhūta lakṣaṇārthatvaṃ vivakṣitamityabhiprāyeṇa yukta ityuktam | atra vibhūtiśabdasya niyantavyaparatve aśvatthādīnāṃ na lokavyāptikāraṇatvam; na ca tadviśiṣṭasya, taissaha vā taditaravyāptiḥ; na ca vyāptau niyantavyā nāmitthaṃbhūtalakṣaṇatvam, nairarthakyāt; niyamanaviśeṣāṇāṃ tu śrutyanusārāt ākāśādivyāptivyavacchedārthatvā cca tadupapattirityabhiprāyeṇāha niyantṛtvena vyāpyeti | "antaḥpraviṣṭaśśāstā janānām ' ityādi hi śrūyate | vyāpya tiṣṭhasītyanena, "vyāpya nārāyaṇaḥ sthitaḥ ' iti śrutiḥ smāritā || yogiśabdaḥ prakaraṇaviśeṣāt tvāṃ sadā paricintayannityādessāmathryācca yogiviśeṣaviṣaya ityāha bhaktiyoganiṣṭhassanniti | sannityanena niṣpannayogiparatvamapi vyāvartitam | atra yoginniti pareṣāṃ pāṭho' nārṣaḥ | sadeti viśeṣaṇamasāmathryāt bhaktayeti siddham | vedanātpūrvaṃ cintanāśakteḥ,kathaṃ vidyāmityasya cintanahetutvāt, lakṣaṇahetvoḥ kriyāyāḥ iti śaturanuśā sanācca cintayituṃ pravṛtta ityuktam | tvāmiti dharmiviśeṣasya pratipannatvāt prakāraviśeṣeṣu bubhutseti jñāpanāyoktam paripūrṇetyādi | praśno hrajñātaviśeṣajñāpanārtha ityabhisandhāyoktaṃ pūrvoktetyādi | bhāveṣviti saptamyabhipretoktiḥ prakṛtānu karṣaṇaṃ vā niyantṛtveneti || pratikūlajanānāṃ narasādigamayitṛtvāt anukūlajanaiḥ svābhilaṣitaṃ yācyamānatvādvā janārdanaḥ | vistara bubhutsāhetujñāpanārthaṃ yogaśabdavivakṣitavyaktayarthaṃ ca bhūyaśśabdaphalitamāha ahaṃ sarvasyeti | amṛtaśabdo'trā tṛptisamabhivyāhārāt māhātmye bhogyatvaparaḥ | bhogyatamatvāyoktaṃ tvayocyamānamiti | tvanmukhacandranissṛ tamiti bhāvaḥ | hi śabdābhipretaṃ vivṛṇoti mameti || evamatṛptyā pṛcchantamarjunaṃ prati atiprasanno bhagavāṃstasyābhijanādivarṇanamukhena yogyatāṃ darśayan vibhūtervistareṇa pratyekaṃ vaktuṃ śrotuṃ ca aśakyatvāt kenacidupādhiviśeṃṣeṇa saṃgṛhītā vibhūtīrvakṣyāmītyāha hanteti | te anasūyutvaprīyamāṇatvātṛptatvādiguṇapūrṇāyeti bhāvaḥ | guṇatvādipratiyogikaśeṣitvādiprādhānya vivakṣāyāṃ vakṣyamāṇasamastodāharaṇavyāptyabhāvāt guṇānāṃ ca prādhānyena vyapadekṣyamāṇatvāt saṃgrāhakamarthaviśeṣamāha prādhānyaśabdeneti | tasyaiva vivakṣitatvaṃ vakṣyamāṇena saṃvādayati purodhasāmiti | piṇḍitārthamāha jagatīti | vistareṇa kathayeti pṛcchantaṃ prati prādhānyataḥ kathayiṣyāmiti kathamucyata iti śaṅkāyāṃ nāstyanto vistarasya me ityucyate | vibhūtīnāmiti śeṣaḥ | "vibhūtervistaro mayā ' iti hi vakṣyate | nāstiśabdābhipretamaśakyatvaṃ darśayati vistareṇa vaktumiti | nedaṃ vakṛśrotrorasāmathrya nibandhanamityāha tāsāmānantyāditi | tadetaduktaṃ nāstyanta iti | vakṣyamāṇeṣu padārtheṣu vibhūtiśabdaprayo nimittamāha vibhūtitvaṃ nāmeti | niyamantavyastvantaraviṣayo vibhūtiśabdo vibhavanakarmaparaḥ| anyatra ca " brāhṛā dakṣādayaḥ kālaḥ ' , "viṣṇurmanvādayaḥ kālaḥ ' , "rudraḥ kālāntakādyāśca ' ityādiṣu "janārdanavibhūtayaḥ ' iti niyantavyeṣu vibhūtiśabdo dṛṣṭa iti bhāvaḥ | kuta ityatrāha sarveṣāmiti | prastutaṃ tādadhīnyaṃ hretacchabdena parāmṛśyata iti bhāvaḥ | samanantaraślokenāpi tasya ślokasya tadarthaparatva darśayeti tatheti | nanvasya ślokasya vyākhyāne pūrvaṃ, "sauśīlyavātsalyasaundaryādikalyāṇaguṇagaṇayogam ityuktam 3; iha tu yogaśabdanirdiṣṭaṃ ruāṣṭṛtvādikamu cyate; tat kathaṃ dhaṭate || ittham | ubhayatrobhayamapi ādiśabdena saṃgṛhītamityekārthatvāt | ata eva hi "etāṃ vibhūtiṃ yogaṃ ca ' ityatra "heyapratyanīkakalyāṇaguṇagaṇarūpaṃ yogaṃ vibhūtiṃ ca ' ityatra tu "yābhirvibhūtibhiḥ ' iti tatpūrvapraśnavākyasthavibhūtiśabdaikāthryasvārasyānniyamanārthatoktā | ataḥ praśnottara parayorīṣadvairūpyaṃ sahram | || vistareṇātmano yogaṃ vibhūtiṃ ca ' iti pṛṣṭamarthadvayaṃ vistareṇa vaktuṃ tasyottaradvayam ahamātmeti śalo kena saṃgṛhrocyata ityabhiprāyeṇāha tatreti | etena prāgukteṣu vakṣyamāṇeṣu ca sāmānādhikaraṇya nirdeśeṣu yathāsaṃbhavaṃ nimittadvayamuktaṃ bhavati | ātmatayā'vasthita iti phalitānvayapradarśanam | anekārtho'pyātma śabdaḥ śarīrapratisaṃbandhini prasiddhiprācuryāt pratisaṃbandhirūpaṃ śarīramapekṣate; tataśca vṛtyanatargato'pi bhūta śabdo buddhayā niṣkṛṣyānvetavya ityabhiprāyeṇa sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ mama śarīrabhūtānāmityuktam | īśvarasya jīvaśarīrāṇi bhūtāni jīvāṃśca prati kathamātmatvamityatrātmalakṣaṇaṃ darśayati ātmā hīti | trayamapyekaṃ lakṣaṇamityeke | tatra śrutyādyanusāreṇa janmāditrayasya brāhṛlakṣaṇatva iva śaṅkitamātravyavacchedārthatayā trayāṇāṃ ,sāphalyaṃ bhāvyam | lakṣaṇatrayamiti cānye | tatra tvevaṃ vivekaḥ ..."yasya cetanasya yat dravyaṃ sarvātmanā svārthe niyantuṃ dhārayituṃ ca śakyam ityādi śarīralakṣaṇavāk yamapi bhāvyam | śarīralakṣaṇāntarāṇi ca tatratatra vistareṇa pratikṣiptāni | caitanyaviśiṣṭaṃ prati apṛthak siddhaviśeṣaṇabhūtadravyaṃ śarīramiti bhāṣyābhipreto'smākaṃ niṣkarṣaḥ | atra sarvabhūtaśabdena śarīramātra nirdeśaśaṅkāvyudāsāya āśayaśabdasya ca hmadayaviṣayatvavyañjanāya ādhāratvaniyantṛtvāderātmalakṣaṇatva siddhayarthe ca āha tatheti | "sarvasya cāham ' ityasyānantaraṃ "dvāvimau puruṣau ' ityu pakramya, "kṣarassarvāṇi bhūtāni ' iti vacanāt sarvabhūtaśabdo'cidviśiṣṭakṣetrajñapara iti niścīyate; tadvadatrāpi | tathā'sminneva prakaraṇe, "uttama puruṣastavanyaḥ paramātmetyudāhmataḥ ' ityuttavā " yo lokatraya māviśya bibhatryavyaya īśvaraḥ || ityuktam | atra bibhartīśvara ityārabhyām ādhāratvaniyantṛtve spaṣṭe; īśvaraśabdarūḍhā ca svāmitvasiddhiḥ; na khalu garūḍādiṣu bhujaṅgādīnniyacchatsu tadīśvaraśabdaḥ | īśvaraśabdasyāhaṃśabdasya cātrakaviṣayatvaṃ ślodvayopādānena darśitam | atra hi sarvabhūtaśabdo jīvapara eva; "yantrārūḍhāni māyayā ' ityabhidhānāt | bhrāmayannityanena niyantṛtvādisiddhiḥ | hmadeśa sthityā ca "mayi sarvamidaṃ protam ' ityādyuktadhārakatvādi sūcitam | evaṃ cidacidātamaka samasta vastuśarīratvaṃ sarvabhūtaśabdānavayenaiva vadantīṃ śrutiṃ darśayati yassarveṣu bhūteṣviti | cidaṃśaṃ prati śarīritvaṃ prapañcayat vākyamupādatte ya ātmanīti | ātmatvenāvasthānasyopādanatvanimittatvopayogāt pūrvārdhena saṃgamayan uttarārdhaṃ vyākhyāti evamiti | evamātmatayā'vasthite'hamityanena tadahamarjuna' ityantaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇya praghaṭṭakam ahamātmā iti ślokena saṅgamayannavatārayati evaṃ bhagavata iti | etena ahamātmetyā dikāḥ samastāścataruāo vibhūtayaḥ iti matāntaraṃ nirastam | vibhūtiviśeṣāniti | prādhānyata iti hrupakrā ntam | nanu śarīravācinaḥ śarīrādiśabdā nātmani paryavasyanti; tadvadatrāpi iti lakṣaṇāsvīkāra eva nyāyyaḥ, na śaktikalpanā, lādhavāccetyatrāha bhagavatīti | hiśabdo hetvarthaḥ | apṛthaksiddhaviśeṣaṇavācinaḥ śabdāstattaddvārā dharmiṃṇyapi mukhyavṛttā iti prayojakarūpeṇa guṇādiṣvapi siddhatvānna śaktikalpanāgauravamiti bhāvaḥ | tadetaduktaṃ paryavasyantīti | śarīravāciśabdānāṃ svarasatastatta dātmani paryavamānamapṛthaksiddhayupādhikaṃ darśayati yatheti | śarīrādiśabdāstu guṇa ityādiśabdavat niṣkarṣa kaśabdatvānna dharmiṇi paryavasyanti | etadabhiprāyeṇoktaṃ devo manuṣyaḥ pakṣī vṛkṣa ityādayaḥ śabdā iti | adhyāsādihetukasāmānādhikaraṇyaśaṅkāmapanayati bhagavatastattadātmatayeti | na hrupakramopasaṃhāraviruddho' rtho madhye svīkāryaḥ; na ca brāhṛṇaḥ sarvaheyamayatvaṃ bhramadvā tattavato vā'ṅkīkartuṃ yuktamiti bhāvaḥ | avinābhāvavacanāditi | ātmanā vinā hi śarīrabhūtaṃ na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | agninā vinā dhūmo nāsti, guṇinā vinā guṇā nāsti ityukte agnayādireva paramārthaḥ, dhūmādistu mithyābhūta iti vā, agnyādyātmaka iti vā pratyayo hi na bhavati; tadvadatrāpīti | nanu "yajñadattaṃ vinā'nye gṛhe na santi ', "rajjuṃ vinā sarpādikaṃ nāsti ' ityukte yathaikasyaiva sattvaṃ tadatiriktānāṃ cāsattvaṃ pratīyate, tadvadatrāpi kiṃ na syādit yatrāha avinābhāvaśceti | asaṃjāvirodhi kāla samuditopakramaviruddhatayā upasaṃhārasyanodaya ityupakramā dhikaraṇa siddhamiti bhāvaḥ | niyāmyatayetyanena dhūmāgnivyāptivaiṣamyamapi darśitam | eva metāvatā granthena, "ahamātmā guḍākeśa sarvabhūtāśayasthitaḥ ' iti sarvaśarīravartināṃ jīvānāṃ brāhṛsva rūpaikyamucyata iti kudṛṣṭimatamunmūlitam | ādityānām ādityapatyānām | ajaghanyo jaghanyajaḥ … ityādivacanānusāreṇa dvādaśo ya utkṛṣṭa ityuktam | atra ca uttareṣu ca nirdhāraṇārthaviśeṣapradarśanārtha utkṛṣṭaśabdaḥ | sa ca "purodhasāṃ mukhyam ' iti vakṣyamāṇamukhyaparyāyatayā apekṣitapradeśe sarvatra nihitaḥ | atra coddhriyamāṇānāṃ padārthānāṃ keṣāṃcitprādhānyaṃ pratyakṣam; keṣāṃcidāgamikam | kvacidavyahitaṃ kvacijjīvavyavahitaṃ ca sāmānādhikaraṇyam | jyotiśśabdena tārakāmātragrahaṇe tato bahirbhūtasya tatsaṃbandharahitasya ca ravernirdhāraṇādyayogāt prakāśakānāmiti sāmānyenoktam | jagatkāraṇabhūtaparajyotirapekṣayāraveḥ khadyotaka kalpatvāt tadvayavacchedāya jagatīti viśeṣitam | aṃśumāniti nirdhāraṇaupayikātiśayitaprakāśayogo matupā vivakṣitaḥ, anyathā paunaruktyāt | raviśabdasya dvādvādaśādityasādhāraṇatvādekavacanaṃ samudāyābhi prāyamiti pradarśanāyoktam ādityagaṇa iti | maruto vākyaḥ ekonapañcāśat ditiputrāḥ, yeṣāṃ saptakāḥ sapta gaṇā bhavanti | śaśino'pi yadi nakṣatratvaṃ syāt, tadā hi tasmāt vargāt tasya nirdhāraṇa mityabhiprāyeṇāha neyamiti | kastahrratrārtha ityatrāha nakṣatrāṇāṃ patiriti | "pradhānyataḥ ' iti hrupakrā ntamiti bhāvaḥ | nanu pūrvāpareṣu sarveṣu nirdhāraṇārtheṣu madhye kasyacit saṃbandhamātraparatvamayuktam; nakṣatraśab dena niśi prakāśamātraṃ chatrinyāyādgrāhram; "sukṛtāṃ vā etāni jyotīṃṣi yannakṣatrāṇi ' iti śruteḥ | candramaṇḍalasyāpi vā svargiṇāṃ bhogasthānatvānnakṣatratvam, "yo vā iha yajate amuṃ sa lokaṃ na kṣate | tannakṣatrāṇāṃ nakṣatratvam | devagṛhā vai nakṣatrāṇi ṭa iti -- tatrāha bhūtānāmasmi cetanetivaditi | mukhye saṃbhavati lakṣaṇā na nyāyyā | na cātra sarvatra nirdhāraṇārthatā; "bhūtānāmasmi cetanā ' ,"sargāṇāmādirantaśca madhyaṃ caivāhamarjuna ' , "vādaḥ pravadatāmaham ', "ahamaivākṣayaḥ kālaḥ ' , "udbhavaśca bhaviṣyatām ' , "dyūtaṃ chalayatāmasmi tejastetasvi nāmaham | jayo'smi vyavasāyo'smi' ityādiṣu nirdhāraṇābhāvāt | ato'tra candrasya nakṣatrajatīya tvābhāvāt ṣaṣṭhayabhihitasya saṃbandhasāmānyasya pramāṇasiddhaviśeṣe paryavasānamiti bhāvaḥ || gītirhi sāmaśabdārthaḥ; tasya vedeṣu nirdhāraṇaṃ kathamiti śaṅkāvyudāsāya sāmavedo'smīti nirdeśa iti pradarśayati ṛgayajuriti | sāmavedasyotkarṣo gītapradhānatvasaharuāśākhatvādibhiḥ; anyeṣāṃ tu tadabhāvāt tāvanmātreṇāpakarṣaḥ; na tu prāmāṇyatāratamyāt | ṛk vā idamagre sāma cāstām | saiva nāma ṛgāsīt amo nāma sāma | sā vā ṛksāmopāvadanmithunaṃ saṃbhavāva prajātyā iti | netyabrāvīt sāma jyāyānvā ato mama mahimā iti gītirūpasya sāmnaḥ prādhānyāt gītyātmakasya sāmaveda sya prādhānyam; ṛgbhyo jātaṃ vaiśyaṃ varṇamāhuḥ yajurvedaṃ kṣatriyasyā''huryonim | sāmavedo brāāhṛṇānāṃ prasūtiḥ iti ca | devā iti svargavāsino vivakṣitāḥ; brāhṛādisaṃgrahāyogāt | vāsava śabdasyendraśabdena vyākhyānamatiśayadyotanārtham; idi paramaiśvarye iti | indriyebhyaḥ parā hrarthā arthebhyaśca paraṃ manaḥ ityādiṣu manasa indriyebhyaḥ pṛthagabhidhānāt katham "indriyāṇāṃ manaścāsmi' iti nirdhāraṇamityatrāha ekādaśānāmindriyāṇāṃ yadutkṛṣṭaṃ manaindriyamiti | ayamabhiprāyaḥ -- indriyāṇi daśaikaṃ ca ityādiṣu manaso'pīndriyatvena vyapadeśāt kvātkaḥ pṛthagvyapadeśo gobalīvardanayāditi nirdhāraṇopapattiriti | na hi bhūteṣu cetanāsaṃjñakaṃ kiñcidbhūtamastītya bhiprāyeṇāha iyamapīti | ṣaṣṭhīti śeṣaḥ | "tejastejasvinām...sattvaṃ sattvavatām ' ityādivat viśiṣṭe sārabhūtaviśeṣaṇāṃśo vivakṣita ityabhiprāyeṇa cetanāvatāmityuktam | nanu bhūtānāṃ ṣaṣṭhatvena cetanāsaṃjñaṃ kimapyanyatrocyate; yathā "mahābhūtāni khaṃ vāyuragnirāpastathā mahī | ṣaṣṭhastu cetanādhāturātmā saptama ucyate| aṣṭamaṃ cu mano jñeyam ' iti; tathā "ṣaṣṭhastu cetanādhāturmana ityupadiśyate ' iti ca | atra ca manaso'dhiṣṭhānatayā cetanāyāstadapṛthagvacanamitya virodhaḥ | ato "bhūtāmāmasmi cetanā ' iti nirdhāraṇorthatvaṃ yujyata iti || maivam | na hi bhūtaṣaṣṭhanirdeśamātrānmahābhūtatvam; anyathā'pi saṃkhyāniveśasaṃbhavāt | atra ca saptamatayā aṣṭamatayā ca nirdiṣṭayormahābhūtatvānabhyupagamāt, cetanāśabdasya ca aprasiddhārthatvāt prasiddhārthasvīkārasyocitatvāt | ata saṃbandhamātravivakṣayaiva atra ṣaṣṭhī yukteti || rudrāṇāmiti rudraṣvekasya śaṅkarasaṃjñayavotkarṣadyotanā | yakṣarāsajātyoravidūra viprakarṣāt yakṣarakṣasāmityuktam; na tu vitteśasya rākṣasatvagandhaḥ | yadvā "nakṣatrāṇāmaha śaśī ' itivat jātidvayapatitvamātramiha vivakṣitam | vitteśasaṃjñayā ca dhanadasyāsādhāraṇaiśvaryotkarṣadyotanam | sthāvarāṇāṃ himālayaḥ iti parvatamātrāṇāṃ parastādvakṣyamāṇatvāt meruśśikhariṇāmityatra śikharaśabdena parvataviśeṣo vivakṣitaḥ; śaktaścāyaṃ śabdo viśeṣaṃ darśayitumityabhiprāyeṇoktaṃ śikharaśobhināṃ parvatānāmiti | praśaṃsāparaḥ pratyaya iti bhāvaḥ | praśastaratnakāñcanādimayaśikharaviśeṣayogānmeroratiśayaḥ || bṛhaspatisaṃjñayā bṛhatāṃ patirityatiśayasiddhiḥ; girāṃ patihrrasau | senānīśabdenātra karmavaśyasenāpatisaṃgrahaḥ | skandasya devasenānītvalakṣaṇo'tiśayaḥ | saraśśabdena pravāhavyatiriksthāsnu salilāśayamātrasya vivakṣitatvāt sāgarasaṃgrahaḥ; ruāotasāṃ pṛthagvakṣyamāṇatvāt || devarṣīṇāṃ , munīnām ityādervakṣyamāṇatvāt atra mahacchabdena viśeṣaṇācca maharṣīṇāmiti ṛṣigaṇaviśeṣo vivakṣita ityabhiprāyeṇa marīcyādīnāmityuktam | girāmiti na śabdamātraṃ vivakṣitam; samudraghoṣādiṣu tatprayogābhāvāt | ata eva nākṣaramātram, "akṣarāṇāmakāro'smi ' iti pṛthagvakṣyamāṇatvā cca | tata eva ekamakṣaramityapyakāravyatiriktaviṣayam | "omityekākṣaraṃ brāhṛ ' ityādiṣu praṇave'pyekāśabdaviśeṣito'kṣaraśabdaḥ prayuktaḥ -- ityabhiprāyeṇāha arthābhidhāyina iti | arthābhidhāyiṣu praṇavasyotkarṣaḥ sarvotkṛṣṭārthābhidhāyitvādinā | śaṅakunā parṇānāmiva sarvāsāṃ vācāṃ praṇavena saṃtṛṇṇatva śruteśca | yajñeṣu japayajñasya prāśastyamanyatra siddham "vidhiyajñājjapayajño viśiṣṭo daśabhirguṇaiḥ ' iti | kiṃca kuryāt ghṛtapaśuṃ saṃkhyejhrsaṅgeṭa iti, paśuyajñaiḥ kathaṃ hiṃruauḥ mādṛśo yaṣṭumarhati , hiṃsātmakaistu kiṃ tasya yajñaiḥ kāryaṃ mahātmanaḥ | prasvāpe ca prabodhe ca pūjito yena keśavaḥ || ityādivacanabalādahiṃsātmakayajñānarhāṇāṃ hiṃsātmakayajñānujñānam | tatrāpi vidhitaḥ pravṛ tteḥ apakārānabhisanadhānāt upakāraśruterdevatāprīṇinatvācca na pratyavāyaḥ | phalārthināṃ tu tatphalamalpasthi ram, duḥkhamiśraṃ ca | ahiṃsātmakāstu yajñāḥ viśiṣṭādhikārisāpekṣā bhagavato'tiprīṇanatvādapavargapratyāsa nnāḥ | ata eva hruparicarādayaḥ piṣṭapaśubhiriṣṭavantaḥ | evamitareṣu yajñeṣu hiṃsādiprasaṅgo'dhikāriviśeṣa ādinā viṣayavyavasthāpanamityādirmahān kleśaḥ; japayajñe tu tatprasaṅgābhāvāt avyāpekṣepeṇārthapratītyā sabījayogadvārā sahasā samādhau niveśanācca yajñāntarebhyo japayajñaḥ prasastatamaḥ sarvāśramasādhāraṇyāt, japyenāpi tu saṃsidhyet brāāhṛṇo nātra saṃśayaḥ | kuryādanyatra vā kuryānmaitro brāāhṛṇa ucyate iti | vidhurāderapi siddhihetutvācca | parvataviśeṣāṇāṃ pūrvamuktatvāt vṛkṣāṇāṃ vakṣyamāṇatvācca tadubhayavyavacchedārtham, himavataśśailarājatvaprasiddhayanurodhārthaṃ coktaṃ parvatamātrāṇāmiti || nanu sarvavṛkṣāṇāmityetadanupapannam, pārijātādyapekṣayā aśvatthasya nikṛṣṭatvādityatroktaṃ pūjya iti | pārijātādīnāmapyaśvatthavat pūjyatvaṃ nāstīti bhāvaḥ | devā mantradarśino devarṣayaḥ, devarṣiṣu nāradasya bahuprakāro'tiśayo bahuṣu pradeśeṣu mahābhārata eva prapañcitaḥ | citrarathaḥ gandharvarājaḥ | siddhānāmityādi | pūrvasaṃcitasukṛtaviśeṣavaśāt janmaprabhṛtisiddhāṇimādyaiśvaryāḥ siddhāḥ | "ādividvān siddha ' iti kapilaṃ iti ca śrutiḥ | dadṛśuḥ kapilaṃ tatra vāsudevaṃ sanātanam iti cāhuḥ | ayamapi paraśurāmādivat || amṛtodbhavamiti janmataḥ prakarṣasūcanam | amṛtamatra jalam, mathya mānāvasthā sudhaiva vā | gajendraśabdena diggajā vivakṣitā | teṣu pradhānatayā dikpāleśvarasya śacīpateraupavāhraḥ airāvataḥ | amṛtodbhavatvaṃ ca kākākṣinyāyādairāvate'pyanvetavyam | rathantarasāmodbhavat vaṃ vā draṣṭavyam | narādhipa śabdenaiva nirvāhakatvalakṣaṇo'tiśaya siddhaḥ | āyudhānāmityarvācīnāyudhaparam| sudarśanādyapekṣayā dadhīcerasthisaṃbhavasya vajrasyāpi nikṛṣṭatvāt | dhenūnāṃ dogdhrīṇām | divyā surabhiriti | yaugikaḥ kāmadhukśabdo'tra vyaktiviśeṣaniṣṭha iti bhāvaḥ | prajanaśabdena jananahetutvaṃ kandarpasyāsādhāra ṇo'tiśaya uktaḥ | sa madāyatta ityarthaḥ | aprajārthakandarpavyavacchedārtho vā prajanaśabdaḥ | paryāyossarpa nāga śabdayoḥ kathaṃ pṛthagvyapadeśa ityatrāha sarpā ekaśirasaḥ nāgā bahuśirasa iti | yādaśśabdena varuṇa syāpi saṃgrahārthamāha yādāṃsi jalavāsina iti | yadvā jalajantumātraṃ vivakṣitam; teṣāṃ patitvena saṃbandho varuṇasya tatsājātyābhāvādgrāhraḥ | arthamā pitṛrājaḥ | saṃyamatāṃ saṃyacchatāmityarthaḥ; tadāha daṇḍaya tāmiti || upamānamaśeṣāṇāṃ sādhūnāṃ yaḥsadā'bhavat ityādinā prahlādotkarṣaḥ | "ahamevākṣayaḥ kālaḥ ' iti nityasya kālatattvasya parastādvakṣyamāṇatvāt, yamasya ca pūrvamuktatvāt tadvyatiriktaḥ puruṣaviśeṣa iha kālaśabdena vivakṣitaḥ; acetanasya ca kālasya gaṇayitṛtvaṃ na yujyate; kalayatāmityasya vijñātṛmātraparatve teṣu kālasya nirdhāraṇamayuktam; atastaducitamarthaviśeṣaṃ darśayati anartheti | na hi maraṇātirikto'nartha iti bhāvaḥ | mṛgendraśabdenaiva siṃhasyātiśayassiddhaḥ | pakṣiṣu vainate yasya vegātiśayāt vedamayatvādinā cotkarṣaḥ || pavatāmityanena pavanāsādhāraṇakriyā vivakṣitā cet, nirdhāraṇaṃ nopapadyeteti tadupapattaye gamanasvabhāvānāmityuktam | ajaruāgamanaśīlānāmityarthaḥ | pavanapreritā eva hi tārakādayo'pyajaruāṃ pari bhramanti | somapavanādiṣvavātra śodhanānvayigamanamihāvivakṣitam | rāmaśśastrabhṛtāmahamitipara śurāmasyāpi jetā rāvaṇahantā rāmo vivakṣita iti taducitam amoghaśastratvalakṣaṇamatiśayamāha śastrabhṛttva matra vibhūtiriti | pūrvottareṣviva rāma eva vibhūtiḥ kiṃ na syādityatrāha arthāntarābhāvāditi | acidvi śeṣasya cetanāntarasya vā śastrabhṛcchabdavācyasyātrāsaṃbhavādityarthaḥ | arthāntarāṇāṃ madhye svāsādhāraṇadharmaviśeṣanirdeśe rītibhaṅgaḥ syādityatrāha ādityādayaśceti | śastrabhṛttvasyānyeṣāṃ ca bhagavantaṃ dharmiṇaṃ prati dharmatvamaviśiṣṭamityekaiva rītiḥ; nirdhāraṇānirdhāraṇabhedavat mukhabhedamātraṃ na doṣa iti bhāvaḥ | tatra "ādityaśabdena ' jyotiṣāṃ raviraṃśumān ityukto ravirvivakṣitaḥ | "ādityānāmahaṃ viṣṇuḥ ityuktastvādityo rāmatulyaḥ | makaro matsyarājaḥ | ruāotastu jāhnavyāḥ viṣṇupadodbhavatvasarvajña śirodhṛtatvatrailokyapravṛttavādibhiratiśayaḥ || sargaśabdena sṛṣṭimātravivakṣāyām ādirantaścetyādinā'nvayāyogāt karmārtho'tra sargaśabda ityāha sṛjyanta iti sargā iti | ādimadhyāntaśabdānāmatrāvayavaviśeṣādyarthatā na yuktā, anatiśayitārthatvāt | nāpi kālaviśeṣārthatā, kālasya vakṣyamāṇatvenātra pṛthagvyapadeśaprayojanābhāvāt | na cotpattyādikriyā mātrārthatā, "udbhavaśca bhaviṣyatām ' iti vakṣyamāṇena paunaruktyaprasaṅgāt | na ceśvarasyaiva kāraṇatvādikamihocyate, "ahamādiśca madhyaṃ ca ' ityukrameṇa kṛtakaratvāt | na cedaṃ sāmānyatasta nnigamanam, uparyupari vacanāt | | tasmāt lokasiddhotpattyādihetuparatvamevocitaṃ lakṣaṇayā | tatrāpyupādānakāraṇasya "bījaṃ māṃ sarvabhūtānām ' ityuktatvācca nimittakāraṇamātramiha vivakṣitam | sargāṇāmityaviśeṣavacanena sarvadeśakālavartisṛjyapratiyogikasarvanimittakāraṇavargasya svādhīnatvabhipretam| tadedakhilabhisaṃhitaṃ sarvadetyādivākyatrayeṇa | adhyātmavidyā jīvaparamātmayāthātmya vidyā | sā viṣayataḥ phalataśca vidyāntarebhya utkṛṣṭā | pravadatāmiti nānyonyavivādamātraṃ vivakṣitam; tatra vādākhyaviśeṣasyāsmaraṇāt | adhyātmavidyā vidyānāmiti vidyā prasaṅgāt tadarthakathāviṣayatvopapatteḥ | na ca "sattvaṃ sattvavatāma ' itivat vādākhyakathāviśeṣavattmabhipretam; anyā pekṣayā'tiśayasūcanasaṃbhave tatparityāgāyogāt | ataḥ pravadatāmiti kathātrayasādhāraṇarūpamiha vivakṣitam; tadāha jalpavitaṇḍādi kurvatāmiti | tatvanirṇayāya pravṛtta ityanena svalpaphalavijigīṣukathāto'tiśayi tāpavargaparyavasiphalatvena vādayotkarṣapradarśanam || baddūvṛcopaniṣadi śrūyate, a iti brāhṛeti | tathā "akāro vai sarvā vāk; saiṣā sparśo ṣmabhivryajyamānā bahvī nānārūpā bhavati ' iti śrutyaiva prapañcitaṃ prakṛtitvamāha sarvavarṇānāṃ prakṛtiriti | nirdhāraṇauyikabahutvasiddhayarthe pratyayārthaṃ darśayati sāmāsikassamāsasamūha iti | " pūrvottarānyapadārtha pradhānebhyo'vyayībhāvatatpuruṣabahuvrīhibhyo dvandvasyotkarṣamāha sa hrubhayeti | ākṣayaśabdena "kalā muhūrtāḥ kāṣṭhāśca ' iti śrutismṛtyādisiddhabahuvidhavikārarupa lokakṣayahetubhūtānantāvacchede satyapi svarūpato'nanādyantatvaṃ vivakṣitamityabhiprāyeṇāha kaleti | anādir bhagavān kolo nānto'sya dvija vidyate ' , "kālo'smi lokakṣayakṛt pravṛttonānto na cādi rna me'sti madhyam '...ityādibhiridaṃ kālādhiṣṭhātṛtvaṃ vyaktam | dhātṛśabdarūḍhā viśvatomukhatvaviśeṣaṇena ca hiraṇyagarbha evātrocyata ityabhiprāyeṇāha sarvasyeti | dhātṛśabdenaivāṇḍāntavartisamastavidhātṛtvalakṣaṇa utkarṣaḥ siddha iti pradarśanāya sarvasya saṣṭetyuktam | etena karmaphalavivātṛtvena vyākhyāntaraṃ nirastam | viśvataḥ iti dikcatuṣṭayamātramiha vivakṣitamiti jñāpanāyoktaṃ caturmukha iti | vedacatuṣṭayapravartanādikaṃ cānena sūcitam || karmāṇurūpadaṇḍa -- kālāvacchedādhikṛtayoryamakālākhyapuruṣayoruktatvāt yamādeśakāriprāṇādhikṛtapuruṣa viśeṣa iha mṛtyussarvaharaḥ ityucyata iti jñāpanāya sarvaprāṇahara ityuktam | pralaye sarvasaṃharteśvara iha mṛtyuriti kaiściduktaṃ mandam, "bhūtānāmanta eva ca ' ityuktatvāt | udbhavasahapāṭhādatra mṛtyuśabdo maraṇa para iti kecit | udbhavaśabdaḥ svarasata utpattikriyāparaḥ; udbhavasthānādikaṃ cātra pṛthageva nirdiṣṭa miti kriyāparatvamevocitamityabhiprāyeṇa udbhavākhyaṃ karmetyuktam | kītryādayo neha guṇaviśeṣā vivakṣitāḥ teṣāṃ puruṣeṣvapi ca udbhūtatvena nīrīṇāmiti viśeṣajhrṇaṭayogāt | na ca nārī śabdo'tra rutrīliṅga padārthamātraparaḥ, mukhyabādhābhāvāt | ato nārīviśeṣanirdhāraṇameva kriyate | tatra ca śriya eva ityabhiprāyeṇa śrīrahaṃ kīrtiścāhamityuktam | etāśca bhagavadasādhāraṇaśaktayaḥ | anyatra tu tattadabhimāna viśeṣāt tattacchabdaḥ || sāmasu bṛhatsāmna utkṛṣṭatvaṃ śrutyaiva siddham, "bṛhacca vā idamagre rathantaraṃ ca āstāṃ vākca vai tanmanaścāstāṃ vāgvai rathantaraṃ mano bṛhat | tadbṛhatpūrvaṃ sasṛjānaṃ rathantaramatyamanyata tadrathantaraṃ garbhamadhatta' iti | gāyatryāśchandasāṃ mātṛtvenotkarṣaḥ śrutiṣu chandovicityāṃ ca prapañcitaḥ | yathā bahuvṛcopaniṣad, agraṃ vai chandasāṃ gāyatrī iti | māseṣu mārgaśīrṣasyātiśayaḥ varṣagarbhādhānakālatvāt māsādhideveṣu keśavādiṣu prathamasya keśavasya māsatvāt vrata vargārambhakālatvācca | kusumākara
