aloluptavam alolupatva miti| 'lūñ chedane' iti dhātau lolū iti yaṅlugantam| tatrta "tve ca"iti cchāndasaṃ hrasvamabhipretyāha alolutvamiti vā pāṭha iti| ayogyasyapṛhārūpaṃ laulyamiha niṣidhyata niṣidhyata ityabhiprāyeṇāha viṣayeṣviti| mukhvayasya mārdasyātrtānanvayāt pūrvabhāṣitva -- mukhasaumyatvādivyaṅgyamaupacārikaṃ darśiyitumāha akāṭhinya miti| kaṭhitaṃ hi dravyamanyeṣāmanupraveśānarham; tadvadiha stabdhaprakṛtiriti tadyatirekavivakṣayā phalato mārdavaṃ vyanakti sādhujaneti| avamatatvādīnāṃ yogopakārakatvāt tanmūlā vrīḍā sattvaniṣṭhānāmayuktā; ata upayuktaṃ hrīviśeṣamāha akāryakaraṇe vrīḍeti| prakhyātābhijanavidyāvṛttā hi mahāntaḥ pareṣvapyakāryakāriṣvapatrapante; svayaṃ tu kimuteti bhāvaḥ| alolupatvācāpalatvayorapaunaruktyāyāha spṛhaṇīyaviṣayasannidhāvi ti| etena krīḍāparihāsamṛgayākṣādiṣvaprasaṅgo'pi darśitaḥ| bhūtetaraviṣayastejaśśabdaḥ parābhibhavanasāmathrye anyānapekṣatāyāṃ vā prayujyate| ato'trtābhibhāvakatvāvinābhūtamanabhimanīyatvaṃ vivakṣitam| tañca durjanāvakāśapradāyikārpaṇyābhāvadvāretyābhiprāyeṇāha durjanairiti| akrodhāt kṣamāyāḥ viśeṣaṃ darśiyati paranimittapīḍānubhave'pī ti| niraparādheṣu nirvikāratā hraudāsīnyamātrtam; na tu kṣamā; paṭhate ca niraparādheṣvapi krodhaḥ, "brāāhṛṇā gaṇikā vaidyāḥ sārameyāśca kuktuṭāḥ| ddaṣṭamātrteṇa kupyanti na jāne tatrta kāraṇam"itītyabhiprāyaḥ| pareṣu taṃ pratī ti| pareṣāṃ pīḍānubhavaṃ pratītyarthaḥ| bhayacāpalanivṛtteḥ pṛthaguktatvādupasthitāyāmapi mahatyāmāpadi śāruāīyānuṣṭhānasaṃkalpasya apracyutāvalambanamiha sāttvikī dhṛtirityabhiprāyeṇāha mahatyā miti| mahatyāpadi saṃprāpte smartavyo bhagavat hariḥ" iti sukaramukhyakartavyā parityāgāditaradapi kartavyaṃ kṛtameva hi syāditi bhāvaḥ| vakṣyati ca sāttvikīṃ dhṛtim, dhṛtyā yayā dhārayate manaḥ prāṇendriyakriyāḥ| yogenāvyabhicāriṇyā dhṛtiḥ sā pārtha sāttvikīṃ" iti| yogenāvyabhicāriṇyā mokṣasādhanabhūtabhagavadupāsanākhyaprayojanena prayojanāntanirapekṣayetyarthaḥ| śarīravāṅyanāṃsi hraśucipuruṣaspaśarśāśucidravyopayogādibhirupahatasattvāni teṣu teṣu karmakhayogyāni śāruauḥ śiṣyante; tadabhāve'trta śautamityāha bāhreti| pratyakṣasiddhakaraṇapāṭavādirūpakṛtyogyatāvyavacchedāyāha śāruāīyeti | ahiṃsāyā uktatvādadrohasya tato viśeṣapradarśināyāha pareṣvanuparodha iti| prabalena hi durbalāḥ svavaśe sthāpitāḥ svācchandyānnivāryante, so'yamuparodhaḥ tadakaraṇamatrtānuparodha ityāha svacchande ti| svasya tu yogopakārī svacchandavṛttinirodhastapa eva; ataḥ pareṣvi ti viśeṣitam| māno garva iti paryāyaḥ sa tu sāmānyata iha niṣeddhamiṣṭaḥ tathā'pi vaṃśavīryaśrutādyanuguṇaṃ mātrtayā bhavannasau sahretāpi; anyathābhavan asurāṇāṃ dharmatayā vakṣyamāṇo'trta na prasaṅgamarhatītyābhiprāyeṇa sopasargamānaniṣedha ityāha asthāne garva iti| daivīṃ saṃpada mityukte devānāṃ vibhūtiḥ pratīyeta; sā cātrta nānveti| ato'bhipretamavatārayituṃ vyutpatiṃ tāvadāha devasaṃbandhinī ti "sattvaṃ devaguṇaṃ vidyāditarāvāsurau guṇau " iti vibhāgāt, 'sattvat saṃjāyate jñānam' iti bhagavadājñānuvṛtteḥ prītiviṣayatvāt, paramapuruṣārthahetutvāñcetyāha sā ce ti| uktaṃ ca, "mahātmānastu māṃ pārtha daivīṃ prakṛtimāśritāḥ| bhajantyananyamanaso jñātvā bhūtādimavyayam" iti| jātasye tyakarmakasya jāyateḥ paratyādiṣvivopasargavaśātsakarmakatvāt karmaṇi dvitīyānvayamāha tāmabhimukhīkṛtye ti| "abhirabhāge" iti karmapravacanīyayogādvā dvitīyā| abhimukhīkṛtya abhilakṣyaḥ yathā daivī saṃpadbhavati, tathā kṛtvā jātasyeti yāvat |īdṛśaguṇayuktānāmevaṃvidhāyāḥ saṃpado'vaśyambhāvitvamatra abhimukhīkaraṇaṃ vivakṣitam|tathā ca smaryate,"jāyamānaṃ hi puruṣaṃ yaṃ paśyenmadhusūdhanaḥ|sātvikaḥ sa tu vijñeyaḥ sa vai mokṣārthacincakaḥ" iti| tadidamāha tāṃnirvartayituṃ jātasye ti||2-3|| dambho darpaḥ ityādau bhavantī tyanuṣajyate | dhārmikatvakhyāpanāyeti |na tu bhagavadājñānuvṛttibuddhayetyarthaḥ| kṛtyākṛtyāvivekakara iti| śāruāātilaṅdhanaheturiti bhāvaḥ| atimāna śabdoktagarvāparaparyāt tatkāraṇasya darpasya viśeṣamāha viṣayānubhavanimitta iti| etenaācāryabhagavatsandarśanādinimittaharṣavyavacchedaḥ| asthā iti pūrvoktamatrta svavidāyabhijānānanuguṇa ityanena vivṛtam| vidyābhijana grahaṇaṃ vīyaryāderapyupalakṣaṇam| "vayasa karmaṇo'rthasya śrutasyābhijanasya ca| veṣavāgvṛtisārūpyamācaran vicarediha" itthasyollaṅghanamihābhipretam| bāhrakuddaṣṭipu ca vākpāruṣyaṃ daṇḍāruṣyaṃ ca nātīva doṣa ityabhiprāyeṇāha sādhūtāmudvegakarassvabhāva iti| ata eva sādhubahiṣkārāt śāruābahiṣkāro'pi syādevetyarthaḥ| prāptakālanidrādirūpamanupayuktavapiṣayaṃ cājñānamāsurāṇāmanyeṣāmapi tulyam; adoṣaśca| tavdyavacchinatti parāvareti| īddaśājñānamūlamāgamāntareṣu parāvaratattvavyatyayakalpanaṃ vedaviruddhācāraparigrahaśca| pūrvoktakatipayaguṇavyatirekapradarśanamihopalakṣaṇārtham| cākareṇa vā'nuktasamastasamuccayaḥ āsurīṃ saṃpabadamabhivyaṅktumāha bhagavadājñātivṛttiśīlā iti| yān prati ucyate ca, "paśyatyenaṃ jāyamānaṃ brāhṛā rūpadro'thavā punaḥ| rajasā tamasā caiva iti ca| prajāpativākye ca dehātmābhimānādimūlatrivarganiṣṭhāmadhikṛtyocyate, "asurāṇāṃ hreṣopaniṣat" iti| atra saṃpacchabdo bhagavadājñātiliṅghanarucīnāmabhiprāyeṇa, upālambhābhiprāyeṇa, saṃpadyata ityetāvanmātravivakṣayā vā netavyaḥ||4|| daivāsurasvabhāvayoḥ śraddhodvegajananāya, "ūdhvaṃ gacchanti sattvasthāḥ" ityādinā uktamiha saṃkṣipya smāryate daivī saṃpadi tyardhena| vimokṣasyeṣṭaprāptiparyantatāṃ vaktumātyantikāniṣṭanivṛttirūpaṃ śabdasya mukhyārthamāha bandhānmuktaya iti| ātmasākṣātkārodidvāreti vā| nibandhaḥ niyato bandhaḥ| tatra adhogacchantī tyetat smārayati adhogatīti||4|| atra mā śucaḥ iti vacanaṃ na śāruāopakramaprakāntośocyaśokapratiṣedhārtham, tasya bahudhā parahmatatvāt| saṃpadaṃ daivī mabhijāto'sītyanena tatparihārasaṃbhavācca| ato nibandhāyāsurī mate tyukte śāruāīyamaryādānatilaṅghinyapi svātmani, "sthiro nigūḍhāhaṅkāraḥ" iti prakiyayā dhīrodāttanāyakaguṇabhūtasya nigūḍhasvāhaṅkāratvasya svātmasākṣikatvāt tāvanmātreṇāpi svasmin āsuratvamatiśaṅkamānasya śrutadvividhasaṃpatkasya bībhatsoḥ svaprakṛtitvajñāpanena śokamapanayatītyāha etacchatve ti| atrāpyasthāne śokaṃ tvamevāhārayasītyabhiprāyeṇāha śokaṃ mā kṛthā iti| na hi devaprakṛtīnāṃ dharmottarāṇāmāsurāḥ putrāḥ saṃbhavantītyabhiprāyeṇa pāṇḍava śabdasaṃbuddhirityāha dharmikāgresarasye ti||5|| svarūpādibhiḥ sameṣu sarveṣvātmasu daivāsuravibhāgasya kiṃ nidānamiti śaṅkāṃ saviśeṣānuvāde pariharan atyantaparihartavyatvajñāpanāya prasaktasyāsuravṛttāntasya vivakṣitamupakṣipati dvo bhūtasargā viti ślokena| asmin loke iti na lokāntaravyavacchedārtham, sarvatrta devasuravibhāgasiddheḥ| na ca nirarthakādhikaraṇamātrtanirdeśo yuktaḥ| ato lokopalambhasiddhākāreṇa vihitaniṣiddhakaraṇasūcanamiha vivakṣitamityābhiprāyeṇāha karmakārāṇā miti| karmalokavivakṣayā vā asminniti viśeṣaṇam| "sargaḥ svabhāvanirmekṣaniścayādhyāyasṛṣṭiṣu"iti bahrarthasyābhipreptaṃ vaktumihārthavaśāt dhātoḥ prayojyavyāpāraparatvaṃ tāvadāha sarga utpattiriti| utpattisvarūpe kathaṃ daivatvāsuratvavibhaṅāga iti śaṅkāyāṃ loke'sminni tyanena daivāsuravibhāge sargaśabdena cābhipretaṃ saṃkalathyāha prācīneti | daivāsurasaṃpadarthatvādutrapattau daivāsuratvoktirityarthaḥ| sarga śabdasya svabhāvaparatvaṃ sṛjyamānaparatvaṃ cāprasiddhatvādanāddatya prasiddhasṛṣṭiparatvena vyākhyānam| daivassargo vistaraśaḥ prokta ityukte devānāṃ sargādikaṃ vaṃśānucaritakīrtanavat pratīyate; na ca tathā kṛtam| yadyapi, "prajahāti yāda kāmān", 'daivamevāpare yajñam' ityādibhijrñānayogakarmayogabhakitiyoganiṣṭhāḥ puruṣā nirdiṣṭāḥ -- tathā'pi tatkartavyaprapañcana eva tatrtāpi tātparyam| ato'trta daivasargasya vistareṇoktistatkāryadvāretyabhiprāyeṇa yadācārakaraṇārthe tyādikamuktam| 'abhayaṃ sattvasaṃśuddhiḥ' ityādikaṃ prāk vistareṇoktasya saṃgrahaṇamityabhiprāyeṇa karmayogādigrahaṇam| āsuraṃ sarga mityatrtāpi vakṣyamaṇānusārādevameva vivakṣetyāha asurāṇā miti| āsuraṃ sargaṃ me śṛṇvityukte sargānvayena kartariṣaṣṭhīpratītiḥ syāt; tato'pi śṛṇvityasyāpekṣitamāptatamatavasūcanamevocitamityabhiprāyeṇāha mama sakāśādi ti| aviditamupādeyaṃ yathā nopādātuṃ śakyat, tathā heyamapyaviditaṃ na hātuṃ śakyam; ato'trta sāvadhāno bhavetyabhiprāyeṇa śṛṇvityuktam||6|| atrta pravṛttinivṛtti śabdau na laukikaviṣayau; āsurāṇāmeva laukikeṣṭāniṣṭaprāptiparihārārthamapathapravṛtte sstpathanivṛtteśca siddhatvāt| na ca vihitaniṣiddhamātrtaviṣayau, rāgaprāptāśāruāprāptaviṣayau vā, na śaucaṃ nāpi cācāraḥ iti punaruktiprasaṅgāt| ato'trta mumukṣvapekṣitapravartakavivartakanivartakadharmavivekā bhāve tātparyamityāha amyudayasādhanami tyādinā| tāvetau dharmau smaryete, "pravṛttilakṣaṇaṃ dharmaṃ prajāpatirathābrāvīt| nivṛttilakṣaṇaṃ dharmamṛṣirnārāyaṇo'brāvīt" iti| na vidurityatrta 'na satyaṃ teṣu vadyate' itivadasadbhāvamātrtaṃ na vivakṣitam, apitu śatakṛtvaḥ pratipādite'pi tamaḥ prācuryāt aparijñānamityabhiprāyeṇāha na jānantīti| kṛtyayogyateti pāguktamatrta vaidikakarmayogyotvāmi tyanena vivṛtam| bāhraśaucamaśuśīlanādibhiravaśyakartavyākaraṇāñca na vadyate; āntaraṃ tvātmaguṇābhāvat| na śaucaṃ nāpi cācāraḥ iti kramāt kāryakāraṇayorniṣedha ityabhiprāyeṇaha taditi| nanu saṃdhyāvandanādervarṇāśramadharmasya "prājāpatyaṃ gṛhasthānām" ityadibhiḥ phalāntaraṃ śrūyate; tat kathaṃ tasya śaucahetutvoktirityāha yathokta mimi| vyatirekoktyā hetuhetumadbhāve'trta ddaḍhīkṛtaḥ| idaṃ nityakarmāntarahānādāvapi grāhram| yathājñāna mityādi| vipralambharasikatvāt yathājñānaṃ bhāṣaṇabāvaḥ, hiṃsāsvabhāvatvāt hitarūpabhāṣaṇābhāvaḥ||7|| evaṃ na satyasyabhāṣaṇamātrtam, apitu tadviparītabhāṣaṇamastītyamanantaramujyata ityāha kiṃce ti| asatyaśabdoṣa'trta na mithyātvaparaḥ,tasya lokopalabdhisvavacanavirodhādibhireva pratikṣiptatvena ātisthūlatvāt, paramārthaṃ sthiraṃ cauścaryamabhimatya nirūḍhābhiniveśānāmasurāṇāṃ prapañcamithyātvakūṭayuktimiḥ pratāryatvāsaṃbhavāñca| "yathā vayamanṛtaprāyāḥ, tathā sarvaṃ jagaditi prāhuḥ" iti vyākhyā'pi mandā jagacchabdasya cetanamātrtaviṣayatvābhāvāt, niṣedhānāṃ cātrta pūrvoktākākhyatirekaparatvāt, apratiṣṭhamanīśvaram itivat śāruāsiddhapratiṣedhaparatvāt, asurāṇāṃ ca śāruāpradveṣaśīlatt| ato'trta śāruā siddhasya pratiṣedhaparo|yaṃ śabdaḥ| tañca satyaṃ brāhṛaiveti, "satyaṃ jñānamanantaṃ brāhṛ" ityādiṣu prasiddham| chāndogye ca cetanācetāniyanatṛtvena brāhṛnāmtayā'sau niruktaḥ, "tasya ha vā etasya brāhṛṇonāma satyamiti|tāni ha vā etāni trīṇyakṣarāni sat,ti,yamiti|tadhyat sat tadamṛtam|aharaharvā evaṃvit svargaṃ lokameti" iti|atotra kapilagurukumārilajinasugatacārvākādi matānuvartina iva abrāāhṛātmakaṃ jagadāhuriti vivakṣāmāha satyaśabdeti | apratiṣṭa śabdenāpi sarvalokavirodhādibhiḥ pratyakṣasiddhapratiṣṭāniṣedhāṃsaṃbhavāt śāstreṣu pratiṣṭhātvena upatiṣṭasarvapratiṣedhavivakṣāmāha tatheti |tadevodāharaṇaviśeṣeṇa vivṛṇoti brāāhṛṇā'nanteneti| etena pratiṣṭāśabdasya dharmādharmamātraparatvena vyākhyā nirastā| sarvāṃllokān bibhartīti |svarūpataḥkāryatasceti bhāvaḥ|ādikūrmaśeṣadiṅnāgaprabhṛtibhirhī vidhṛteti śāstreṇokte hi haitukairevaṃ jalpyate,"dhartā dharitryā yadi kaṣcidanyaratasya parastato'nyaḥ|evaṃ kecidicchanti|gurutvānnityapatanaṃ ca jaināḥ| anīśvara śabdo'pyatra na pratimārājādilaukikakeśvarapratiṣedhārthaḥ,taistatpratṣedhābhāvāt |yathā'nuvadanti,"lokavvahārasiddha iti cārvākāḥ " iti | na ca brāhṛniṣedhamātrāthaḥ asatyami tyādinā punaruktaiḥ|ato'tra vyutpatyanusāreṇālaukikaniyantṛniṣedhe tātparyamityāha satyasaṃkalpenetyādinā | ayaskāntādivat acitsvabhāvāt, "jīvājīvātmakaṃ sarvaṃ jagadetannirīśvaram"iti jainādiddaṣṭā dharmādimātrtavasādvā, "parameśvarasaṃjño'jñakimanyo mathyavasthite" itivat ābhimānikeśvaraśāsanādvā, deśakālāvacchinneśvarasamudāyapravāhavaśādvā jagatpravṛttirinapi parameśvaratvena kalpayanti, te āsurā eveti bhāvaḥ| anye'pi kecidīśvarāḥ pravartakā ddaśyante; śrūyante ca; tat kathaṃ bhagavatassarvaniyamanamityātrtāha ahaṃ sarvasyeti| anyeṣāmapi niyantṝṇāṃ niyamanarūpapravṛtirbhagavadadhīnaiva| tathā ca sūtrtitam, "kartā śāruāārthatvāt" ityupakramya, "parāttu tacchuteḥ" iti| evaṃ tribhiḥ jagata utpattisthiti pravṛttīnāṃ parabrāhrādhīnatvaṃ necchantī tyuktaṃ bhavati| tatrta jagadutpatteḥ pratijñātaṃ brāhṛnairapekṣyamanyatasmiddha tayaivamupapādayantītyāha vadanti caivamiti| aparasparetyādikaṃ na pūrveṇaikavākyam, kimanya dityāderananbayāt| kliṣṭapanādanupatteśva| "etadebaiṣāmāsuratve paryāptam; kiṃmanyaducyata"iti kalpanā adhyāhārādigrastā| vadanti caiva miti tu nādhyāhārādivivakṣayoktam, etāṃ ddaṣṭi mityanenaiva tatsiddheḥ| ataḥ kāmahetuka mityasyaivopapādanāya aparasparasaṃbhūta mityādyuktirityabhiprāyeṇāha yoṣiditi| "kriyāsāntatyena hetaphalabhāvarahitam"iti vyākhyāntaramatimandam; prasiddhatamārthatyāgāt, kāmahetuka mityananvayāñcetyābhiprāyeṇāha anevaṃbhūtaṃ kimanyadupalamyata iti| yadyapi yoṣitpuruṣasaṃsargamantareṇaiva svedajānāṃ sthāvarāṇāṃ cotpattidrdaśyate tathā'pīśvaramātrtahetukā devādisṛṣṭirnopalabhyate| ddaśyamānaṃ tu ayonijaṃ yonijavadeva darśanabalādaṅgīkurmaḥ tatrtāpyanvayatirekāvasthitatattatsāmagrīmātrāt kāryasiddhisaṃbhave kimīśvareṇa katrrtā kalpitana, āgamikatayā svīkṛtena veti bhāvaḥ| akiñcitkāmahetukam iti paroktapāṭhāntarasya aprasiddhatvādibhiranādaravyaktyarthaṃ kimanyaditi pāṭhasya pratiniṣedhaparatāṃ vyanakti kiṃcidapi nopalabhyata iti| ata iti| anvayavyatirekabalādityarthaḥ| kāmahetuka miti ddaṣṭākāraṇopalakṣaṇam| kāmaprāvaṇyavaśāt taduktiḥ| yathā pāṣaṇḍāgamā api tattapuruṣapravartitāntādayaḥ evaṃ kalpekalpe pravṛtamīśvaraśilpino jagannagaravṛtāntaṃ saṃbhāvitamapi tīvrauṣadhakalpaśāruāpradveṣādalapantītyuktaṃ bhavati|| etāṃ ddaṣṭi miti| viparītāṃ ddaṣṭimityarthaḥ| avaṣṭabhye tyākramaṇādipratītivyudāsāyāha avalambye ti| nityāsyātmano vināśābhāvāt 'ṇaśa adarśane' iti dhātvartho'trta vivakṣita ityāha addaṣṭeti| svayaṃjyotiṣaḥ pratyagātmasvarūpasya dehādhyāsādhiṣṭhānātāya nityamupalambhāt dehātiriktatvena viśoṣitam| naṣṭātmatvaheturihālpabuddhitvamucyata iti punaruktiparihārābhiprāyeṇāha dhaṭādivaditi| yadvā paśumṛgādivat karmavaśāt svārasiko viviktātmānupalambhaḥ| alpabuddhayāḥ iti tu tatparihārāśaktirucyata iti bhāvaḥ|evaṃ parāvārātmaviṣayaviparītaddaṣṭiruktā atha prabhavantayugramarmāṇaḥ ityādinā tatphalamucyate| ugrakarmāṇaḥ ityatrogravratādipratītivyudāsāyāha sarveṣāṃ hiṃsakā iti| aśubhāḥsvaṃsargirṇāpi doṣāvahā ityarthaḥ| jagataḥkṣayāya prabhavantīti, "anena prasaviṣyadhvameṣa vo'stviṣṭakādhuk","parasparaṃ bhāvayantaḥ śreyaḥparamavāpsyatha"ityādipratipādītāṃ bhagavanmūlāṃ lokabhāvanadharmamaryādāmatilaṅghayanti; tadanuvartinaścānye'pi mandāḥ tadācāropadeśādiviruāmbhādikrameṇa sarvasya jagatariuāvargāpavargarūpavṛddhivirahiṇaḥ trtividhatāpābhihatirūpāya kṣayāya bhavantītyarthaḥ||9|| kāmo hi jagaddheturuktaḥ ataḥ sa eva hi teṣāmāśrayaṇīyo'bhimataḥ tadāśrayaṇetikartavyatārūpāstu dambhamānādayo'śucivrataparyantā ityucyate kāma miti ślokena| duṣprāpaviṣayatvaṃ duṣpūratve hetuḥ yadvā viṣayaprāptirhi kāmasya pūraṇam ato duṣprāpaviṣayatvameva duṣpūratvam| āśritya prayojanatayā'bhisaṃdhāyetyarthaḥ| tadabhiprāyeṇāha tatsisādhayiṣaye ti| viparītapravṛttihetubhūtaṃ kṛtyākṛtyāvivekāndhatvamiha moha śabdena vivakṣitamityāha ājñānāditi| asat grahaṇam ārjanaṃ yoṣāṃ te'trta asadgrāhāḥ| dharmābhisaṃdhimanto hi nyāyenārjayanti kāmapravaṇāstu cauryādibhiṃstadupakaraṇānītyāha anyāyagṛhītaparigra hāniti| parigraśabdo'trta parigrāhraparaḥ| "īhante kāmabhogārthamanyāyenārthasaṃcayān" iti tvetasyaiva vivaraṇam| ata eva aśubhābhiniveśāniti vyākhyā'pyatrta mandā| gṛhītve ti tādātvikaviniyogaparatvāt ātmīyatvābhimānaparatvādvā punaruktiparihāraḥ| pāṣaṇḍāgamādnirdiṣṭāni hi vratāni puruṣasya darśanasparśanādyayogyatāhetutvāt svayamaśucīnyevetyabhiprāyeṇāha aśāruāvihitavratayuktā iti| dharmābhisaṃdhirahitānāmapi tāmasānāṃ viṣaharaṇapāṣāṇasphoṭadityastambhanapratimājalpādivañcanopāyaivarvaśīkṛtānāṃ vedabāhreṣu vrateṣu mātrtāyā saṃyogo bhavati| yadvā śauryāhaṃkārādimūlaḥ śāruāviruddhaḥ saṅkalpo'trta vrataśabdābhipretaḥ śāruāīyeṣvapi vrateṣu bhagavatsamārādhanavivakṣāmajānatām ayathāśāruākaraṇādaśāruāvihitaprayuktatvam| dambhamānau prāgeva vyākhyatau| mado'tra dhanābhijanavidyādimūlamayathāyathaceṣṭitārambhakamauddhatyam||10|| evaṃ pravartakānāmuparyupari manovikārādaya ucyante cintāmaparimeyā mityādibhiḥ| aśakyaviṣayavṛthāprāyāsavyañjanāyāha adya śvo ve ti| aparimaneyā miti asaṃkhyeyaviṣayatvenānantaśākhatvaṃ vivakṣitamityāha ataparicchedyā miti| pralayāntāmityatrta śarīrapātāvadhikatboktirmandā| anantakālasādhyamalpakālena sisādhayiṣantīti tu vyāmohātiśayakhyāpanena saprayojanamidam pralayaśabdaśva prasiddhatama viṣaya ucitaḥ| cintayitṝṇāṃ puruṣāṇāmāpralayasthāyitvābhāvāt cintāyāḥ svarūpeṇa pralayāntatvaṃ cāyuktamityabhiprāyeṇāha prākṛtapralayāvadhikālasādhyaviṣayamā miti| asaṃkhyeyeṣu cintāviṣayeṣvekaiko'pi dussādha iti bhāvaḥ| prayojanatāya'bhimateṣu kāmopabhoga eva paramo yeṣāṃ te'trta kāmopabhogaparamāḥ tadāha kāmāpabhoga eveti| svargāpavargapratiṣedhārtha etāva cchabda ityāha ito'dhika iti| saṃjātaniścayā iti atra niścitaśabde 'bhuktā brāhṛṇāḥ' itivat kartari kta iti bhāvaḥ|| cintā kartavyaviṣayā āśā tu phalaviṣayā āśāviṣayāṇamasaṃkhyātatvāt tadāśānāmapi śataśāsvatvena tathātvam| kāmakrodhaparāyaṇāḥ ityatra krodhasya paramaprāpyatayā tadabhimānaviṣayatvābhāvāt kāmakrodhayo raikāgryyāmātrtaṃ vivakṣimityāha kāmakodhaikaniṣṭhā iti| ayanaśabde'trta āśrayaparaḥ kāmo hi vahanyamānaḥ krodhātmanā pariṇamatīti prākprapañcitasmāraṇe tātparyāt na punaruktiḥ| kāmabhogārtha miti| vivayānubhāvaryam| paramaniśśreyasasādhanapūtaparamapuruṣasamārādhanārthaṃ yatkartavyaṃ, hanta tat anarthāvahātikṣudrakṣaṇikasukhābhāsārthamāsīditi bhāvaḥ| anyāyeneti | na hi yajñādivat nyāyārjitaiḥ kāmopabhogo niṣpayam tatrta īhayā niṣpādayantīti vivakṣitvāt arthasañcayāniti dvitīyānvayaḥ||11|| evaṃ "saharuābhagasaṃdarśanātmaśca mahānandalakṣaṇo mokṣaḥ"ityādibhiḥ kāmopabhogaḥ paramapuruṣārtha iti kṛtvā tadarthamarthapuruṣārthasvīkāra ityuktam atha tatrta pravṛttasya, vyatirekasaṃjñāsaṃsthāvasthitayogivat labdhālabdhakṛtākṛtapratyavekṣaṇamucdyotanāya idamadyetyādinā| etena pūrvektacintāviṣayānantyāmapyudāhrataṃ bhavati| vakṣyamāṇadhanavyātiriktaviṣayatvadyotanāya putrtakṣetrādiśabdaḥ| sāttvikānāmīśvarādyadhīnakṛtākṛtapratyevekṣaṇāvyavacchedāya ahaṅkāragarmatayā'pi tathāvidhānusandhānasya bhrāntirūpatvaṃ mayetyanena sūcyata ityāha matsāmathryenaiveti| evakārābhipretaṃ vivṛṇoti nāddaṣṭādineti| evamevottamapuruṣākṛṣṭāhaṃśabdavyākhyānaparūpe ahamevetyādāpyabhiprāyaḥ| idamastīdamapīti, cintāyāṃ viṣayabhūyastatvajñāpanam||13|| evamiṣṭiprāptau abhiprāya uktaḥ athāniṣṭanivṛttāvucyate asau maye ti| atrta mayetyādeḥ śatrtuhananoyuktaguṇavattasimānagarmatāmāha balavate ti| śūraḥ vyāghrādivat parabalaṃ tṛṇīkṛtya nirbhayapraveśaśīlaḥ, "śūraṃ bhīruṃ kaviṃ jaḍam" iti śūrasya bhīrupratiyogikatvena pāṭhāt| vīro'trta parākrame glānyādivikārarahitaḥ| prekṣāvadanantapuruṣapravṛttiviṣayāddaṣṭānādareṇa svasāmathryabhātrtāvalambane ko heturityātrtāha kima treti| mandadhībhiriti|ayamabhiprāyaḥ -- arthādigrahaṇalubdhaiḥ nigūḍhābhiprāyaigrrenthaiḥ prātāritā dānayajñādiṣu pravṛttāssiddhamapyarthaṃ parityajya kṛpaṇā bhavanti iti| durbalai riti| prabalo hi na prātārayituṃ śakyate, 'na bhedāsādhyā baladarpitā janāḥ' iti nyāyāditi bhāvaḥ| parikalpiteneti | natu lokāyataśāruā vivakṣitapratyakṣānvayavyatirekarūpapramāṇasiddhenetyarthaḥ||13|| evamiṣṭiprāptyaniṣṭaparihārayossvasāmathryamātrtādhīnatvabhrama uktaḥ ataḥ atha svasāmathryādāvapibhāvo'pyatrta īśvaraśabdena vivakṣita ityāha svādhīno'ha miti| svavyatiriktasamastaniyantṛtvābhimāno'pyatrtābhipreta ityāha anyeṣāṃ ce ti| "tavāṃsakūṭe bhūmaṇḍalm, tvaṃ hi sarveṣāṃ niyantā"ityukte tathāvidhatvābhidhānādeva hi tathāvidhānāṃ prītyādisaṃbhava iti bhāvaḥ| pūrvāparānuguṇyāt bhogīti bhogasāmathryaparam; tatrtāhaṃ cet na dharmasvabhāvādevaṃbhūta ityahaṃśabdābhiprāyamāha svata eve ti| siddhaḥ jñānādyatiśayasaṃpanna ityarthaḥ| siddhasamīhita iti vā| sukhīti| putrtajanmādisukhayogītyarthaḥ| bhogīsukhi śabdayo rhetuphalavivakṣayā vā paunaruktyaparihāraḥ| eṣāmīśvaratvādīnāmabhijanāntānāṃ bhuktaśiṣṭa karmamūlatvaṃ prāgeva śrutasmṛtibhirūpapāditam||14|| asmilloke iti| lokāntaraṃ tu nāstīti hi tadabhiprāyaḥ yadvā astiśabdābhipretasārvakālikasamaniṣedhavivakṣayā asmilloke iti nirdeśaḥ| yāvallokamanveṣaṇe'pīti bhāvaḥ| prakṛtairevākāraire kaikaśo'pi saddaśaḥ pratiṣidhyata svasāmathrye ti| mayā saddaśaḥ ka ityetāvati vaktavye, avyaśabdaḥ anyatvamevāsāmathrye heturiti dyotanārthaḥ| yadvā, matto'na mayā saddaśo nāsti ahameva mayā saddaśa iti, "rāmarāvaṇayoriva" itivat bhāvyam| yakṣyedāsyamītyetat sātvikaviḍambanamātrtaviśrāntena dambhenaiva| dambhenāvidhipūrvaka miti hranantaraṃ viśeṣyate| modiṣya iti na svārgādivivakṣayā; apitu yajamānatvādinimittamahacchabdādilābhena| yakṣye ityādipratipattāvapi prākaraṇikīmahaṅkāropahatiṃ darśayati īśvarīnugrahanirapekṣeṇe ti| ityajñānabimohitā ityeva paryāptam; manyanta iti tu vaiśadyārthamuktam||15|| īśvare nyastābharā hi prāyaśo niśvitāḥ, tadyatirekamāha svenaiva sarva miti| iti kṛtvā iti matvetyarthaḥ| cintārūpavṛttiktaṃ mana eva citam; tatpravṛttibhedādanekatvoktiḥ tata darśayati evaṃ kuryā mityādinā| vibhrāntāḥ vikṣiptā ityarthaḥ | dvā vibhrānti viparītajñānam moha stvajñānam| athavā "anyathā cintitaṃ kāryaṃ devena kṛtamanyathā"iti nyāyāt cintānāmeva bhrāntiparūpatvamāha evaṃrūpeṇe ti| "na jātu kāmaḥ kāmānāmupabhogena śāmyati| haviṣā kṛṣṇāvatrmeva bhūya evābhivardhate" ityayamartha upasargeṇa dyotyata ityāha prakarṣeṇa saktā iti| "idaṃ kṛtamidaṃ kāryamidamanyat kṛtākṛtam| evamīhāsamāyuktaṃ kṛtāntaḥ kurute vaśe" ityaktamāha madhye mṛtā iti| asucau kāmabhoge prasaktānāṃ tathāvidhameva phalamityābhiprāyeṇa narakasyāśucitvaviśeṣaṇam| pūyarudhiravasādimayatvaṃ cāśuci tvam||16|| ātmasaṃbhāvitāḥ ityatra parasaṃbhāvanāprasaṅgarahitatayā abbhakṣaḥ itivat avadhāraṇagarbhatāmāha ātmanaiva saṃbhāvitā iti| ātmapraśaṃsādirūpadoṣavyaktyarthamāha ātmanaivātmāna miti| paraissaṃbhāvitā api hi santo lajjakate| staśabdhatāhetuḥ paripūrṇamananayamānā iti| na kiṃcitkurbāṇā iti tu śabdārthaḥ| kiṃcit guruvandanādikamapītyarthaḥ| dhanādiddaṣṭasaṃpattimadena addaṣṭavaikalyatiraskāra iti vaktuṃ pāralaukikāpravṛttihetuṃ śaṅkate katha miti| 'vidyāmado dhanamadastṛtīyo'bhijano madaḥ' iti sanniyogaśiṣṭatvāt dhanasyātrtokteśva tatsamabhivyāhrato madaheturmāno vidyābhijananibandhana ityāha vidyābhijanābhimānena ce ti| nāmasaṃbandhino yajñā nāmayajñāḥ saṃbandhaśvātrta dharmādiprayojanābhisandhivyudāsāyā phalaphalibhāvenetyabhiprāyeṇāha nāmaprayojanai riti| kītryādiṣvapi nāmaśabdaprayogāt tadabhisaṃdheśva dambhene tyādinā siddheḥ saṃjñāyāṃ prasiddhiprakarṣāt apahāsārthatvaucityāñca yaṣṭotināmamātraprayojanairi tyaktam| ata eva 'yajñasamākhyāmātrtam; na tu vastuto'sau yajñaḥ' iti vyākhyā'pi mandā pradarśitā ? avidhipūrvakatvoktyaiva tadarthasiddheśca| dambhena hetune tyabhisaṃdhiviśeṣasya hetutvoktiḥ| yaṣṭatvakhyāpanāye ti tu viṣayataḥ prayojanataśca tadvivaraṇam| vidhiratrta vidhāyakaṃ vākyam| tadukta prākaraparityago'trtavidhipūrvakatvamityāha ayathācodana miti||17|| punaruktyādiparihārāyānantaraślokasya sāttvikayajanetikartavyatārūpaguṇavaiparītyaparatvamāha teceddagbhūtā yajanta iti| krameṇa dāmbhikayajñetikartavyatākramaṃ vivṛṇoti ananyāpekṣa ityādibhiḥ| bhagavaneva sarvaṃ kārayatītyasya pratikṣepo'haṃkāraḥ, yatparihārāya smaryate, "yadyahaṃkāramāśritya yajñadānatapaḥ kriyāḥ| kurvaṃstatphalamāpnoti punarāvartanaṃ tu tat||" iti| balavattvamātrasyādoṣatve'pi bhagavato balene tyasya viparītaṃ svabalaparyāptyanusaṃdhānam| tadubhayamūlo darpaḥ sarvāvajñānahetuḥ pūjyapūjāpratisphardhīṃ bhagavatprasādadeveṣṭaprāptyaniṣṭaparihārāvityasya viparītau kāmakrodhāviti| saṃśritāḥ samyagāśritāḥ, nirapekṣahetutvenābhimanyamānā ityarthaḥ| atrta paradeheṣvi ti yajñānukūlapratikūlaṝÏtvaktaskarādivivakṣayā| saptamyā sthitissiddhā| sā ca pravartanādyarthamiti śrutyādibhiḥ prākprapañcitam; tatpratipattiviruddhaṃ smārayati sarvasya kārayitāra miti| hitaprartanamevāsūyāheturiti bhāvaḥ| puruṣottama miti| yadvailakṣaṇyavijñānamātrtāt kṛtakṛtyo bhavatītyuktam, sa hi mahopakārī dveṣāsūyāspadameṣāmiti bhāvaḥ| sarvapravartanādiguṇa kathanaṃ guṇeṣu doṣāviṣkaraṇarūpārūpāsūyālakṣaṇavyakatyartham| puruṣottamaprakaraṇe hi smṛtyādipravartanāya, "sarvasya cāhaṃ hradi sanniviṣṭaḥ" ityuktam tadevātrta māmātmaparadeheṣvityanena smāryata iti ca bhāvaḥ| ' pradviṣanto'myasūyakāḥ ' ityanayoḥ prātilomyena hetukāryatayā'nvayakramaṃ yajantaityanukarṣaṇena vākyasamāÏpta cāha kuyuktibhi riti| īśvaraparatantrtatve kathaṃ karmavaśyatā phalānāṃ karmamūlatve ca kimīśvareṇetyādayaḥ kuyuktayaḥ| anasūyālakṣaṇavyājenāsūyāmapi bṛhaspatiralakṣayat -- na guṇān guṇino hanti stauti mandaguṇānapi| nānyadoṣeṣu ramate sā'nasūyā prakīrtitā|| iti| asahiṣṇutvarūpeṇa lakṣaṇena dveṣaṃ vivṛṇoti māmasahamānā iti| asahamānatvaṃ ca tadājñātilaṅghanaparyantamanusaṃdheyam| etañca svasaṃśyānāmapyaśucinarakapatane nidānam yathocyate, "majjanti pitarastasya narake śāśvatīssamāḥ| dviṣyāt yo vibudhaśreṣṭhaṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ harim" iti| evaṃ "ye dviṣanti mahātmānaṃ na smasanti ca keśavam| na teṣāṃ puṇyatīrtheṣu gatiḥ saṃsargiṇāmapi||" ityādi cātrtānusaṃdheyam| nāmayajñairityasyopalakṣaṇatāmāha yāgādikaṃ sarva miti||28|| evaṃvidhapradveṣādipūrvakayāgāderapi yathocitapratikūlaphalaprado'hamevetyucyate tānahamityādiślokadvayena| vaiṣamyanairdhṛṇyaparihārārthaḥ tāni tyanuvāda ityabhiprāyeṇāha ya evaṃ māṃ dviṣantī ti| atrta caturbhirviśeṣaṇaiḥ 'na māṃ duṣkṛtinaḥ ityādinoktāścaturvidhā duṣkṛtina eva vivakṣitā iti tadyākhyānamidam| tathā hi narādhamaśabdastāvat sa eva| 'āsuraṃ bhāvamāśritāḥ' ityetattu dviṣanta ityetatsamānārthatayā prāgeva vyākhyātam| evaṃ ktūrāśumaśabdāvapi yathāyogaṃ mūḍhādiśabdasamānārthaunetavyau iti| atrtātyantāvibhāgena yojanaṃ cāsurarāśyaikyāt| janmādicakraparivṛttiṣvavicchinnatayaikākāreṇa saraṇāt saṃsāraḥ saṃtānaḥ| saṃsarati puruṣo'sminniti adhikaraṇārthadhañanto'trta saṃsāraśabdaḥ| tahbahutvoktiścakraparivṛttyānantyādityāha janmajare tyādinā| saṃsāra śabdasya sadasajjanmāsādhāraṇatvādviśeṣyata ityāha tatrāpī ti| "etaddhi durlabhataraṃ janma jadīddaśam" idyādyuktasātvikajanmaviśeṣavyavacchedāya tāmasatvam āsurīṣvevetyucyata ityāha madānukūlapratyanīke ṣviti| īddaśaṃ pratikūlajanma devādicaturvidhayoniṣvapi draṣṭavyam iti| "eṣa evāsādhu karma kārayati taṃ yamadho ninīṣati " ityādiśrutyanusāreṇa kṣipāmītyuktasya dvāramāha tattaditi| pāpapravṛti hetubhūtakrarabuddhayādiprādanamapi prācīpradveṣādiphalabhūtatvāt neśvarasya vaiṣamnairdhṛṇyāpādakam||19|| uttarottaramapakarṣaparamparocyate āsurīmiti ślokena| mūḍha śabdataḥ phalitamāha madviparītajñānā iti| yadvā viparītajñānamevātrta mohaḥ, sa ca vākyārthanuguṇyāt svaviṣayo viśeṣitaḥ| sattvottarāṇāmapi parabrāhṛprāpteranekajmasaṃsiddhisādhyatayā tāmaseṣu tatprasaṅgapratiṣedhayoranaucityāt prāpteḥ prathamaparvabhūtaśāruājanyajñānaprāptirihāśāruāvaśyeṣvāsureṣu pratikṣipyate| tatra śāruājanyajñānatvavyaktayarthamāha asti bhagavā niti| adhamatvasyottamāvadhisāpekṣatvādavadhisamaparṇasamarthatayā sannihitaḥ tataśśa bdo na hetupara ucita ityabhiprāyeṇāha tataḥ tato janmana iti||20|| avaśyapariharaṇīyaṃ saṃkṣipyocyata ityabhiprāyeṇānantaragranthaṃ saṃgamayati asye ti| yathāvasthitasyātmano'prāptireva hrātmānaḥ sa cāsurasvabhāva evetyabhiprāyeṇāha āsurasvabhāvasyātmanāśasye ti| mūlacchedāt sarvo'pyāsurasvabhāvaschinna evetyabhiprāyeṇāha mūlahetu miti| āsurasvabhāvarūpasya narakasye ti| etasmādadhikaṃ kimanyannarakamiti bhāvaḥ| āsurasvabhāvaparihārārthaṃ hi tanmūlo'yamupadeśa iti vā, tamodvārairi tyanantaraikāthryaṃ vā vivakṣitam| ātmano nāśanava miti| "asanneva sa bhavati" ityādikrameṇeti bhāvaḥ| praveśaheturhi dvāram; tenāpi prāptimātrahetutvamiha vivakṣitamityabhiprāyeṇopacārāvalambanakramamāha mārgo heturityarthaṃ iti| dvāraṃ nāśanam | praveśanneva naśyatīti bhāvaḥ| tyājyasya doṣoktistyāgavidhyupakāriketyabhiprāyeṇāha tasmā diti| rauravādirnarakaḥ pāpakṣayahetuḥ āsusvabhāvastvasau pāpārjanahetutvādatidhora ityabhiprāyeṇāha dūrataḥ parityaje diti||21|| tyājyasya doṣoktyā tyogo vihitaḥ, tyāgasyaivedānīṃ phalapravāha ucyate etai riti ślokena| madviparītajñānahetubhi riti tamaḥ phaloktiḥ, tama śabdo vā'trta tatparyantalakṣakaḥ, tamodvārairvimuktatvāt tamasā'pi vimucyate; śreyaścaraṇaṃ ca tattvajñānapūrvakamityabhiprāyeṇāha labdhamadviṣayajñāna iti| śreya ācaratī tyanena prāguktabhagavatpradveṣādinivṛttirvivakṣitā| śreyaḥ praśastam tañca saṃgrahām bhagavadāmanukūlayam tadanupraveśāt sarvasya śāruāīyasyetyabhiprāyeṇāha madānukūlya iti| tataḥ śreyaścaraṇādeva hetorityarthaḥ| māmaprāpyaivetyādiparāmarśādiha paragatiśabdanirdiṣṭaḥ prāpyaparyavasānabhūmiḥ paramapuruṣa ityāha māmeva parāṃ gati miti|| āsurasvabhāveṣu mūlatayā pradhānabhūtāstraya uktāḥ; tebhyo' pradhānatamaḥ parihārtho heturanantaramucyata ityāha śāruāānādara iti| sarvāvasthasamastapuruṣahitānuśāsamānāt śāruāśabdo vedeṣveva prathamaṃ prāptaḥ, tadanubandhādananyeṣvityabhiprāyeṇāha śāruāṃ vedā iti| vidhāyakavākyasya śāruāpratipakṣabhūtaḥ kāmakāro'tra na śāruāśabdenopāttatvāt tadyāpāro'trta vidhiśabdavivakṣita ityāha vidhiranuśāsana miti| phalitamāha vedākhyaṃ madanuśāsana miti| śāruāmeva vidhiriti sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ vā vivakṣitam| madanuśāsana mityanena 'śrutiḥ -- smṛtirmamaivājñā' ityādismāraṇam| etenānyathā liṅādyarthaṃ varṇayanto'pi pratyuktaḥ| liṅādayo hi praśāsiturabhiprāyamākṣepādabhidhānato vā vyañcayanti| śāruāpratipakṣabhūtaḥ kāmakāro'tra na śāruāīyavaikalpikādiviṣaya ityabhiprāyeṇāha svacchandānuguṇamārgeṇeti| "atha kena prayukto'yaṃ " ityādyuktadākāmaprayuktetyuktaṃ bhavati| "yā vedabāhrāḥ"smṛtayo yāśca kāśca kuddaṣṭayaḥ| sarvāstā niṣphalāḥ pretya tamoniṣṭhā hi tāḥ smṛtāḥ||" ityādyanusandhānenāha na kāmapyāmuṣmikīṃ siddhi miti| āmuṣmikasukhahetubhūtāmupāyasiddhimityarthaḥ| na sukhaṃ -- na khargādisukhamityarthaḥ| yadvā āmuṣmikīṃ siddhimiti svargādiphalaviṣayam; susva miti tvaihikaparam| ata eva hi kiñcicchabdaḥ| ihāpi hi sukhaṃ śāruāīyānuṣṭhānajanitaparama puruṣānugrahādeva| ata eva hucyate "anārādhitagevindā ye narā duḥsvabhāgīnaḥ" iti| kaimutyapradarśanāyātrtānyasukhasamabhivyāhāra ityāha kutaḥ parāṃ gati miti||23|| adhyāyoktaṃ sarvametadarthamityābhiprāyeṇānuśiṣyate tasmācachāruā miti| atrta kāryākārya śabdayorutpādyānutyasayāsaṅgamabhipretyāha upādeyānupādeyavyavasthāyā miti| anuṣṭhānaviryayasasya tattvātattvayoḥ pradarśanārthāvityabhiprāyeṇopādeyādisādhāraṇaśabdaḥ| upādanamatrta yathāśāruāṃ manasāsvīkaraṇam| śāsruāmevetyayuktam, "śrutiḥ smṛtissadācāraḥ" ityādivirodhādityatrtāha dharmaśāruoti | ādiśabdenācchedāya jñātvetyādikamucyata ityāha yadeveti| sarvāṇi hi śāruāāṇi sākṣādvā paramparavā vā paramapuruṣasamārādhanatayaiva sarvaṇi karmāṇi vidadhiti; tatrta tattvahitayoḥ, "vedaiśca sarvairahameva vedyaḥ" ityuktaṃ paratattvaṃ prāguktasamākhyayā smārayati puruṣottamākhyamiti| tatprāptyupāyabhūtaṃ ce ti| sarveṣāṃ hi phalasaṅgādityagenānuṣṭhitānāṃ parabrāhṛpraptyupāyatvameva svabhāva iti bhāvaḥ| atrta avabodhayantī tyanenājñāpanarūpavanidhānaśabdārthe vivṛtaḥ| ayathāśāruāṃ karmaṇāṃ karaṇaṃ ca na kartavyamityabhiprāyeṇa kartumarhasītyuktam| tasmādapyanuṣṭhānatattvadhyavāsāyasādhāraṇyamāha upādātu miti| arhasītyetadanusārī madhye tvamiti nirdeśaḥ tasya daivīṃ saṃpadamabhijātasya yogyatvāti -- śayadyotanāya| etaduktaṃ bhavati sattvottareṇa ||atha aṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ||18|| kartavyaviśodhanapradhāne antime'dhyāyatrtike'syādhyāsya paścādbhāvitvajñāpanāya ṣoḍaśasaptadaśayordevāsuravibhāgoktyādimukhena heyopādeyavibhajanaparatāyā praghaṭṭakaikyamabhipretyāha atīteneti| vaidikasya karmaṇassāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ praṇavānvayaḥ, tatra mokṣābhyudayasādhanayormedastatsacchabdanirdeśyatveneti vibhajamānasyāyamabhiprāyaḥ -- viśeṣaṇādisāmathryalabdho'yaṃ vibhāgaḥ| 'bahṛṇaḥ pārokṣyāt ta diti nirdeśaḥ| tajjñāne tu sanmārgatvavivakṣayā sa cchabdaḥ| kramādete sātvikarājasatāmasāḥ"iti vibhāgastu kasyacidutprekṣākalpitaḥ iti|| evamukteṣvapyartheṣu mokṣasādhanabhūtāṃśasvarūpaśodhanamuttarādhyāyena kriyata iti saṅgatyabhiprāyeṇāha anantara miti| "īśvare kartṛtābuddhiḥ sattvopādeyatā'ntibhe| svakarmapariṇāmaśca śāstrasārārtha ucyate" iti saṃgraha śloke tyāgasaṃnyāsaikyatatsvarūpānuktirīśvare kartṛtābuddheśśeṣatayā tadupanyāsāditimantavyam|satvopādeyatvamatra tātparyavṛtyā'bhādhīyata ityabhiprāyeṇāha sattvarajastamasāṃ kāryavarṇanene ti| 'svadharmajñānavairāgyāsādhyabhaktyekagocaraḥ' iti saṃgrahārambhoktapradhānakartavyaparo'trta śāruāsārārthaśabda ityabhiprāyeṇāha sārārtho bhaktiyoga iti|svargādisādhanānāṃ yajñadānādīnāṃ svarupāviśeṣe'pi yadhyogānmokṣasādhanatvaṃ,tadviśeṣamidānīṃ śodhayitumarjunaḥ pṛcchatītyabhiprāyena prakṛte praśnaṃ saṅgamayati tatratāvaditi| satvavivṛdhditadupāyādikathanaṃ tyāgādiviśiṣṭamokṣasādhanakarmārthatayā|saṃnyāsaśabdasyāśramaviśeṣādirūḍaḍheḥ tyāgamātre'pi śakteśca pṛthaktvaikatvaśaṅkā|vādivipratipatyādibhissvarūpaviśeṣāniścayaḥ| tyāgasaṃnyāsayorviśeṣatastattvabubhutsāhetumāha tyāgasaṃnyāsau hīti| karmasvarūpe svargāpavargādi sādhāraṇe tyāgādisaṃjñakaviśeṣaṇayogādeva hrapavargasādhanatvam| ataḥ prāptāprāptavivekena viśeṣaṇe tatsādhanatvavyapadeśaḥ| saṃśayaviparyayopamadīṃ viśeṣa iha tattvaśabdena vivakṣita ityāha yāthātmyamiti| pṛthaktvaṃ veditumicchāmītyukte niścitapṛthaktvasya tattatsvarūpajijñāsā pratīyo; na ca tat yuktam pūrvatra pṛthaktvaniścayahetvabhāvāt uttaratrta caikatvasyaiva vakṣyamāṇatvāt| ato'yaṃ praśno'nupapannaḥ prativacanāsaṅgatiścetyātrtāha ayamabhiprāya iti| tattvaṃ veditumicchamītyetadeva vivakṣitam pṛthaktvanirdeśastu saṃśayakoṭanyataropakṣepamātrtaparaḥ| pṛthaktvamasti cet tadveditumicchāmīti vā vākyāvṛtirityabhiprāyeṇāha kimiti||1|| pṛthaktvaikatvatatsvarūpajijñāsayā praśnaścet, tatrta kasminnaṃśe kāmyānāmityādimatabhedopanyāsasya saṅgatirityāha atheti| ayamabhiprāyaḥ -- nyāyato hratrta nirṇayaḥ pratipādyate; saṃdigdhe ca nyāyāvatāraḥ sandehaścātrta vādivipratipattinibandha iti nyāyaviṣayaviśodhanāya vipratipatattyupanyāsaḥ iti| etena kathitārthayorapi saṃnyāsatyāgaśabdayorvipratipattiśamanāya asminnadhyāye punaḥ praśna ityapi sūcitam| ekatvasvīkāreṇa prativacanāt pṛthaktvapratikṣepo'rthasiddha ityabhiprāyeṇāha ekameva svarūpamiti| svamatasya 'niścayaṃ śṛṇu' iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt kavayaḥ, vicakṣaṇāḥ iti padadvayaṃ nārthaprāśastyārthavaktūgauravaparam api tu vipratipattyupayuktavedanamātrtaparamityabhiprāyeṇāha kecanetyuktam| kāmyānāṃ karmaṇāṃ nyāsa miti viśeṣaṇāditareṣāmaparityāgaḥ pratīyate uttaratrta ca sarvakarmaphalatyāga miti viśeṣaṇādatrta kāmyasvarūpatyāgaścetyabhiprāyeṇāha svarūpatyāga miti| kāmyasvarūpatyāgaṃ vadatāmayamabhiprāyaḥ -- na tāvat nityanaimittikavat akaraṇe pratyavāyāt karmāntarānarhatāpattibhayādvā kāmyamanuṣṭhīyate| na ca trtivargasādhanāya tasyāpavargapratyanīkatvāt| na ca tadeva karma apavargasyāpi svayaṃ sādhanam; upāsanādinairarthakya prasaṅgāt| na ca viniyogapṛthaktvena vidyāṅgatayā tatparigrahaḥ yajñādiśruternityanaimitikamātrtaviṣayatve'pi virodhābhāvāt| ata eva hi,"sarvāpekṣā ca yajñāgiśruteraśvavat" ityadhikaraṇamāśramadharmasāpekṣatāparaṃ bhāṣyate| tasmāt svargādisaṃjñanarakahetavaḥ kāmyāḥ kriyā mumukṣubhirnānuṣṭheyāḥ iti| sarvakarmaphalakatyāga miti vadatāṃ tvayamāśayaḥ -- phalavirodhādviḥ tyāgaḥ śaṅkyate| ataḥ phalameva tyajyatām| na ca niṣphalānuṣṭhānaprasaṅgaḥ, nityanaimittikavadeva bhagavatprītimātnā sarvakarmaphalakatyāga miti vadatāṃ tvayamāśayaḥ -- phalavirodhādvi kāmyānāṃ tyāgaḥ śaṅkyate| ataḥ phalameva tyajyatām| na ca niṣphalānuṣṭhānaprasaṅgaḥ; nityanaimittikavadeva bhagavatprītimātnārthatayā tadanuṣaṭhānopapatteḥ| na caivaṃ na vidhiḥ; "yo vā etadakṣaraṃ gāmryaviditvā'Ïsmalloke juhoti yajate tapastapyate bahūni varṣasahastrāvyantavadevāsya tadbhavati" ityādinā'kṣaraśabdanirdiṣṭaparamapuruṣavedanābhyāmeva tasyaiva karmaṇo nityānityaphalasādhanatvaśruteḥ| ato nityanaimittikānāmiva kāmyānāmapi na svarūpatyāgaḥ iti| vivādasya bhinnaviṣayatvāyogādatrta tyāgasaṃnyāsaśabdayorekārthatvāvaśyambhāvāt pṛthagarthatvaśaṅkāparihāro'rthalabdha ityāha tatreti| etena, saṃnyāsatyāgaśa bdayoḥ pṛthagarthatvamaṅgīkṛtya kasyacit kāmyasvarūpa prahāṇaviṣayatayākasyacitu nityanaimittikaphalopekṣārthatāṃ ca vadantaḥ pratyuktāḥ| na hṛtrta kāmyetarakarmaṃphalatyāgamityucyate| tataśca saṃkocakābhāvāt trtividhamapi karma saṃgṛhrati sarvakarmeti| tadidamuktam nityānāṃ naimittikānāṃ kāmyānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ karmaṇā miti| nityānāmapi , 'prājāpatyaṃ gṛhasthānām' ityādinā phalasaṃyogo'vagataḥ|| atrta śloke tyāgasaṃnyāsaśabdayorarthabhedavyatpādanaparatāṃ nirasitumaikāthrye praspaṣṭaṃ hetudvamāha tatheti| na hrarthadvayavivaye'trta vimarśe anyatarasyaiva niścaya upapanna ityabhiprāyeṇoktam tyāgaśabdenai veti| parasparaparyāyatādarśanāñceti | ayamabhiprāyaḥ -- 'niyatasya tu saṃnyāsaḥ karmaṇo nopapadyate' iti niṣiddha eva hi saṃnyāsaḥ karmaṇā 'mohāt tasya parityāgaḥ' iti tyāgaśabdenānūdya tāmasatvena nindyate; anthā jaradgavādivākyāt parasparānvayaprasaṅgāt| evaṃ 'bhavatyagināṃ pretya ityukte' evārthaḥ 'na tu saṃnyāsināṃ kavacit' iti vyatirekenaṇa ddaḍhīkriyate| na ca tadanyāvidhiranyābhāvasya vyatirekaḥ| ata imau śabdāvatrtāpyekārthāviti| aṅgīkṛtamiti| prativaktatrtā bhagavateti śeṣaḥ||2|| kāmyānā miti ślokena phalavirodhatadabhāvadvārā virodho darśitaḥ| atha tyājyaṃ doṣavat iti ślokena svarūpato doṣayogatadabhāvāmyāṃ pratyavāyakara tvādiṃmukhena vivādaḥ pradaśryate| vaidhahiṃsa'pi kāpilairniṣiddhatvena doṣatayāṅgīkriyate| yathoktarmāśvarakṛṣṇena, "ddaṣṭavadānuśravikaḥ sa hraviśuddhikṣayātiśayayuktaḥ" iti| uktaṃ ca pañcaśikhācāryaiḥ, "syāt svaphalssaṃkarassupariharassapratyavamarṣaḥ"iti| ataḥ 'vaidhahiṃsā puruṣasya doṣamāvakṣyati, kratoścopakariṣyati' iti tanmatam| ataḥ eke iti śabdena sāmānyato nirdiṣṭā vādinaḥ doṣavaditi hetvanvayādisāmathryāt doṣākhyaddaṣṭāntoktibalādvā viśeṣato vyañnta ityāha kāpilā vaidikāśca tanmatānusāriṇa iti| etena sarvakarmasvarūpasaṃnyāsavādināṃ matamapi vedabāhratvena darśitam| rāgādidoṣava diti| ragādayodoṣā bandhākā iti sarvasaidvāntikasaṃmatatvāt tadudāharaṇam; yadvā karmaiva rāgādidoṣavat; ata eva bandhakamityabhiprāyaḥ| asyāṃ yojanāyāmādiśabdo hiṃsādikamapi saṃgṛhṇati| sarvaṃ yajñādikaṃ karme ti karmaśabdo'trta sāmānyaviṣayo'pi yajñadānatapaḥ karma na tyājyamiti pakṣāntare viśeṣamāt śāruācoditaviṣayaḥ tatrta ca viśeṣākābhāvāt kāmyaviṣayatve paunaruktyāñca sarvaviṣaya iti bhāvaḥ| sarvaistyājyatve tadvidhāyakasya śāruāsyāprāmāṇyaprasaṅgāt mumukṣuṇe ti viśeṣitam| aparaśa bdo'trta svamatānusāriviṣayaḥ| yajñadānatapaḥ karma na tyājyaṃ kāryameva taditi hi svamataṃ vakṣyata ityabhiprāyeṇāha paṇḍitā iti| tyājyopādeyavibhāgatattvavida ityarthaḥ||3|| tatrtetiśabdaḥ prakṛte vipratipattiviṣayatānuvādamukhena nyāyapravṛttiṣayasaṃdigdhatādyotaka ityabhiprāyeṇāha evaṃ vādivipratipanna iti| me niśca mitayanena matāntaretthānaśaṅkāvyudāsāyāha tyāgaviṣayaṃ niścayaṃ mattaśśṛṇviti| mattaḥ bhramādidoṣarahitādityarthaḥ| tyāgo hītyā dikaṃ na vakṣyaṇāṇa sāttvikādityāgatrtaividhyaviṣayam; kiṃ tu sāttavikatyāgāvāntarabhedaviṣayam, saṃprakīrtitaḥ ityasya prāguktatatparatvasvārasyāt, hiśabdena śrotṛsaṃpratipattyādipratīteścetyabhiprāyeṇāha tyāgaḥ kriyamāṇeṣvevetyā di| mayī sarvāṇī tyeta eva ślokariuāvidhatyāgapara iti atrta niṣphānuṣṭhānasvarūpatyāgaṃ, sāṅkhyataśaṅkāṃ ca pratikṣeptum, trtayāṇāṃ svarūpaṃ vivinakti karmajanya mityādinā| madīyaphalasādhanataye tyādi| svakīyaprītisādhanatayā svārthameva bhagavān pravartayatīti hi mumukṣoranusaṃdhānamiti bhāvaḥ| svakartṛtvasya tādadhīnyatadanumatisāpekṣatvādibhissarveśvare kartṛtvānusaṃdhānam| kartṛtvatyāgastu anekakartṛke paraprayuktasvātmakartṛktavānusandhānamityuttarasatrta viśodhayiṣyate||4|| evaṃ trtividhatyāgānuvādasya svarūpatyāgavyavacchedārthatocyate yajñadāne tyādinā| vividiṣādyutpatteḥ prākyajñādikamanuṣṭheyam, paścātu parityājyamityākhyātīti kecit; tanmatavyudāsāyāha na kadācidapīti| 'sa khalvevaṃ vartayam yāvadāyuṣam' iti śrutyabhiprāyeṇāha api tvāprayāṇāditi| tathāca sūtrtam 'āprayāṇāt tatrtāpi hi ddaṣṭam' iti| aharahariti coditakālopalakṣaṇam| nanu vidyāniṣṭhasya kimarthaṃ karma ? na tāvadārādupakāritvena; samuñcayādipakṣānabhyupagamāt| nāpi tattvajñānārtham saparikarāt pramāṇādeva tatsiddheḥ| na ca tadanusmaraṇarūpopāsānārtham tasyāpi saṃskārapāṭavādisādhyatvāt na cānyat kiñcit karmaṃsādhyaṃ mumukṣvapekṣitaṃ prayojanaṃ paśyāmaḥ na ca prayojanamanuddiśya mandasyāpi pravṛttirityabhiprāyeṇa kuta ityākāṅkṣāpradarśanam| cakāro'nuktasamuñcayārtha ityabhiprāyeṇa prabhṛti śabdaḥ| varṇāśramasaṃbandhī nīti| nityanaimittikānāmapi svarūpatyāga iti yaḥ pakṣaḥ, sa iha pratikṣipyata iti bhāvaḥ| yajñādīnāṃ sannipatyopakāradyotanāyopakartavyajñānasvarūpaparo'tra manīṣiśabda ityabhiprāyeṇāha mananaśīlānā miti| manasa īṣiṇo manīṣiṇa iti vyutpatau phalitoktiriyam| śravaṇānantarabhāviyauktikabhananavyavacchedāyāha mananamupāsanamiti| pāvanāni manīṣiṇa miti samabhivyāhārasiddhamupakāraprakāraṃ vyanakti mumukṣūṇāmityādinā| 'prāyaṇāntamokāramabhidhyāyīta' iti pakramya 'yaḥ punaretaṃ trtimātrteṇomityanenaivākṣareṇa paraṃ puruṣamabhidhyāyīta' ityapāsanaṃ yāvañcīvamanuṣṭheyamiti nigamyate| atastadaṅgamapi yāvajjīvamanuṣṭheyam| tañca, 'sa khalvevaṃ vartayan yāvadāyuṣam' ityādibhirvaṇryata iti bhāvaḥ| upāsanavaduttarādhanivartakatvābhāvāt prajīnaśabdaḥ||5|| evaṃ pāvanatvoktyā tyājyaṃ doṣavaditi pakṣaḥ pratikṣiptaḥ| niścayaṃ śṛṇvityādinokta evārthaḥ etānyapīti ślokena nirdoṣatvādhyabasāyārthaṃ nigamanātmanā ddaḍhīkriyā ityapunaruktiḥ| hetusādhyabhāvena pūrvottaragranthau saṃgamayati yasmāditi| manīṣiśabdasūcitopāsanasamānayogakṣematādyotanāya api śabda ityāha upāsanavadetānyapī ti| paramātmaprītidvārā karmaṇāṃ pāvanatvādisiddhayarthamāha madārādhanarūpāṇīti| saṅgaśabdasya phalatyāgoktyā punarukti pariharati karmaṇi mamatā miti| niścita miti| nātrta punastvayā saṃśayitavyamiti bhāvaḥ| uttamamiti asarvajñānāmapyeṣāmetadviruddhaṃ svarūpatyāgādimataṃ sarvamadhamatvādanādaraṇīyamiti bhāvaḥ||6|| atha niyatasyetyādinā matāntarāṇāmadhamatvaṃ svamatasyottamatvaṃ ca prapañcayate| varṇāśramaprayuktatayā dustyajatvaṃ niyataśabdenābhipretamityāha nityanaimittikasyeti| tu śabdasahitaḥ saṃnyāsaśabdo'trta tyājyaṃ doṣavadityatrtasvarūpatyāgānuvādī sa eva hi mohāttasya parityāgaḥ ityutarārdhena nindyata ityabhiprāyeṇa saṃnyāsastayā ityuktaḥ| pāvanatvenāvaśyakartavyatve śiṣṭe, punaḥ tyāgonapapadyata iti śāsanaṃ prākprapaccitaddaṣṭāddaṣṭānupapattismāraṇaparamityābhiprāyeṇānupaparti vivṛṇoti śarīrayātrtā'pīti| kevalāśanādinā'pi lokikadehayātrtā sidhyedityātrtāha śarīrayātrtā hīti| "pañca bhūtātmakairbhogaiḥ āpyāyanamityātrtāha annamayaṃ hīti| sāttvikāhaṃkārakāryasyānnavikāratvāsaṃbhāvādāpyāyanoktiḥ|smṛtilambhe sarvagranthīnāṃ vipramokṣaḥ"bhidyate hradayagranthiḥ ityādikayā samānārthayā śrutyā darśanaśabdena viśeṣyata ityabhiprāyeṇa brāhrasākṣātkārarūpamityuktam| viśadatamatvāt sākṣātkārektiriha bhāvyā| sakṛdanuṣṭhitasya vidyopakāritvaśaṅkāṃ parihāram nigamayati tasmāditi| nopapadyate ityasya kāraṇābhāve kathaṃ kārya syāditi bhāvaḥ| uktaprakāreṇāparityājyatvaniyamavattvaṃ tasye tyanūdyata ityabhiprāyeṇāha evaṃ jñānotpādina iti| 'tyājyaṃ doṣavadi'tyanūditasya matasyaitaddūṣaṇamityābhiprāyeṇāha bandhakatvamohādi ti| "tatrta bhavaḥ" ityaṇpratyayena tāmasaśabdaṃ nirvakti tamomūla iti| saṃbandhamātrte'pi taddhitārthe phalitaviśeṣo'm| tāmasabuddhimūlatvena sadvārakaṃ tamomūlaṃ vivṛṇoti tamaḥ kāryeti| nanvatrta samabhivyāhratamohamūlatvenaiva tamomūlatve darśayitavye tamaḥ kāryājñānamūlatvoktiḥ kimarthā? tadarthaiva na hruktasyaiva punaśśabdāntaravyañcane prayojanam th;adhikabodhanaṃ tu yuktamaviruddhaṃ ceti|| nanu "pramādamohau tamaso bhavato'jñānameva ca" iti śloke mohaśabdena viparītajñānasya pṛthaguktatvādajñānabhāva ucyata iti vyākhyāt iha punaḥ, ajñānaṃ tu jñānavirodhi viparītajñānam iti kathamucyate ittham| jñānābhāvasyāpi pravṛttihetutvaṃ viparītajñānadvāreti pradarśanārthaṃ ślokasthamohaśabdasya prayojanāntaravivakṣayāvā, ślokasthasyājñānaśabdasya mohaviṣayatvajñāpanārthaṃ veti| tāmasabuddheḥ karmatyāgahetutāṃ vakṣyamāṇena vyanakti tathāceti| tatvavido na parityajanmatītyabhiprāyeṇa tāmasanirdeśaphalitaṃ nigamayati ata iti| nityanaimitikāderiti ādi śabdena phalābhisaṃdhirahitakāmyānāmapi vakṣyamāṇānāṃ grahaṇam| viparīta jñāne tyanenāyathājñānamūlāt rājasatyāgāt viśeṣapradarśanam| ayathāvadi ti hi rājasabuddhirvakṣyate|| tadevamantaraṅgatayā svarūpaśabdavyapadeśyasvarūpanirūpakadharmaprāṇapradadharmavaiparītyābhāve'pi nirūpitasvarūpaviśeṣakadharmavaiparītyena rājasīṃ budiṃdha vakṣyamāṇāmanusmaran rājasatyāgaṃ vivṛṇotiyadhyapi tyādinā| duḥkhamityeve tyavadhāraṇāt kāyakleśabhayā diti cokteradharmatvamoho'tra nāstīti phalitam|'arthānāmārjane duḥkham' ityādhyanusāreṇāha -- duḥkhātmake ti | manaso'vasādakara miti|anavasādo hi vivekātisādhanasaptakegaṇita iti bhāvaḥ|antaraṅgabahiraṅgavirodhe bahiraṅgatyāgo yuktaityabhiprāyeṇāha jñānabhyāsa eve ti |"yathoktānyapi karmāṇi parihāya dvijottamaḥ|ātmajñāne śame ca syāt vedābhyāse ca yatnavān" ityanuvādavākyāni asyamūlam| sa kutvā rājasaṃ tyāgamityanubādavivakṣitamāha ayathāvasthiteti| vakṣyamāṇasāttvikatyagaphalamiha tyāgaphalaśabdena vivakṣitam, mumukṣuprakaraṇatvāt karmatyāge tatsādhyasvargādiphalasya prasaṅgābhāvāñcetyabhiprāyeṇāha jñānotpattirūpa miti| duḥ khātmakatvādiprayuktamanovasādaśaṅkāṃ pariharati nahī ti| "phalasaṃbibhantsayā hi" ityādyuktakrameṇa karmabhiḥ prasādito bhagavān manaso'navasādameva karotītyarthaḥ||8|| atha tyāgo hītyādinā smāritamevoddhṛtya sattvakāryayathāvasthitajñānamūlatayā tasyaiva śāruāīyatvaṃ draḍhayati kāryamityeveti ślokena| 'niyatasya tu saṃnyāsaḥ karmaṇo nopapadyate' iti prakramādihāpi niyataśabdaḥ karmaviśeṣaṇamiti tadarthamāha nityeti| āhatya kāryatvaṃ hi prayojanasyaiva tadarthatayaiva hi sādhanasya kāryatā tasmādaphalasya kathaṃ kartavyatvamityatrtāha madārādhanarūpatayā kārya miti tadabhipretamāha khayaṃprayojana mati| kartṛtvatyāgo'pyatrtānusaṃdhenaḥ| ata eva hranantaśloke tyāgīti śabdaḥ saṅgaphalakartṛtvatyāgīti vyākhyāyate||9|| sattvādimūlaśāruāīyatyāgayuktasya, 'vartate sāttviko bhāvaḥ' , udāsīnavadāsīnaḥ ityādiprasiddhaṃ vikārābhāvarūpaṃ lakṣaṇamucyate na dveṣṭīti ślokena| tenoktalakṣaṇatyāgasya sattvamūlatvamapyupapāditaṃ bhavati| tatrta hetukāryakramaucityena bhinnakramatayā vyākhyāti sattvasamāviṣṭa ityādinā| 'dhīrdhāraṇāvatībhedhā' iti naidhaṇṭukāḥ| śrutiśca, 'medhāmanīṣe mā viśatāṃ samīcī bhūtasya bhavyasyāvarudhyai' iti| atrta ācāryopadiṣṭeṣvartheṣu apracyuteranyāsaṅkarāñca phalitamāha yathāvasthitatattvajñāna iti| atrta śubhāśubhaparyāyakuśalaśabdābhyāṃ pratiṣidhyamānaddheṣasaṅgahetvanuvāda ityabhiprāyeṇāniṣṭaphalatvādyuktiḥ| tyāgī tyuktasya tyāgasya hetutāṃ vivṛṇoti sarvasminnityādinā| yathā'ndīye'nyakartṛke karmaṇi svasaṃbandhavirahāt bādhakādyabhāvaniścayena dveṣādyabhāvaḥ, tathā'trtapītyābhiprāyaḥ| ananuṣṭhānadaśāyāṃ harṣadveṣaprasaṅgābhāvāt kriyamāṇayori tyuktam| nanu kuśale nānuṣañjate ityetat yuktam; svargādiṣu nissaṅgātāmātrteṇa kāmyānuṣṭhāne'pi tatphalānanvayaśāruāāt; na dveṣṭakuśalaṃ karmeti tu viruddham; phalasaṅgābhāvaprasaṅgāt| na hi narakādikaṃ kasyacidiṣṭaṃ syāt| evaṃ ddaṣṭapratyavāyahetuṣvapyadveṣo na yukta ityatrā prāmādikaviṣayatvena parihāra uktaḥ| nanvadhikāriviśeṣe buddhipūrvairapi pāpakarmabhiralepaḥ kiṃ na syādityatrāha nāvirata iti| etacchlokārthaṃ prakṛtahetutayā ghaṭayam paramaprakṛtaṃ nigamayati ata iti|| 10|| niyatasye tyādipratipāditayuktivivaraṇapūrvekaṃ phalatyāgenopalakṣaṇena prāguktariuāvidho'pi sāttvikatyāgaḥ nahī ti ślokena nigamyata ityāha tadāheti| atrā dehamṛte ti na prāṇimātrānirdeśaḥ, anupayogāt| ataḥ karmasvarūpatyāgāśakyātāheturavayavārtho vivakṣita ityabhiprāyeṇāha dhriyamāṇaśarīreṇe ti| śakyamiti tyajanaparatvānnapuṃsakatvaikatve, sāmānyarūpavivakṣaṇādvā| dehabhṛttvahetukamaśakyatvaṃ vivṛṇoti dehadhāraṇārthānā miti| tadanubandhinaḥ arthārjanādayaḥ bhavantu laukikāni; kiṃ śāruāīyairityātrāha tadartheṃ ceti| śrutisvārasyahetukāṃ svarūpatyāgaśaṅkāṃ parihartuṃ yasmitva tyādikamucyata ityabhiprāyeṇāha yastbiti| 'abhidhīyate' ityasya kairityākāṅkṣāśamanāya 'tyāgenaike' ityādiśrutyupādānam| prakrāntanigamanaparatvena pradarśanārthatāṃ draḍhayati trāvidha iti||11|| laukikaphalasādhanakarmaprakiyayaiva hi vaidikānāmapi phalasādhanatbavyavasthāpanam| laukikāni ca karmāṇi phalecchābhāve'pi svaśaktyanurūpaṃ phalanti| evaṃ vaidikeṣvapītyabhiprāyeṇa śaṅkate nanbiti| nanvagnihotrādīnāṃ mahāyajñādīnāṃ ca viniyogapṛthaktvena āśramāṅgatvasvargādyarthatvādivirodhāt svargādyarthatayā'nuṣṭhānaṃ mā bhūt, āśramārthatayā'nuṣṭhāne tu ko virodha ityatrāha nityanaimittikānāmapī ti| bījāvāpādiddaṣṭāntena akuśala mityuktsya prāmādikasyāpi bandhakatvaṃ sūcitam| na hi bhūmau pramādanipatitaṃ bījaṃ na phalati| tasmāti āmrarasārthino viṣatarubījāvāpatulyo'yaṃ karmakalāpa ityabhiprāyeṇa phalitaṃ svarūpatyāgamāha ata iti| amumukṣūṇāmidamaniṣṭatvāditrauvidhyam, mumukṣvapekṣayā svargāderapyaniṣṭatvāt -- ityabhiprāyeṇa narakasvargādikathanam| kārīryādisādhyavṛṣṭādiphalānāṃ jīvaddaśābhāvitvasthiteḥ pretyeti pradarśanārtham; anyathā tasminneva śarīre tyāgināmapi bādhācñetyabhiprāyeṇāha karmānuṣṭhānottarakāla miti| atrāpyanaṣṭaphalānanvayaḥ pūrvoktarītyā prāmādikakarmaviṣayo mantavyaḥ| uktasya codyasya pratijñāmātroṇottaramidamucyate; na tu kayācit yuktyetyatrā āha etadukta miti| viniyogapṛthaktvaṃ viniyojakavākyapṛthaktvena grāhram| viniyogapṛthaktvena jyotiṣṭomādiṣu pāpakṣayādinānāphalatvaṃ siddham| parihriyate| viruddhaphalatvacodyamiti śeṣaḥ| nanu 'tamevaṃ viddhānamṛta iha bhavati| nānyaḥ panthāḥ' iti niyamanādvedanameva mokṣasādhanatayā vidhīyate| karma tu vyavacchidyate| ataḥ kathaṃ mokṣādhikāre viniyogoktiḥ? tatrāha mokṣaviniyogaśce ti| asinā jidhāṃsati, aśvena jigamiṣatītyādiṣvivārthasvabhāvādihāpīṣyamāṇadhātvartha -- karaṇatayā'nvayaḥ| ato vedanotpattidvāreṇa paramparayā sādhanatvānmokṣaviniyogaḥ| avyavahitasādhanavivakṣayā tu "nānyaḥ panthāḥ"ityādibhirniṣedha iti bhāvaḥ|| evaṃ paripaśnābhipretamanyathā'pi prativaktumupakramata ityabhiprāyeṇa saṃgatyarthamuktamaṃśaṃ nigamanacchāyayā'nuvadati tadeva miti| tat svarūpatyāgādestāmasatvādityarthaḥ| evaṃ varṇāśramādiniyatasya dustyajatvaprakāreṇetyarthaḥ| asminneva śloke, 'bhavatyatyāgināṃ pretya na tu saṃnyāsināṃ kacit' iti tyāgābhāvaviparyayasya saṃnyāsaśabde nānukathanāt tyāgasaṃnyāsapṛthaktvāśaṅkā ca parihratetyāha sa eva ca tyāga iti||12|| aniṣṭamiṣṭam ityāderanantaraṃ kāraṇapañcakokteḥ kā saṃgātirityatrāha idānī miti| sākṣātpaśnaviṣaye pratyukte satītyarthaḥ| bhagavati, puruṣottame ityubhābhyāṃ prāguktaprakāreṇa sarvāntaryāmiṇaḥ tadgatvatatprayuktadoṣābhāvakhyāpanam| prakāramāhe tyanena āmatṛtīyādhyāyādanukrāntasyākartṛtvānusaṃdhānasyātrauva sahetu kayathāvasthitasvarūpaśodhanamiti darśitam| triṣu tyāgeṣu prakrānteṣu antamasya prakāraśodhanamiti saṃgātiḥ| trividhe'pi tyāge sāttvikatayā prakānte kimiti kartṛtvatyāgaprakāramātropapādanamityatrāha tata eve ti| iti śabdo'trā hetvarthaḥ| ṛtvigādiṣu kartṛtve'pi yajamānādeḥ karmaṇi phale ca mamatā ddaśyate; tadvadasyāpi kiṃ na syāt; ataḥ kartṛtvatyāgamātrāt kathaṃ karmaṇi phale ca mamatābuddhinivṛttirityatrāha paramapuruṣohī ti| hī ti pramāṇaprasiddhisūcanam| "tvaṃ nyañcadbhirudañcadbhiḥ karmasūtropapaditaiḥ| hare viharasi krīḍākantukairiva janturiva jantubhiḥ"|| , "kṛṣṇasya hi kṛtebhūtamidaṃ viśvaṃ carācaram" ityādiprasiddhamāha svakīyenetyādinā| karaṇādhipādhiṇe hi paramapuruṣaḥ śrūyate| ataḥ karaṇānāṃ jīvaśeṣatvadaśāyāmapi gajaturagādyalaṅkāreṣu rājña iva paramapuruṣasya śeṣitvaṃ na nivartata ityabhiprāyeṇāha svakīyaiśca karaṇakalevaraprāṇai riti| saṅkocakābhāvādddaṣṭāddaṣṭaphalapradānādikamapi tasya līletyāha svalīlāprayojanāyeti| "lokavatu līlākaivalyam" ityādibhiridaṃ mīmāṃsitamiti bhāvaḥ| līlādiprayojanāye ti pāṭhe tu ādiśabdena kāruṇyādimūlabhaktarakṣaṇādigrahaṇam| nanu śāruāīyasya karmaṇaḥ paramapuruṣasamārādhanatayaiva vidhānāt phalaparyantasya tasya tadīyatā yuktā laukikaṃ tu karma tathā śiṣṭam nāpi tathā'dhyakṣam; kṣunnivṛttyādeḥ phalasya jīvagāmitvenaivopalambhāt| ato laukikānāṃ phalānāṃ jīvaśeṣatve tatsādhanasyāpi karmaṇastadarthatā yuktā tasmātam siddhaye sarvakarmaṇāmi tyādibhiḥ sarvaviṣayasaṅgatyāgādyupapādanamaśakyamiti; tatrāha ata iti| paramapuruṣasyaive ti ṣaṣṭhī svasvāmibhāvakhyasaṃbandhaviśeṣaviśrāntā| yathā pañcaraśakuntapoṣaṇādikaṃ tatsukhādikaṃ ca sārvabhaumasya śeṣabhūtam, tathā'trāpīti bhāvaḥ|| sāṃkhye kṛtānte iti sāṃkhyasiddhānto vivakṣitaḥ, tatrośvarānabhyupagamāt, karaṇātiriktasya kartṛtvānabhyupagamena, 'kartā karaṇaṃ ca pṛthagvidham' iti kartṛkaraṇavibhāgoktyasaṃbhavāt| tasya vedaviruddhatve tattvopadeśāya tadupanyāsāyogāt| aviruddhatve'pi vedamūlatvasyaivāṅgīkartṛvyatve veda eva viśramāt| arthaucityāya ca rūḍhiparityāgena yaugikārthāvalambanasya sarvasaṃmateḥ| ato vedeṣveva yathāvasthitatattvanirṇayāya pravṛto bhāgaḥ sāṃkhkṛtāntaśabdena vivakṣita ityabhiprāyeṇa nirvakti saṃkhyā buddhi riti| prakaraṇānurodhena budiṃdha viśinaṣṭi yathāvasthite ti| yadiha śaṅkareṇoktam, "padārthāḥ saṃkhyāyante yasmin śāruo tat sākhyaṃ vedāntaḥ, sa eva kṛtāntaḥ kṛtasya karmaṇo'sminnantaḥ iti tadasat, vedanteṣvapi karmānvayasya sthāpitatvāt| rūḍhiparityāde cāvaśyaṃbhāvinyucitatamayogasyaiva grahītuṃ yuktatvāt| antaśabdo niścayaparatayā naidhaṇṭukaiḥ paṭhitaḥ sa eva buddhipūrvasaṃṣāditatayā kṛtaśabdena viśeṣyata ityabhiprāyeṇa anusaṃhite nirṇaya ityaktam| yadvā nirṇayaśabdo'trā niṇītavastuparaḥ kṛtāntaśabdasya siddhāntaparyāyasya tattadabhyupagatārtharūḍhatvāt| ata eva hi anusaṃhita iti viśeṣitam| na hi nirṇaya evānusandhātavyaḥ| athavā prācāṃ nirṇayaḥ parairanusaṃhita iti viśeṣitam| na hi nirṇayaśabdaḥ| tadānīṃ proktānītya nena samanvayaḥ| siddhi śabdena phalaparyantatvādikamihāvivakṣitam; 'yatkarmaprārabhate, pañcaite tasya hetavaḥ' iti karmasvarūpopasaṃpatterevānantarokterityabhiprāyeṇāha utpattaya iti| mamakāraṇānī tyasaṃbhavāt madīyāni kāraṇanītyukteriha daiva śabdanirdiṣṭasya svasya svakīyatvābhāvenānanvayāducitamanvayamāha mama sakāśādanusandhatsve ti| vakṣyamāṇānāṃ pañcānāṃ yathādarśanaṃ vivikte hetubhāve manassamādhānavidhānārthamidamiti bhāvaḥ| ṣaṅviśakamanabhyupagacchatā pañcaviśakaṃ ca kartṛtvāropamātrādhikaraṇaṃ pratipādayatāṃ prakaraṇamidaṃ viruddhamityabhiprāyeṇa yaugikārthaparatvamupapādayati vaidikī hī ti| śarīrendriyaprāṇajīvātmopakaraṇa miti bahuvrīhiḥ| upakaraṇaṃ vivakṣitakāryārthatayopāttaḥ parikaraḥ||23|| uktavivaraṇatayā ślokadvayasyāpunarukti paramate viridhaṃ cābhipretyāha tadidamāhe ti| tat śrutisiddham, idaṃ vivakṣitamityarthaḥ| nyāyyaṃ nyāyādanapetam; "dharmapathryanyāyādanapete" ityanuśāsanāt| nyāya śabdaścātrā arthāntarānaucityāt vyutpattyanurodhāñca śāruāmevānusandhatta ityabhiprāyeṇāha śāruāsiddha iti| śāruāsiddhena saha laukikavivakṣāyāṃ tadanyadveti vaktavyam vihite nirdiṣṭe viparīta śabdaśca niṣiddhe svasaḥ, kaimutyena ca laukikaṃ labhyamityabhiprāyeṇāha pratiṣiddhe ve ti| sarvasmin karmaṇī ti phalitoktiḥ| yathā śārīmānasavācikeṣu karmasu śarīrādīnāṃ prādhānyena pratiniyatatā na tathā'mī pañca hetavaḥ apitu pratikarma pañcāpyapekṣitā ityabhiprāyeṇāśārīratvādyuktiḥ| pañcahetukeṣu sarveṣu prādhānyādeva hi śārītvādivibhāgaḥ| yadyapi jagatsṛṣṭādiṣu paramātmanā svecchayaivamukaraṇīkṛtānyetānītyābhiprāyeṇa hetvantaroktiḥ| "adhiṣṭhānaṃ kṣetrāmāhuḥ" iti karālāyāha vasiṣṭhaḥ, tadanusāreṇāha adhiṣṭhānaṃ śarīra miti| śrutiśca, "madhavat matrthaṃ vā idaṃ śarīramāttaṃ mṛtyunā tadasyāmṛtasyāśarīrasyātmano'dhiṣṭhānāma" iti śarīre'dhiṣṭhānaśabdaṃ vyutpādayati adhiṣṭhīyata iti| adhiṣṭhātujīṃyasyāpi karaṇādeḥ pṛthaṅnirdeśāt tatsaṃkocāyāha mahābhūtasaṃdhātarūpa miti| viśvakartṛriha daivaśabdena pṛthaggrahaṇāt, kartṛśabdasya cātrā "śāruāphalaṃ prayoktari"iti nyāyasūcanārthatvāñca kartā jīvātme tyuktam| nanu kartṛtvaṃ hi jñānacikīrṣāpūrvakakarmārthaprayatrāyogitvam; jñānamātrāsyātmano jñātṛtvāsaṃbhavāt tanmūlaṃ kartṛtvamapi naṃ syādevetyata āha asya jīvātmanojñātṛtvaṃ kartṛtve ceti| 'jño'ta eva' ityādisūtrāgrahaṇaṃ śrutyāderapi tata evā''karṣaṇāt| karmotpatihetūpanyāsāt karaṇaśabdo'trā karmendriyamātrāpara ityabhiprāyeṇāha vāgiti| yadyapi jñānendriyāṇāṃ tattadviṣayajñānotpādanadvārā paramparayā karmaṇi hetutvamasti, tathā'pi vastumātreṣvāvalociteṣu manasā saṃkalpayaiva karmakaraṇāt manaścānyavyāpākhyavadhānābhāvāt samanaska mityuktam| jñānendreśyāpi manasaḥ karmendriyapravattiṣvapi sādhāraṇyāt karmendriyatvoktiḥ| śarīra vāṅmanobhiri ti atraivokteḥ manasaḥ saṃkalpādikarmāpekṣayā vā karmeṇdriyatvavādaḥ | sākhyairap yevamovoktam, "buddhīndriyāṇi cakṣuśśrotraghrāṇarasanastvagākhyāni | vākyapāṇipādapāyūsthān karmendriyāṇyāhuḥ || ubhayāt makamatra manaḥ saṃkalpakamindriyaṃ ca sādhamryāt iti | karmahetuṣūpādīyamāneṣu pṛthagvidha miti viśeṣaṇaṃ tadupayuktavyāpārākhyavidhāparimityāha karmaniṣpattau pṛthagvyāpāra miti | vāgādiṣvekaikasya vacanādāna viharaṇotsargānandasaṃkalpādikriyāvyāpāro hi mitho vilakṣaṇaḥ | prayatnamūlā śarīrādikriyaiva hi ceṣṭādaśabdena pañcātmā vāyuri ti | abhidhīyata iti śabdena pritapādana mātraṃ vivakṣitam | atra taddhetāvanyasmin lakṣayitavye vāgādīnāṃ karaṇādiśabdairupāttatvāt prāṇa saṃvādādiṣu karaṇānāṃ śarīrasya ca sthitipravṛtteḥ prāṇāyattatvaśruteḥ, " prāṇapravṛttinimitta ceṣṭāvācinā śabdena prāṇalakṣaṇā'tra yuktetyabhiprāyeṇāha tadvattivācine ti | ceṣṭāśabdene ti pūrveṇānvayaḥ | prāṇasaṃvādādismāreṇena prāṇalakṣaṇāyā aucityaṃ vṛttervaividhyaṃ ta vivṛṇoti śarīrendriye ti | pṛthakchabdavivi dha śabdayoḥ paunaruktyaparihārāyāha śarīrendriyadhārakasya prāṇapānādibhebhinnasye ti | adhiṣṭhānakartṛkaraṇa vyāpārāpekṣayā śarīrendriyavargarūpaviṣayabhedena ca pṛthaktvaṃ prāṇādivṛttibhedapratiniyatocchvāsa nimeṣonmeṣādi vyāpārairvaividhyaṃ ceti bhāvaḥ | pañcātma śabdo'tra pañcavṛttitvaparaḥ; tathā ca sūtram, pañcavṛttirmano badvayapadiśyate iti | pañcavṛttitvoktiśca nāgakūrmakṛkaradevadattadhanaṃjayarūpavṛttyantarapañ cakasyāpi pradarśikā | daivaṃ caivātra pañca mamityatra daivākhyapradhānanirdhāraṇārtha matre tyunuvāda ityāha atra karma hetukalāpa iti | paramātmanaḥ pañcamatayā parigaṇane śrutyarthapāṭhādikramāsaṃbhavāt vācaḥ kramavarti tvena yathāsaṃbhavaṃ parigaṇane'pi pañcamamiti pūraṇanirdeśe prayojanābhāvāt, yathā kaṭhavallyām, indriyebhyaḥ parā hrarthāḥ' ityupakramya, "mahataḥ paramavyaktātpuruṣaḥ paraḥ | puruṣānna paraṃ kiṃcit sā parā gatiḥ || ' itīndriyādisamastapravṛttau pradhānahetuḥ paramapuruṣo vaśīkaraṇīyakāṣṭhātvena nirdiṣṭaḥ, tadvadihāpītyabhiprāyeṇāha paramātmā antaryā mīti | nanu, "daivaṃ purākṛtaṃ karma', "daivaṃ diṣṭaṃ bhāgadheyam ' ityādiṣu prācīnakarmarūpabhāgyaparyāyatayā daivaśabdaṃ paṭhanti | tasya ca hetutvamupapannam | ataḥ kathamatra paramātmetyucyate? ittham | na hi prāgeva vinaṣṭānāṃ karmaṇāṃ svarūpeṇa hetutvaṃ saṃbhavati | ataḥ karmajanyādṛṣṭarūpaparamapuruṣa saṃkalpasyaiva hetutvaṃ vaktavyam | tato varaṃ tasyaiva daivaśabdena pratipādanam | asti ca daivaśabdasya daivataparyāyatayā'pi loka vedayoḥ prasiddhiḥ; yathā, satyaṃ satyaṃ punassatyamuddhṛtya bhujamucyate | vedaśāstrāt paraṃ nāsti na daivaṃ keśavāt param || iti | na hratrārthāntaraṃ saṃbhavati | evaṃ śrīmadrāmāyaṇe 'pi, "svā dhīnaṃ samatikramya mātaraṃ pitaraṃ gurum | asvādhīnaṃ kathaṃ daivaṃ prakārairabhirādhyate || iti | tathā sabhāparvaṇi, śrūyatāṃ paramaṃ daivaṃ durvijñeyaṃ mayā'pi ca | nārāyastu puruṣo viśvarūpo mahādyutiḥ || iti | tathā yājñavalkyapraṇīte yogaśāstre, " ārṣaṃ chandaśca mantrāṇāṃ daivataṃ brāāhṛṇaṃ tathā ityukta evārthaḥ punaḥ, "ārṣaṃ chandaśca daivaṃ ca ityādinā'pi nirdiśyate | tatraiva daityamohanārthe prajāpat "adhidaivaṃ kimucyate ' iti prativakti | chāndogye ādityākhyadaivatavartinaḥ puruṣasyādhidaivatamiti jhrnideśena aharitināmocyate, tasyopaniṣadaharitya dhidaivataṃ tasyopaniṣadahamityadhyātmamiti | evamanyatrāpi draṣṭavyam | anyairapi cātra daivaśabdaścakṣurā dyanugrāhakādityādiviṣayatāyā vyākhyātaḥ | vayaṃ tu ādityādīnāmapyanugrāhakaṃ paramātmānamiha daivaṃ brāūma iti viśeṣaḥ | prayuktaṃ ca stotre, prakhyātadaivaparamārthavidāṃ mataiśca iti | lakṣmīkalyāṇe 'pi ca, dharme pramāṇaṃ samayastadīyo vedāśca tattvaṃ ca tadiṣṭadaivatam iti | tasmāddaivaśabdo'tra devatāparyāyaḥ | sa cātra sarvapravartakahetuparatvāt viśeṣakābhāvācca paradevatāviṣaya ucita iti paramātmā'ntaryāmī karmantaryā mī karmaniṣpattau pradhānahetu rityuktam| yathā'sau sarveṣāmātmā, na tathā'sya kaścidityataḥ paramātmā | yathā śarīrarādeḥ pravṛttau jīvaḥ pradhānahetuḥ, tathā tasyāpsāvityabhiprāyeṇāntaryāmitvoktiḥ | tadvivakṣāmātra pūrvāparābhyāṃ sthāpayati uktaṃ hī tyādinā | nanu "svatantraḥ kartā iti kartṛlakṣaṇamanuśiṣṭam; iha ca karteti kṣetrajña aiva nirdiṣṭaḥ | ataḥ kārakāntaraprayoktṛtvaṃ kārakāntarāprayojyatvaṃ ca tasyāṅgīkartavyam | tasmāt daiva mapyatrādhiṣṭhānādivat tadapekṣayā guṇībhūtam vaktavyamityatrāha paramātmāyattaṃ ce ti | utpannajñānacikārṣā prayatnasya hi puruṣasya kārakāntaraprayoktṛtvādikam; jñānādyutpattireva tu paramātmamāyatteti śrutisiddhatvāt jīvasya parāyattakartṛtvaṃ svātantryaṃ cāviruddhamiti śārīrake sthāpitamiti bhāvaḥ | imamabhiprāyamajānan vāyūdakādivat paramātmanaḥ prerakatvamiti jhrmatvā?ṭa codayati nanveva miti | jyotiṣṭomādiṣu yadi paramātmā prerayati, tadā na jīvasya kiṃcidvidheyam; na hi prabalena hyiyamāṇasya gamanavidhaḥ| atha nirundhe, tathāpi na vidheyam; na hi durbalasya prabalena niruddhasya gamanavidhiḥ| atha nirundhe, tathāpi na vidheyam; na hi durbalasya prabalena niruddhasya gamanavidhiḥ evaṃ yatra paramātmā pravartayati, tatra nivṛtteraśakyatvānniṣedho niṣphalaḥ | yatra tu na pravartayet, tatra tu pravṛtterevāśakya tvānna niṣedhāpekṣeti bhāvaḥ | iyamatra cārvāketarasamastasiddhāntāvalambinī tatra tu pravṛtterevāśakyatvānna niṣedhāpekṣeti bhāvaḥ | iyamatra cārvāketarasamastasiddhāntāvalambinī codyakāṣṭhā -- nigrahānugrahāmnātapūrvādṛṣṭapracoditaḥ | nigra hānuhyādyarhaṃ itīdaṃ ghaṭate katham iti | jīvasya jñātṛtvakartṛtvapāratantrayābhāvacodyavat pāratantrye'pi vidhiniṣedhavaiyathryaprasaṅgacodyamapi pañcamavedatupaniṣa dodrraṣṭā bhagavān bādarāyaṇaḥ svayameva parijahāretyāha idamapī ti | vihitapratiṣiddhā vaiyathryādihetubhya eva cetanena kṛtaṃ prayatnamapekṣya paramātmā uttarottareṣu pravartayatīti sūtrārthaḥ| tatrā sarvapravṛttiṣu paramātmādhīnāsu kathaṃ kṛtaprayatnāpekṣatvamucyate? vaiyathryacodyasya cāvaiyathryasiddhayarthatayā parihāre sādhyāviśeṣaśca syāditi śaṅkāyāṃ sūtrāsyābhiprāyikamarthamāha etadukta miti| ayamabhiprāyaḥ -- yat tāvat īśvarasya yantrādivat svasaṃkalpakalipatapravṛttiśaktīnāṃ samarpaṇam, yañca bhūtalādivat sarvaparvapravṛttittyānuguṇyena svarūpatassaṃkalpaśca sarvadhāratayā'vasthānam, yadapi karaṇakalebarādyadhiṣṭhānaśaktipradānam, yañca pravṛttyālambanabāhraviṣayapuraskaraṇam, tat sarvaṃ jīvasya kartṛtvānuguṇaṃ sarvapravṛttinivṛttisādhāraṇaṃ ceti na tatrā codyāvakāśaḥ| etācaiva sarvapravṛttinivṛttisādhāraṇamudāsīnatvaṃ bhagavata ucyate| evaṃ labdhaśakteḥ puruṣasya pravṛttikāle yat kāryaniṣpattyarthamīśvarasyānumantṛtvam, tadapi na jīvasya kartṛtāṃ vārayati; apitūttabhnātīti na tato'pi vidhiniṣeghavaiyathryavam| na caikasminneva karmaṇi paramātmākhyakatrrantarasāhacarye jīvasyāniyojyatākāraṇam; pratyekamaśakyeṣu bahubhiranuṣṭhīyamaneṣvapi loke vidhiniṣedhatatphaladidarśanāt pravṛttiśaktasyecchāyāmanyairanivāryatvena svātanñyādisiddheḥ| evam, "kāryate hravaśaḥ karma sarvaḥ prakṛtijairguṇaiḥ" ityādiṣvapi jñānecchāpuraskāreṇa pravartanāt icchāviśeṣādeśca svavāsanādiviśeṣamūlatvāt jīvasya kartṛtvaṃ susthitam| ata eva hratrā hetupañcake karteti samākhyāsamādhinā kartṛtvenaiva jīvo nirūpyate| yatu karaṇakalebaraśaktijñānavāñchādiṣu viṣamapradānam ahitapravatau anivāraṇam anumananaṃ pratyavāyajananaṃ ca, tadapyanādipūrvakarmavaiṣamyepādhikatayā neśvarasya vaiṣamyanairdhṛṇyāpādakam| pravṛttibaiṣamyasyāddaṣṭavaiṣamyamūlatve'pi tadevāddaṣṭaṃ śāruāpuraskāreṇāsya ddaṣṭādikamārabhate, tadapyevamiti vidhiniṣedhāvakāśalābhaḥ| na hi pūrvaṃ yajñādikāraṇamaddaṣṭaṃ svabuddhayaivu nivṛttiyogyatayā śāsanānarhadaśāmapādya pāpepravartayati; tadapi tatheti| anyathā, addaṣṭamūlatvāt hitāhitapravṛttyorna śāruāāpekṣetiva vādinaḥ pūrvāddaṣṭe'pi tathā prasaṅgat svavacanavirodhaḥ| atha aṃddaṣṭamūlatve śāruāvaiyathryaprasaṅgaḥ sārthakaṃ ca śāruāṃ paraisabhyupagamyata ityadtagaddaṣṭamūlatvameva nopapadyeteti manyase -- tadapi na laukikavidhiniṣedhayorapi tathā prasaṅgat| tatrāpi hi sāmagrī vaiciñyamūlatve pravṛttivṛttyādivaiciñyasya, kiṃ gāmānayetyādiniyogena? atha so'pi niyogaḥ svasāmagrayopanītaḥ pravṛttinivṛttisāmagrīmadhyamadhyāsta iti paśyasi, evaṃ vaidikaniyogo'pīti saṃpaśyethāḥ| tarhi laukikamapi niyogaṃ parityajāma iti cet; hanta parasparasaṃvyavahāravyutpatyādyasaṃbhāvat vilīnaṃ lokāyatenāpīti mūkībhava| evaṃ sāmānyataḥ sarveṣu addaṣṭavaiṣamyamūleṣvapi karmasu śāruo sāvakāśe tadeva śāruāmīśvarabuddhiviśeṣaṃ cet addaṣṭamupadiśāti, tathāvidho'yamīśvaraḥ pramāṇabalādavagata iti na tatrā paricodanākāśaḥ| na caiṣa doṣaḥ| yathokta mācāryairvādihaṃsāmbuvārhaiḥ "vaiṣamye sati karmaṇāmaviṣama kiṃ nāma kuryāt kṛtī kiṃ vodāratayā dadīta varado vāñchanti cet durgatim"iti| tadayaṃ cārvāketarasamastasiddhāntaniṣṭhānāṃ sādhāraṇaparihārasāraḥ -- tattadiṣṭāddaṣṭamūlaśāruāvaśyadaśānvayāt| punastathātathā'ddaṣṭādyutpattirupapadyate|| pumarthasādhanatve pratīteḥ svecchayā pumān| pravarteti tādathryāt sāvakāśā'trā codanā|| iti||atrā karaṇakalebarapradānādisādhāraṇopakārasāpekṣatayā jīvakartṛtvasya parāpekṣatva sannityantenoktam| karmaniṣpattye ityādinā tu pravṛttiviśeṣe jīvasya svātantrayaṃ darśitam| tatrāpi parasya kiṃcitkāraḥ tadantarabasthita ityādinoktaḥ | taṃ kṛtaprayatrāmityarthaḥ||24||25|| yadyevaṃ pañcānāṃ hetutve'pyātmaiva kartā, tahrrakartṛtvānusaṃdhānaṃ bhrāntirūpameva syāt| vidhiniṣedhādisaṃrakṣaṇāya kartṛtvaṃ tāvat dustyajam| na ca sahakārinirapekṣakartṛtvaṃ pratiṣidhta iti vācyam; tasya prasaṅgabhāvena pratiṣedhāyogāt| na ca kaścit dehendriyadaṇḍacakrādinirapekṣaḥ karomīti manyate -- iti śaṅkāyāṃ niyantrāntaranirapekṣasvabhāvikakartṛtvabhramasya, dehādyātmabhramavatāṃ cānekādhīne karmaṇyananyayādhīnatvābhimānasya nivāraṇamakartṛtvānusaṃdhānamityucyate tatraiva miti ślokena| paramātmānumatipūrvaka iti sarvanirvāhakapradhānahetugrahaḥ| ātmāna miti| svātmānamityarthaḥ| ata eva ca kartṛśabdo'trā na pūrvavat dharmisamarpakaḥ; itarathā karmaprārambhahetumityadhyāhāraprasaṅgāñcetyabhiprāyeṇāha kevalamātmāmanameva kartāra miti| tuśabdo'trāvadhāraṇārtho vyākhyātaḥ| śaṅkānivartakatve'pi vā kevalaśabdoktavyaktyartha evakāraḥ| nanvatrā kevalaśabdena svābhāvikakartṛtvānuvādamātrāṃ syāditi cennaḥ, caturbhissaṃbhūyakaraṇe prastute tadanabhijñanindāyāṃ tadvyavacchedārthatvāsvārasyāt; tasyāpekṣittvāñcā| tatra yat parairuktam, -- ātmano'vikriyasvabhāvatvenādhiṣṭhānā dibhissaṃhatatvānupapatteḥ vikriyāvato hranvaissaṃhananaṃ, saṃhatya vā kartṛtvaṃ syāt; natvavikriyasyātmanaḥ kenacitsaṃhananamastīti na saṃbhūyakāritvamupapadyate ' iti; tadasat, svarūpotpattayādibhavikārarahitasyātmanaḥ dāruṇyagniryathā tailaṃ tile tadvatpumānapi| pradhāne'vasthito vyāpī cetanātmātmavedanaḥ' ityādibhiśśāstraidrravyāntareṇa saṃhananasya jñānacikīrṣādyādhāratayā sahakāribhissaṃbhūyakartṛtvasya ca sthāpanāt; anyathātrāpi "pañcaite tasya hetavaḥ ' iti karturapi hetutvena parigaṇanasya bhaṅgaprasaṅgāditi | sa durmati riti etaduktasyaivānuvādaḥ, anyathā paunaruktyādityabhiprāyeṇāha viparītamati riti| akṛtabuddhi rihādhyātmaśāsruauraniṣpāditabuddhiḥ, tadāha aniṣpanneti | 'yaḥ paśyati, na paśyati, na sa paśyatī'ti vyādhātāt, sadapi darśanamayathābhāvenāsatkalpatayā nindyata ityabhiprāyeṇāha na yathāvasthita miti| bāhreṣu yathāvasthitadarśanasaṃbhavāt prakṛtaviṣaye niyacchati kartāra miti| svabhāva -- artha -- śāruāprāptavyatirikteṣu na pravarteta; avaśyatartavyeṣu svabhāvādiprāpteṣvapi svasminnadhiṣṭhānādiṣu ca yathāṃśaṃ karmabandhaṃ nyasya pravarteteti hudayam||26|| durmatiprasaṅge kastarhi sumatiriti bubhutsāyāmevaṃvidhākartṛtvānusaṃdhānasya prayojanamucyate yasye ti ślokena| bhāvo 'trābhiprāyaḥ, arthāntarānanvayāt| sa ca prakaraṇāt samabhivyāhārāñca viśeṣyate kartṛtvaviṣayo manovṛttiviśeṣa iti| ahaṃkṛtaḥ ityatrā katrrārthatve'pi manovṛttiviśeṣasyāhamabhimānaviṣayatvāyogāt tanmūlatvāmātrāmiha vivakṣitamityāha ahamabhimānakṛta iti| atrāhaṃśabdenāhamabhimānalakṣṇā vā| yadvā 'ahaṃkṛtaḥ' iti 'bhuktā brāhṛṇāḥ' itivat kartari ktaḥ| ahamabhimānakṛta iti phalitoktiḥ| nanu ātmano'hamarthatvāt kathamahamabhimānavarjanam? tatrāha ahaṃ karomī ti| sāvadhāraṇāmidaṃ yojyam, anyathā sākṣātkartṛtvavirodhāt| evaṃ kartṛtvatyago kaṇṭhokte pariśeṣāt tenārthasiddhaḥ phalasaṅgatyāgaḥ buddhiryasya na lipyate ityanūdyata ityāha asminni ti| "nāvirato duścaritāt" ityādipratiṣivaidhetarahananavyudāsāya śāstropakramādisidvamukṛṣyāha yudve hatvā'pī ti| na hanti hananābhimānajanyaddaṣṭavattayā tatphalasaṃbandhayogyahantrantaravilakṣaṇa ityarthaḥ; anyathā 'hatvāpi na hantīti vyādhātāt| yattu paraira troktam 'ātmano hananakartṛtvābhāvāt tatkāryeṇādharmaphalena na saṃbadhyata ityucyate' iti; tadasat, 'yasya nāhaṃkṛto bhāvaḥ' iti viśeṣaṇavaithryāt| aviduṣo'nyasyāpi tanmate kartṛtvābhāvāt| tasminnapi ca karmaphalalepasya mithyātvābhyupagamāt| 'kathaṃ bhīṣmam' ityādeḥ praśnasya kaimutyena pratikṣepārtham imāllokāni ti sāmānyenocyate ityabhiprāyeṇāha na kevala miti| atra na hantī tyasya na nibadhyate iti vyākhyānamiti yojanā samīcine gatyatare saṃbhavati na yuktā| ato 'yasya nāhaṃkṛto bhāvaḥ', 'budviḥ yasya na lipyate' ityanayorhetusādhyabhāvenāvasthitayoḥ phalamapi hetusādhyabhāvena na hanti na nibadhyate ityanūdyata ityāha tata iti na nibadhyate ityanena karmasādhyamokṣavirodhiphalānanvayo vivakṣita ityabhiprāyoṇāha tatphalaṃ nānubhavatī ti| etena, 'kriyākāle nāhaṃkāraḥ, kriyāttarakāle mayā kṛtamiti pratisaṃdhānālepaḥ, na hanti, na nibadhyate ityubhābhyāmaihikāmuṣmikapratyavāyapratiṣedhaḥ' iti yojanāntaraṃ nirastam||17|| evaṃ sāttvikatyāgo viśodhitaḥ| atha tadarthaṃ 'nityasattvasthaḥ' ityādibhirbahudhā prāgarvāk ca prasaktā sattvopādeyatā niravaśeṣaṃ viśodhyā; tatra madhye karmacodanaprakārādikathanaṃ kathaṃ saṃgacchata ityatrāha sarva miti| karmacodanaprakāroktistadanubandhuṣu jñānādiṣu guṇatastraividhyaṃ prapañcayitumityarthaḥ| kartavyakarmaviṣaya mityādi| jñānajñeyajñātṛ śabdāḥ sāmānyaviṣayā api karmacodanātraividhyārthatvāt viśeṣaparā iti bhāvaḥ| etena jñānaśabdasyātra śātraparatvavyakhyā nirastā| pravartakavacanarūpacaidanāsvarūpavilakṣaṇānāṃ jñānādīnāṃ kathaṃ codanābhedatvoktirityatrāha bodhabodhyabīddhṛyukta iti| jñānādīnāṃ codanānubandhitvamātreṇa vidhā śabdoktaṃ prakāratvamityarthaḥ| evaṃ trividhaḥ karmasaṃgrahaḥ ityatra hetudvayasahitasvarūpeṇa traivadhyam| anuktaviṣayatraividhyāntaroktiśaṅkāvyudāsāya triṣvanyatamaṃ vivicyata ityāha tatre ti| saṃgraha śabdasya karmaṇi vyutpattimāha saṃgṛhrata iti| karmaiva saṃgraha iti karmadhārayaḥ| karmaṇo vā saṃgrahaḥ| 'vrīhibhiryajeta' ityādipratipāditaṃ kriyākaraṇamiha karaṇaśabdenocyate| phalāpekṣayā tu karmaṇa eva karaṇatvādityabhiprāyeṇāha sādhanabhūtaṃ dravyādika miti| ādiśabdena jātyādigrahaṇam| nanvatra jñāyate'neneti jñānaṃ, tadeva karaṇamityucyate; jñānāditrayameva hi karaṇakarmakartṛśabdairvivṛtamiti yuktam; ata eva hi jñānaṃ karma ca kartā cetyanantarānuvādasaṃgatiriti cet -- maivam; śabdasvārasyābhāvāt, uktamātrasya ca śabdāntareṇa punarabhidhāne prayojanābhāvāt; uktāvāntaravibhajanasya tu vivekopayuktatvāditi bhāvaḥ| kartṛkaraṇasamabhivyāhārāt karmaśabdo'pi kārakaviśeṣaviṣaya iti śaṅkāmapākaroti karma yāgādika miti| kriyāsvarūpaṃ hi guṇatastrividhaṃ vibhakṣyate iti bhāvaḥ| niyojyāvasthatayā parijñāteti nirdiṣṭa eva anuṣṭhātravasthatayā punaḥ karmaśeṣatayā tatprakāratvena karte ti vyapadiśyata ityāha kartā anuṣṭhāte ti||18|| 'jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ parijñātā' ityuktā eva padārthāḥ jñānaṃ karma ca kartā cetyanūdyante| jñātṛtvakartṛtvayoravasthābhedamātratvāt jñānoktyaiva jñāturapi sidverihānuktiḥ; jñeśabdasya ca karmaviṣayatvāt| karaṇaṃ tu karmānupraviṣṭatvānna pṛthagvibhakṣyate| guṇasaṃkhyāna śabdena sāṃkhyarādvāntavivakṣāyāṃ pramāṇābhāvāt prakṛte cā nupayogāt guṇasvarūpagaṇane ca jñānāderanupraveśābhāvāt guṇakāryagaṇana ityuktam| yathāvacchṛṇu -- yathāvacchravaṇayogyamavadhānaṃ kurvityarthaḥ| yathāvaditi vivakṣitaṃ prakāramāha guṇato bhinnānī ti||19|| sāttvikajñānādikathanaṃ kartṛtve guṇapāratantryajñāpanārthaṃ| sarvabhūta śabdābhipretamanātmavidbhiranusaṃhitaṃ bāhravaicitryamāha brāāhṛṇe tyādinā| jñānaśabdasyātra prakṛtakarmacodanānubandhikarmānuṣṭhānadaśābhāvi jñāpanaparatvāt karmādhikāriṣvi ti bhūtāni viśeṣitāni| bhāva śabdo'tra padārthaparyāyaḥ| eka miti jātyaikyavivakṣayocyate; ātmabahutvasya prāgeva samarthitatvāt, advaitadarśanaṃ sāttvikajñānamiti paroktasya nirmūlatvāt; nānābhāvā niti cānantaraṃ bahutvokteḥ, sāmyānusandhānaprapañcanasyātra pratyabhijñānāt, karteti prakṛtapratyagāmaviṣayatvaucityena paramātmaparatvāyogāccetyabhiprāyeṇāha ātmākhyavamiti| sitadīrghe tyādinā, "gavāmanekavarṇānāṃ kṣīrasya tvekavarṇā" ityādiśrūtisūcanam| atra sarvabhūta śabdena brāāhṛṇatvādijātigrahaṇāt guṇādyavāntaravibhāgaparo vibhakta śabda iti ca bhāvaḥ| kenākāreṇaikatvamityatrāha jñānākārava iti| pratiṣidhyamānasya vyayasya prasañjakamāha vyayakhabhāveṣvapī ti| prāguktaṃ phalādisaṅgarūpavikṛtirāhityamapyavikṛtatvapareṇā vyaya śabdena saṃgṛhītamityāha phalādisaṅgānarhaṃ ce ti| saṅgo 'tra saṃbandhaḥ; anubhava ityarthaḥ| icchāparatve'pi bhogo'rthasidvaḥ| karmacodanānubandhijñānaphalakatvāt karmādhikāravelāyā mityukt| mayedaṃ kartavyamityanusaṃdhānadaśāyāmityarthaḥ| yena jñānena īkṣate viṣayīkarotītyarthaḥ||20|| pṛthaktvādiśabdānāṃ punaruktiparihārāyāha brāāhṛṇādyākārapṛthaktvene ti| sarveṣu bhūte ṣviti viśiṣṭānuvādaḥ; tatra bhāvā niti viśeṣyaniṣkarṣa ityabhiprāyeṇāha ātmākhyānapi bhāvā niti| pṛthaktvena ca pṛthagvidhān pṛthaktvena viśeṣitānityarthaḥ| jātibhedaviśeṣyabhedaguṇādibhedaparatayā pṛthaktvanānāpṛthagvidha śabdānāmapunaruktiḥ| uktavyatirekaparatayā phalādisaṃyogayogya tvoktiḥ jñānaṃ vettī ti kartṛtvopacāraḥ||21|| kārya śabdo'tra notpattipātraparaḥ; tasyāpi hetuḥ prāguktaparimitaśaktīnāmārādhanatvamityabhiprāyeṇāha ekasmin kartavye karmaṇi pretabhṛtagaṇādyārādhanarūpe'tyalpaphala iti| karmasvarūpakāryamātrasyāpi saṅgayogyatvābhāvaḥ tatrāpi phalavivakṣāyāmāha kṛtstraphalavadi ti| kṛtstraphalahetubhūtakarmaṇīvetyarthaḥ| kāryabhūtasya jñānasya saṅgasya vā kāraṇamātraniṣedhāyogāt prekṣāvatsaṅgaheturiha pratiṣidhya ityāha vastuta iti| ahaituka miti pāṭhe'pi haitukādanyatvavivakṣayā'yamevārtho grāhraḥ| pūrvavadeve ti| rājasavadityarthaḥ| ekasmin kārye saktamahetukamityanenaivālpaphalatvasidveḥ khadyotaprakāśavat svarūpatā evālpatvaṃ svārasikamalpaśabdena vivakṣitamityapunaruktirityabhiprāyoṇa atyalpaphalaṃ ca pretubhūtādyārādhana viṣayatvādalpaṃ ce tyuktam| "sattvāt saṃjāyate jñānam" iti pūrvoktaṃ tu rājasatāmasajñānayorajñānatvavivakṣayā| uktaṃ hi "etajjñānamiti proktamajñānaṃ yadato'nyathā" iti|| adhikāryeśene ti| avibhaktatvavibhaktatvādiviśeṣitakarmādhikārisvarūpānusaṃdhānenetyarthaḥ| viśiṣṭe karmaṇi viśeṣaṇatayā'dhikāriṇaḥ aśaṃtvoktiḥ| yadyapi saṅga śabdo vibhajya phalasaṅgakartṛtvatyāgapratipādane viśeṣaviṣayaḥ, tathā'pi saṅgarahitamityatra saṃkocakābhāvādapekṣitatvācca kaṇṭhoktaphalaprepsātiriktasāmānyaviṣaya ityāha kartṛtvādisaṅgarahita miti| ādi śabdena mamatā gṛhrate| 'muktasaṅgo'nahaṃbādī' ityādikathitaḥ kartṛdharma iha taddvārā karmaviśeṣaṇatvena yojitaḥ| brāhṛṇi rāgāt saṃsāradveṣācca kriyamāṇasya karmaṇaḥ kathamarāgadveṣataḥ kṛtatvamityatrāha kīrtirāgādakīrtidveṣācce ti| saṅga śabdapunaruktiścānena parihmatā| akārasyāsamastatvavivakṣāyā vā phalitoktivivakṣayā vā na kṛta mityuktam| 'tapo dambhena caiva yat' ityādyuktapratiṣedhārthamidamityabhiprāyeṇāha adambhen ti| kāryamityeve ti sāttvikatyāgasmāraṇam||23|| kāmepsunetya nena aphalaprepsunetyuktaviparītokiṃta vyanakti phalaprepsune ti| saṃbandhasāmānyaṣaṣṭhayā'tra samāsaḥ| atra vikalpādyasaṃbhavāt vāśabdaścārtha ityuktam| pravṛttipradhānarajobhūlatayā anupayuktaprayāsamiśraṇāt bahulāyāsa tvam| tatra ca sarvatra svayameva heturityabhimānaḥ sāhaṃkāra śabdena vivakṣitaḥ| tata eva bahulāyāsa padaṃ ca saprayojanamityabhiprāyeṇāha bahulāyāsamidaṃ karma mayaive ti||24|| kṣaya śabdena tādātvikārthavyayadoṣavivakṣaṇādupasargaśaktyā ca anubandha śabda etatsaṃbandhitayā paścādbhāviduḥ khapara ityāha kṛte karmaṇī ti| hiṃsā svaviṣayā paraviṣayā cetyabhiprāyeṇa tatra prāṇīpīḍe ti sāmānyoktiḥ| daivapratisaṃbandhinaḥ pauruṣasya puruṣasaṃbandhiddaṣṭasāmagrīsamavadhānarūpatāmāha ātmanaḥ karmasamāpanasāmathrya miti| bhaviṣyato'nubandhādeḥ sākṣātkārāsaṃbhavāt yuktibhirāgamaiśca aparāmarśo' trānavekṣaṇa mityāha avimṛśyate ti| anubandhādyajñānasya pṛthaguktatvāt prakāntākartṛtvajñānapratyanīko'tra moha śabdārthe ityāha paramapuruṣe ti||25|| anahaṃvādī tyanena kartṛtvābhimānarūpasaṃgasya pṛthaṅniṣedhāt muktasaṅga ityatra saṅgaśabdaḥ saṃkucitaviṣaya ityāha phalasaṅgarahita iti| tata eva karmaṇi svakīyatānusandhānarūpasaṅgo'pi pratiṣiddhaḥ| ahaṃvadanaśīlaḥ ahaṃvādī; tadanyo'nahaṃvādī; tatrā manaḥ pūrvā hi vāgityabhiprāyeṇāha kartṛtbābhimānarahita iti| kartṛtvasya vivicyamānatvāt tadupayuktā dhṛtiriha vivakṣitetyāha ārabdha iti| prayatnarūpasyotsāhatasya kartṛśabdenaiva siddhavāt rājasādikartṛsādhāraṇyāñca viśeṣavivakṣāmāha udyuktacetasttva miti| muktasaṅga ityanena svargādiphalasaṅganivṛteruktatvāt siddhayasiddhayornirvi kāra ityasyaddaṣṭaphalaviṣayatāmāha yududāviti| muktasaṅgatvaphalaṃ vā nirvikāratvam||26|| karmaphalaprepsu rityanenānuśravikasvargādiphalarthitvasyābhidhānāt rāgī ti ānuṣaṅgikaddaṣṭauphalasaṅgavivakṣāmāha yaśorthīti| apātrāvyayādirāhitasya guṇatvāt karmāpekṣite ti viśeṣitam| "kāmamātmanaṃ bhāryāṃ putrāṃ voparundhyāt na tveva dāsakarmakaram" ityādyuktaviparītasvabhāvatā'trā hisātmakaśabdena vivakṣitetyāha parāntīḍayitveti| kartṛtvopayogāya tai karma kurvāṇa iti phalitoktiḥ| evaṃ karmāpekṣitaśuddhirahita ityapi| na hi darśanasparśanādiyogśucitvamātreṇa karmaṇyatāniṣpatiriti bhāvaḥ|| avadhānābhāvādeḥ prākṛta ityādinā sidveḥ ayukta śabdena anarhatvaṃ vivakṣitamityāha śāstrīye ti| aśuci śabdanirdiṣṭāt rājasasyāyagyatvādadhikamayogyatvamiha vivakṣitamityāha vikamarmastha iti| evaṃ hi tasyāyogyatātiśayaḥ; yathā "śaivān pāśupatān spṛṣṭā lokayatikanāstikān| vikarmasthān dvijān śūdrān sacelo jalamāviśet||" … iti| śātrādhyayanatadarthopadeśādijanitasāttvikakarmānuṣṭhānānuguṇaviśeṣarāhityaṃ prākṛta śabdena vivakṣitamityāha anadhigatavidya iti| pūjyeṣvapi tvaritāvaśyakartavyayathocitapraṇādyārambhaviparītaṃ stimitasvabhāvatvamiha stabdhaśabdārtha ityāha anārambhaśīla iti| gūḍhavipriyakṛttvaṃ śaṭa tvam| tacca prakaraṇāt śāstroditatāmasakarmadvāretyāha abhicārādikarmaruci riti| punaruktiparihārāya māyāpratāraṇādilaukikarmadvārā naikṛtikatvamāha vañcanapara iti| 'śvaḥ kāryamadya kurvīta' iti nyāyāt śāstrīyaṣu tvaritena bhavitavyam| tadvaiparityamihā''lasyam| tatrānārambhasya stabdha śabdenoktatvāt ārabdadheṣvi ti| viṣādī tyatra dhātorevāvasādārthatvāt upasargeṇa tatprakarṣaḥ, pratyayena tācchīlyaṃ ca vivakṣitamityāha atimātrāvasādaśīla iti| avasādaśca lakṣito vākyakāreṇa, "deśakālavaiguṇyacchokavastvādyanusmṛteśca tajjaṃ dainyamabhāsvaratvaṃ manaso'vādaḥ"iti| prārabdakarmaṇāṃ śīghramasamāpanarūpamandapravṛttitvā deralasā diśabdena nirdiṣṭhatvāt avayavaśakteḥ śaṭhādisamabhivyāhārasya cānuguṇadīrghasītratvaṃ viśinaṣṭi abhicārādikarma kurvan pareṣu dīrghakālavatryanarthaparyālocanaśīla iti| 'sūtra sūtraṇe' iti dhātuḥ| sūtraṇaṃ cintanam; tācchīlyārthapratyayaḥ; dīrghasūtraṇāt dīrghūsūtrī| niraparādhaśakuntādigrahaṇārthadīrghasūtrakartṛsamānatayā dīrghasūtrītyaupacārarikagrahaṇaṃ tu mandamiti bhāvaḥ||28|| jñānatraividhyamuktam; punarbudvitraividhyaṃ vakṣyate; tatra paryāyatayā punaruktiśaṅkāṃ parihartumuktasya viśeṣaviṣayatāmanuvadati evaṃ kartavyakarmaviṣayajñāna iti| prakṛtopayuktamanantaraṃ prastūyata iti saṃgatyabhiprāyeṇāha idānī miti| jñānatraividhyaṃ pūrvoktam punariha traividhyakathanaṃ kimarthamiti śaṅkāyāmanuṣṭhā daśābhāvyanusaṃdhānādvilakṣaṇastadvetatayā tataḥ pūrvabhāviśāstrādijanyo'dhyavasāya iha budvi śabdārtha ityāha sarvatattvasarvapuruṣārthaniścayarūpāyā iti| etena 'jñānaṃ budvarvṛttiḥ, budvistu vṛttimati' iti paroktaṃ nirastam| tadeva vyanakti budvirbivekapūrvakaṃ niścayarūpaṃ jñānamiti| vivekapūrve -- pakṣāntarapratikṣepaparyantavicārapūrvamityarthaḥ| prastutatrividhānuṣṭhānopayuktaprakāreṇa trividhāyā dhṛtessādhāraṇaṃ rūpamāha ārābdhāyā iti| ayamapi saṃphalpadāḍharyādirūpo budvisvabhāvaviśeṣa eva| guṇato vibhakte vācye vacane cāsaṃkīrṇasvarūpe'nvayāt trividhapṛthaktva śabdayorapuruktimāha trividhaṃ bhedaṃ pṛthaktvena procyamāna miti| evaṃ budvayādikāryakātnryaparasya aśeṣeṇe tyasya śravaṇe'nvayādapunaruktiḥ yathāvacchṛṇviti darśitā| sāvadhānaṃ saṃśyaviparyayarahitaṃ śvṛṇvityarthaḥ| digvijaye mānuṣadaivadhanavat śamādidhanaṃ ca jetavyamiti saṃbuddherbhāvaḥ||29|| kāryākārya śabdābhyāṃ punaruktiśaṅkāparihārāya "ityādyanusāreṇa pravṛttinivṛttiśabdayoḥ pradhānakarmaviṣayatvamāha abhyudayasādhanabhūta ityādinā| rājasatāmasabudvayoḥ ayathavadi tyādiviśeṣaṇāt ihārthatastannivṛttervivakṣitatvajñāpanāya yathāvasthita tvoktiḥ| kāryākārya śabdayoriha prakṛtapradhānakarmetikartavyatābhūtaddaṣṭāddaṣṭavyāpāraparatvamāha sarvavarṇānāmi tyādinā| tatra sūkṣmadhīvedyatvāya deśakālāvasthāviśeṣeṣvita ti viśeṣitam| smaryate hi, "śarīraṃ balamāyuśca vayaḥ kālaṃ ca karma ca| samīkṣya dharmavit budvayā prāyaścittāni nirdiśet||" iti; "deśaṃ kālaṃ tathā''tmānam"… ityādi ca| atra śakyāśakyayorapi kāryākāryaśabdābhyāmeva grahaṇam| bhayābhayayossvarūpajñānasya sarvasādhāraṇatvādiha tannimittajñānaṃ vivakṣitam; tacca prākaraṇakaviśeṣaviṣayamamāha śāstrātivṛttirbhayasthāna miti| bibhetyasmāditi bhayam; sarvapraśāsiturīśvarādenava hi tattvavidāṃ bhayamabhayaṃ ca| na hi tatpreraṇamantareṇa kenacidvādhitumabādhituṃ vā śakyam| tatastadājñānuvṛttyativṛttī eva bhayābhayanimittamiti bhāvaḥ| bandhamokṣasadbhāvajñānasyāpi sādhāraṇyāt yāthātmya miti viśeṣitam| bandhasya mithyātvādivādaḥ mokṣasya pāṣāṇavadbhāvādimataṃ ca yathātmya śabdena vyudastam| vettī ti kartṛtvopacāraḥ; svācchandyena viṣayīkarotītyarthaḥ||30|| dhṛtisādhanaṃ
