dharma iti vyutpattyā dharmaśabdasya pravṛttinivṛttidharmasādhāraṇyādubhayaprasaṅgācca pūrvoktaṃ dvividhami tyuktam||31|| tāmasī tyanenaiva tamomūlatvasidveḥ tamasā''vṛtte tyanena tādātvikatamonirudvaprasaratvaṃ vivakṣitamityāha tamasā''vṛttā satī ti| savārthā nityanena sidvasādhyarūpasamastānuktasaṃgrahamāha santaṃ cārthamasanta mityādinā| etena bāhrānāṃ kuddaṣṭīnāṃ ca mataṃ tāmasamiti darśitam| uktaṃ ca manunā, "yā vedabāhrāḥ smṛtayo yāśca kāśca kuddaṣṭayaḥ| sarvāstā niṣphalāḥ pretya tamoniṣṭhā hi tāḥ smṛtāḥ" iti| atra rājasatāmasabudvayoriyān viśeṣaḥ -- asamagravedanamanyathāvedanaṃ ca rājasyām; yathāvanna jānāti iti vyākhyānāt; tāmasyāṃ tu sarvaṃ viparītaṃ manyate, sarvārthān ityukteri tyeke| anye tvāhuḥ prakārānyathātvaṃ prakārthanyathātvaṃ ca viśeṣaḥ| yadyapi ubhayatrādhiṣṭānabhūte dharmiṇyatadvarme evādhyasyate; tathā'pi svanirūpakadharmavaiparītye tāmasatā; yathā śuktirajatamabhrame; nirūpitasvarūpaviśeṣakadharmavaiparītye tu rājasatā; yathā pītaśaṃkhabhrama iti||32|| rājasadhṛto trivargokterapavargasādhanabhūto yoga iha vivakṣitaḥ; cānanyopāsanameva prāganuśṭiṣṭamityāha yogo mokṣasādhanabhūtaṃ bhagavadupāsana miti| phalāntarasaṅgo'tra vyabhicāraḥ; yogasya tannirodhakaraṇaṃ svarūpataḥ phalataśca mahānandarūpatvenetyāha yogoddeśena pravṛttāḥ tatsādhanabhūtā ityuktam| mānasī kriyā tāvat sākṣāt karaṇam| prāṇakriyā'pi; "yatra manastatra vāyuryatra vāyustatra manaḥ"ityanyonyapariṣvaṅgāt| yathocyate, "punarvāyupathaṃ prāpya mano bhramati vāyuvat"… iti| tathā prāṇāyāmaprakriyayā ca yogavirodhikleśapāpādijayahetutvāt| bāhrendriyākriyā tu "svādhyāt yogamāsīta yogāt svādhyāyamāmanet| svādhyāyayogasaṃpattyā paramātmā prakāśate||" ityādibhirutthānakālabhāviyogāṅganiṣevaṇarūpeṇa, pratyāhāre nirudhyamānarūpeṇa vā||33|| prasaṅga śabdo'tra na prāsaṅgikatvārthaḥ, tadanupayogāt| dhṛteḥ svavyāpāraviṣayatvāya prakṛtaprakriyānusārāya ca dharmādiśabdaistattatsādhanalakṣaṇoktā| sāmānyasyāpi phala śabdasyāstra sāttvikatyāgaphalādapavargāt saṅkocāyāha phalākāṅkṣītyatrāpī ti| lākṣaṇikaprayogābhipretaṃ vivṛṇvan śabdo'rthatasca phalitamāha ata iti||34|| svapna śabdo'tra suṣupterapyupalakṣaka ityabhiprāyeṇāha nidrā miti| daivagatonmādādivyavacchedāya durnitumūlatvaṃ madasyātra darśayati viṣayānubhavajanita miti| asvādhīnānāṃ svapnādīnāṃ kathaṃ puruṣeṇa dhāraṇamiti śaṅkayāmatrāpi hetulakṣaṇā pūrvavadityāha svapnamadāvuddeśye ti svapnamadayossuvābhimānā spadatayā bhayādeḥ pṛthakkṛtya vyākhyānam| durmedhāḥ| durmedhastvādityarthaḥ| dhāraṇamevātra moktavyatva sūcanāya na vimuñcatītyucyata ityabhiprāyeṇāha na vimuñcati ghārayatī ti| na cātra bhīrordhṛtirvirudveti vācyam, āgāmyanavekṣaṇena durmatestadvetvanuvartanaparatvāt| bhayadāyī viṣayo durmānamalaprabalavirodhājuḥ; śokadāyī tu krodhādimūlabandhavadhādiḥ; viṣādadāyī tu vṛthāvittavyayādiḥ||35|| anantaragranthasaṃgatyarthaṃ tu śabdadyotitaṃ vyanakti pūrvoktā iti| bharatarṣabha śabdo'tra prakṛṣṭasāttvikasukhasaṅkayogayatājñāpanārthaḥ| idānī miti| sādhana bhedasyoktasya sādhyabhedākāṅkṣāvasara ityarthaḥ|| āpatamadhuratvābhāvāt sāttvikasukhasyābhyāsasāpekṣatvam| loke'pyābhyāsikī kṣudrā prītirasti; tadvuyādāsāya krameṇa niratiśayāmi tyuktam| ratim atyantādaramityarthaḥ| duḥ kha śabdasyātra saṃkocakābhāvāt kṛtstraviṣayatvoktiḥ||36|| abhyāsasāpekṣatvaduḥ khāntahetutvayoḥ prayojakarūpemanantaramucyata ityabhiprāyeṇāha tadeva viśinaṣṭī ti| yattadi ti|tacchabdaśiraskeṇa yacchabdenānuvādaḥ śrutyādiprasiddhataratvadyotanāya| tatsukhamiti prītyatideśaḥ| viṣayamivetyanena āpātaprātikūlyāmātraṃ vivakṣitamityāha duḥkhamive ti| anenamandatīnāṃ jihāsāspadatvaṃ darśitam| na hi sukhaṃ nāma kiṃcidustu viṣavat amṛtavañca pariṇamate; atastadupacaritamāha abhyāsabalena viviktātmasvarūpāvirmāvala iti| buddherātmīyatvādimātrokteḥ aphalatvāt ātmaviṣayetyuktam| buddherayogyaviṣayasaṃrgarūpakāluṣyanivṛttirhi prasāda ityabhiprāyeṇāha nivṛttasakaletaraviṣayatva miti| jarāmaraṇādinivartakatvāt bhogyatamatvena hātumaśakyatvāñcamṛtopamatvam| paraśeṣataikarassasya svarūpasya yathāvadāvirbhāve paramātmānubhavasukhāyāntarnītatvādiha pṛthaganuktiḥ||37|| viṣayāṇāṃ tattadindriyārthānāmannapanādīnāmityarthaḥ| sukhatānimittakṣūdādau nivṛtte iti rājasamukhasya ddaṣṭasasukhasya ddaṣṭaprātikūlyanidānoktiḥ| yaduktaṃ bhāgavatā parāśeṇa, "agneḥ śītena toyasya tṛṣā bhaktasya ca kṣudhā| kriyate sukhakartṛtvaṃ tadvilomasya cetaraiḥ||" iti| "kṣuttṛṣṇopaśamaṃ tadvacchītādyupaśamaṃ sukham| manyate bālabuddhitvādduḥkhameva hi tat punaḥ||" iti ca| dṛṣṭasukhatānimittanivṛttāvupekṣaṇīyatāmātravyāvṛttyarthaṃ duḥkhodarkatvaṃ pariṇāme viṣamive tyanena vyajyate| pāradārikarasādīni hi bhayādibhūyiṣṭhakṣaṇikudratarasukhāni anantarakālabhāvyatighoraniratiśayaduḥkhāya bhavantītyāgāmikaṃ viṣatvamāha nirayādinimittatvāditi||38|| anabudhyata itya nubandho vipākaḥ| mohana śabadasyātra bhāvārthānanvayāt karaṇārthatvamāha mohahetu riti| nidrādijanyasukhasya viparītajñānahetutvābhāvāt moho'tra yathāvasthitavastvaprakāśa ityuktam| rājasasukhasya vipāke mohahetutvam, tāmasasukhasya tu tadānīmapīti lokasiddhamityabhiprāyeṇoktaṃ vivṛṇoti nidrādayo hīti| spaṣṭa miti na yuktyāgasāpekṣamityarthaḥ| alasasya pravṛttyabhāvamātraṃ dṛśyate, na jñānābhāva ityatrāha ālasyamindriyavyāparāmāndya miti| tataḥ kimittyatrāha indriyo ti| karaṇavyāpāratāratamyānuguṇaṃ hi kāryatāratamyam| jñānasya māndyaṃ cālpaviṣayatvam| tacca viṣayāntaprakāśābhāvagarbhamiti bhāvaḥ| pramādasya svarūpeṃṇaivāpekṣitājñānarūpatāmāha kṛtyānavadhānarūpa iti| evamālyasya pramādayorajñānānuvidvatvaṃ darśitam; tadvetutvaṃ tu kathamityatrāha tataśce ti| jñānasyāpaṭutvaṃ hi kramādatyantājñāne viśrāmyatīti bhāvaḥ| nidrāyāḥ sukhahetutvamāyāsaviśramahetutvādibhiḥ, vicchedakeṣu roṣācca lokasdvam; indriyavyāpārāndyasyāpyaṅgasaṃkṣobhādinivṛttidvārā; anavadhānasya tu budverekāgratākalpanarūpaprayāsanivṛttyeti| sukhābhāsaprasaṅgenākālanidrādikaṃ nopādeyamityuktaṃ bhavati| smaranti ca, "yāmadvayaṃ śayānastu brāhṛbhūyāya kalpate" ityādi| āhu ścāyurvedavidaḥ, " akāle'tiprasaṅgācca na ca nidrā niṣevitā| sukhāyuṣī parākuryāt kālarātririvāparā" iti| guṇakṛtavibhāgaprakaraṇatātparyamanuṣṭhānaparyavasānarūpaprayojanenopasaṃharati ata iti||39|| prākṛtaguṇātītaśudvasattvamayabhagavatprāptilakṣaṇamokṣāt prāk niyatadeśakālaphalabhogairuccāvacaissarvairapi kṣetrajñaiḥ uktasya triguṇasya niśśeṣadustyajatvamukhena guṇakāryaprakaraṇaṃ nigamyate na tadastī ti ślokena| guṇatrayaprakaraṇaṃ tu nātropasaṃhmatam, anantaramapi 'svabhāvaprabhavairguṇaiḥ' ityukteḥ| divi devaṣvi ti sattvottaradeśādhikāriṇāmupalakṣaṇam| tattulyatayā pṛthivyā mityādi manuṣyādiṣvi ti rājasatāmasādhikārivivakṣākhyānam| "hiraṇyargarbho bhagavān" ityādyanusāreṇa bahuvacanābhipretamāha brāhṛādiṣvi ti| guṇaprakaraṇāt khatva śabdasya guṇaviśeṣārthatābhramavyudāsāya prāṇi śabdaḥ| samudāyarūpeṇāpi nirdhāryamāmaṇeṣu tatrāpi guṇanirmukta na kiṃcit sattvamisyabhiprāyeṇa jāta śabdaḥ| jāta miti vā vyastam āsaṃsāraṃ janmaprabhṛti guṇabadvatādyotanārtham|| evaṃ sarveṣāṃ saṃsāriṇāṃ guṇatrayavaśyatvamuktam atha tattadgutāratamyavaddehayogināmadhikāriṇāṃ yathādhikāraṃ śāstrairvibhaktāni karmādīni vivicyante| tasya paramaprastutena saṃgatyarthamadhyāyārambhaprakāntaṃ pradarśayati tyāgene tyādinā| saṃnyāsaśabdārthādananya iti| śrutāvapi hi, 'tyāgenaike' 'saṃnyāsaṃyogāt' ityubhāvekaviṣayāviti bhāvaḥ| evaṃbhūtasye ti| trividhatyāgayuktasyetyarthaḥ| vṛttyā sahe ti| kṛṣigorakṣyādīni hi vakṣyamāṇāni jīvikāviśeṣā iti bhāvaḥ| atra brāāhṛṇakṣatriyaviśā miti samāso dvijatve sati vedādhikārāt| prācīnakarmānurūpaṃ sattvādiguṇavṛdviḥ prāgeva prapañcitā| ataḥ tadvetukaṃ karmātra tattadguṇapracurapuruṣāsādhāraṇadharmatayā svabhāva iti darśitama| etena "karmavaśyā guṇā hret sattvādyāḥ pṛthivīpate" iti vacanādaupādhikānāṃ guṇānāṃ cātra svabhāvikato pktyayu?phktiśaṅkā'pi nirastā| guṇavibhāgaprakāro brāāhṛpurāṇādiṣu prapañcitaḥ| tasyāyaṃ saṃkṣepaḥ, "tamaśśūde rajaḥ kṣatre brāāhṛṇe sattvamuttamam" iti| astārthe vadan prakṛtaṃ vivṛṇoti rajastamobhibhavenodbūtaḥ sattvaguṇa iti| uttama śabdasya, rajaḥ kṣatre ityādi ṣvapyanvayamāha kṣatriyasye tyādinā | alpodrikta iti śūdrāt vyavacchedāya| atīndriyāṇāṃ guṇānāmapi śāstrādhīna vibhāgatvāt karmapravibhāge guṇānāṃ kartṛtvādyasaṃbhavācca guṇaissahe tyuktam | guṇāpekṣayā śāstreṇa vibhaktatayā guṇa svarūpavibhāgasya śāstrādhīnatvābhāvādasaṃkīrṇabodhanaṃ vivikṣitamityāha pratipāditānī ti | vibhajya pratipādanaṃ vivṛṇoti brāāhṛṇādaya iti | karmaśabda eva sāmānyato vṛttimapi saṃgṛhṇāti; tādathryādvā tadākṣepa ityabhiprāyeṇāha vṛttayaśce ti | jīvanopāyā ityarthaḥ || śamo damaḥ' ityādau pūrvaṃ vyākhyātānāmapi guṇānāṃ punavryākhyānaṃ varṇānubandhena vidhāne avāntaraviśeṣaśaṅkāpākaraṇārtham, brāāhṛṃ karme tyuktakarmatvasiddhaye niyamanādirūpeṇa puruṣavyāpārasādhyatva jñāpanārthaṃ ca ataśśaucādāvapi tadāpādanaṃ grāhram | asti matirasyetyāstikaḥ; tadbhāva āstikyam | taccāprāmāṇi keṣu bhavat doṣāya | pratyakṣādisiddhe tu nāsāvatiśayaḥ | śāstrīyaṣvapi kvācitsaṃśayādau kudṛṣṭitvaprasaṅgaḥ | ato vaidika jhrārtha ṭa sya kṛtsnaye tyuktam | sahapaṭhitavijñānāderbhedajñāpanāya satyatāniścayasya prakṛṣṭatvoktiḥ | tat vivṛṇoti kenāpī ti | vaidikasya kṛtsnasye tyuktaṃ kudṛṣṭādyabhimatavaidikārthasaṃgrahavyudāsāya prādhānyena saṃkalayya vyanakti bhagavāni tyādinā | atra viśeṣaṇānāṃ prāgeva vyākhyātatvādiha...jhrna tatra vyāpriyate ....ṭa sarvavedavedānta vedya ityuktārthakramānusāreṇa viprakīrṇavākyoddhārakramaḥ | ślokārthaṃ nigamayati tadetadi ti | brāāhṛṇaḥ karma brāāhṛm brāhṛ śabdo'tra brāāhṛṇajātipara ityabhiprāyeṇāha brāāhṛṇasye ti ||42|| "śūraṃ bhīraṃ kaviṃ jaḍam" iti bhīrupratiyogini śūraśabda ityabhiprāyeṇāha nirbhayapraveśasāmathrya miti| mānasaśārīrasaṃvalanamidam| praviṣṭasya paraiḥ paribhave praveśo'pi doṣassyāt; atastatparihārāya teja ihoktamityāha parairanabhibhavanīyate ti| dākṣyāt dhṛterviśeṣo vighnopanipāte'pī ti| darśitaḥ| pravṛttisāmathryāt pravṛttāparityāgo hranya eva| yudve cāpī tyatra api śabdadyotitaṃ tīvaṃ phalāyananimittamāha ātmamaraṇaniścaye'pīti| atre śvarabhāva śabdena duṣṭanigrahaśiṣṭānugrahaśaktirvivakṣitetyabhiprāyeṇāha svavyatirikte ti| saphalajane ti svārāṣṭrādyavacchinnaviṣayam || rūḍhiṃ vyutpatiṃta cānusṛtya phalataḥ svarūpataśca kṛṣiṃ darśayati sasyotpādānaṃ karṣaṇa miti| evaṃ vāṇijyavyākhyāne'pi grāhram| gauḥ rakṣyā yatra, tat karma gokṣyamityabhiprāyeṇāha paśupālana miti| rakṣyamiti bhāvārthaṃ vā; rakṣaṇamityarthaḥ| gaurakṣya miti vā pāṭhaḥ| gāṃ rakṣatīti gorakṣuḥ; tasya karma gaurakṣyaṃ paśupālanam| vaṇijaḥ karma vāṇijya mitivat| evaṃ viśaḥ karma vaiśyam; "guṇavacana brāāhṛṇādibhyaḥ karmaṇi ca " iti vyañpratyayaḥ| śāstrāntarānusāreṇa paricaryāyāḥ prakṛtatritayānubandhitvamāha pūrvavarṇatraye ti| nanu ṣaṭkarmā brāāhṛṇaḥ| trikarmāṇau kṣatriyavaiśyau| śūdrāsyāpi, "bhāryāratiḥ śucirmṛtyabhartā śrādvakriyārataḥ| namaskāreṇa mantreṇa pañcayajñānna hāpayet||" ityādayau dharmo vidhīyante; tat kathamiha tatkarmaṇāmiyatānirdeśa ityatrāha tadeta diti| pradarśanīyān udāharati yajñādayo hī ti| pradarśanārthatve hetvantaramāha śamādayo'pī ti| śamādīnāṃ mokṣārthivarṇatrayasādhāraṇyena kathaṃ brāāhṛṇasyaiva taduktamityatrāha brāāhṛṇasya tvi ti| svabhāvaprabhavai riti pūrvoktānuvidhānāt sahajatvavivakṣāyā'tra svabhāvaja śabda ityabhiprāyeṇāha sattvodrekasya svābhāvāvikatvena śamadamādayassukhopādānā iti| tatkarmeti nonaktamityanvaḥ| uktānāṃ vṛttīnāṃ pradarśanārthatvāya caturṇāṃ vṛttyaṃśaṃ vivicya vivinakti brāāhṛṇasya vṛttirityā dinā| bhūdradharmo vṛttiśca yājñavalkyena smaryate, "śūdrasya dvijaśuśrūṣā tayā jīvan vaṇig bhavet| śilpairvā vividhairjīved dvijātihitamācaran" iti; manustatra viśeṣamāha, "viprasevaiva śūdrasya viśṣṭaṃ karma kītryate" iti; tadidamabhipretyāha śūdrasya tu kartavyaṃ vṛttiśca pūrvavarṇatrayaparicaryaive ti| nanvidayamuktam; bhāryāratirityāderuktatvāt; "māṃ hi pārtha vyāpāśritya"ityārabhya, "striyo vaiśyāstathā śūdrāste'pi yānti parāṃ gatim" iti ca svayamevāha; "vasante dīkṣayedvipram"ityārabhya "hemante śūdrameva ca| striyaṃ ca varṣākāle tu pañcarātravidhānataḥ"iti bhagavatsamārādhanārthe dīkṣā ca vihitā| tathā, "brāāhṛṇaiḥ kṣatriyairvaiśyaiśśūdraiśca kṛtalakṣaṇaiḥ| arcanīyaśca sevyaśca nityayuktaissvakarmasu| sāttvataṃ vidhimāsthāya gītassaṃkarṣaṇena yaḥ" iti dīkṣātaśūdrāderbhagavadarcanādikaṃ spaṣṭamuktam| tathā yugadharmān prakramyocyate, "kṛtaṃ nāma yugaṃ pūrve yatra dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ "| kṛtameva na kartavyam yasmin kāle narottama | brāāhṛṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāśśūdrāśca kṛtalakṣaṇāḥ | kṛte yuge samabhavan svakarmaniratāssadā | ekavedasamāyuktā ekamantravidhikriyāḥ | pṛthagdharmāstvekavedādharmamekamanuvratāḥ | cāturāśramyayuktena karmaṇā kālayoginā | akāmaphalasaṃyogāt prāpnuvanti parāṃ gatim ca, aṣṭāṅgayogayuktānāṃ hmadayāganilatātmanām | yogināmadhikāraḥ syādekas min hmadayeśaye | vyāmiśrayāgamuktānāṃ hmadyāganiratātmanām | yogināmadhikāraḥ syādekasmin hmadayākāśaye | vyamiśrayāgamuktānāṃ viprāṇāṃ vedavādinām | samantre tu catuvryūhe hradhikāro na cānyathā | trayāṇāṃ kṣatriyādīnāṃ prapannānāṃ ca tattvataḥ | amantramadhikārastu catuvryūhakriyākrame | sakriye mantracakre tu vaibhavīye vivekinām | mamatāsaṃnirastānāṃ svakarmaniratātmanām | karmavāṅmānasaiḥ samyagbhaktānāṃ parameśvare | caturṇāmadhikāro vai vṛte ityadhikāraviśeṣaniyamaḥ kṛtaḥ | saptame ca vratavidhānaparicchede, "dānercane tu śūdrāṇāṃ vratakarmaṇi sarvadā | asiddhānnaṃ tu vihitaṃ vā brāāhṛṇocchayā | svakarmaṇā yathotkarṣamabhyeti ca tathā'rcanāt | tasmāt svenādhikāreṇa kuryādārādhanaṃ sadā || sarvatrādhikṛto vipro vāsudevādipūjane | yathā tathā na kṣatrādyāstasmācchāstroktamācaret || nayennaktāśanairbhaktyā dinānyetāni maudgala | vratādyante tu vihitaṃ paripīḍaṃ hi tasya vā || iti vrataviśeṣakramo vauṣaṭ svāhāvaṣaṭkāraniṣṭhānāṃ tu pratikriyā | namaskāreṇa vihitā iti | tathā nāradīye śrīmadaṣṭākṣarakalpe, na svaraḥ praṇavo'ṅāni nāpyanyavidhayastathā | strīṇāṃ tu śūdrajātīnāṃ mantramātroktiriṣyate || iti | evamekādaśīvrātadayo'pi sarvasādhāraṇāḥ purāṇādiṣu paṭhante | tathā anye'pi vajryāvajryaniyamāḥ katikati dharmaśāstrādiṣu kathyante | yathā, kapilākṣīrapānena brāāhṛṇīgamanena ca | śūdre vedākṣareṇaiva niṣkṛtirna vidhīyate || , hmatkaṇṭhatālugābhistu yathāsaṃkhyaṃ dvijātayaḥ | śudhyeran strī ca śūdraśca sakṛtspṛṣṭābhirantataḥ , teṣāṃ sa evā''camanakalpaḥ |adhikamaharahaḥ keśaśmaśru lomanakhavāpanam ityādi | tasmāt, "japastapastīrthayātrā pravajyā mantrasādhanam| devatārādhanaṃ caiva strīśūdrapatanāni ṣaṭ||" ityādikaṃ vihitavyatiriktavarṇatrayaśūśrūṣāvirudvaviṣayamiti yojyam| api ca, "na śūdrābhagavadbhaktā viprā bhāgavatāḥ smṛtāḥ" ityādivacanāt, jayākhya saṃhitādiṣu bhāgavatānāṃ caturṇāṃ samatvavacanācca bhagavatparicaryāvaśāt varṇatrayaparicaryānivṛttirapi saṃbhavet| ataḥ kathaṃ śūdrasya tu kartavyaṃ vṛttiścapūrvavarṇatraparicaryaiveti bhāṣitam? -- atra brāūmaḥ -- yadyapi vihatavyatiriktaviṣayāḥ sarvaniṣedhāḥ; viśiṣṭasaṃskāraguṇaviśeṣādimatāṃ ca śūdrāṇāmapi dharmaviśeṣā vihitāḥ, tathā'pi te sarve varṇatrayapariryākhyapradhānadharmāvirodhena tanniyuktaiḥ śūdreḥ tatparicaryābhāvanayaivānuṣṭheyāḥ| ata eva hratrocyate paricaryātmakaṃ karme ti| anyathā paricaryetyeva vaktavyam| na ca niṣprayojanādhikagrahaṇa yuktam| āmananti ca rahasyāmnāyavidaḥ , "jñānajñāpanasaṃpreṣaṇakarmā brāāhṛṇaḥ, jñānaparitrāṇakarmā kṣatriyaḥ, jñānabījavardhanakarmā vaiśyaḥ, jānaparyutthānakarmā śūdraḥ| kṛtayugasyānte tretāyugasyādau brāāhṛṇakṣatriyavaiśyaśūdrā bhidyante| teṣāṃ bhinnānāṃ ddaṣṭhiḥ na tathā bhavati, pathyā rasanā na tathā bhavanti; puṣpaphalamoṣadhivanaspatayo na tathā dadhate; tāṃ ddaṣṭhvā brāāhṛṇakṣatriyavaiśyaśūdrāṇāmasūyā prādurbabhūva; śūdraḥ prathamajātiḥ, na vaḥ paryutthāsyāmīti, vaiśyo dvitīyajātiḥ na vo bījāni vardhayiṣyāmīti, kṣatriyayastṛtiyajātiḥ, na vaḥ paritrāsya iti; tān brāāhṛṇa ityāha, āsthitā yūyam; na vo vakṣyāmīti| atra paryutthānaṃ -- paricaryā| evaṃ "śūdrā bhagavadbhaktā" ityādistutivākyena varṇatrayaparicaryādinivṛttiprasaṅgo'pi pratyuktaḥ, bhagavadekāntaśūdrasyaiva paryutthānavidheḥ| bagavadbhaktistutiparatvādeva hi, "sarvavarṇeṣu te śūdrā ye hṛmaktā janārdane"iti vyatirekanindā| kiṃ tahrratra stutinindālambhanam? āntaraḥ sattvādiguṇomeṣaḥ; yadapekṣayā brāāhṛṇādereva brāāhṛṇyādikaṃ śrutyādiṣu kītryate, "amaunaṃ ca maunaṃ ca nirvidyātha brāhṛṇaḥ" iti| "viṣṇuṃ krāntaṃ" vāsudevaṃ vijānan vipro vipratvaṃ gacchate tattvadarśī , caṇḍālamapi vṛttasthaṃ taṃ devā brāāhṛṇaṃ viduḥ ityādi | yattu śarīrasattvādiguṇatāratasyanibandhinaśca dharmāstata evāvatiṣṭhante | ata eva hi vidita brāhṛvidyo'pi viduraḥ svasya tadvacane'nadhikāramāha, śūdrayonāvahaṃ jātonāto'nyadvaktumutsahe iti| śamādiguṇapauṣkalayogini tu śūdrādau, ruāīdharmiṇyāṃ janan yamivāvajñānādinivṛttimātraviśeṣāpekṣayā jātisāmānyavīkṣaṇapratiṣedha iti | yathā smaranti, etaiḥ sametaśśūdro'pi vārdhake mānamarhati iti | ata eva, bhaktiraṣṭavidhā hreṣā yasmin mlecche'pi vartate | tasmai deyaṃ tato grāhraṃ sa ca pūjyo yathā hraham || ityādikamanuplaparyantatayā'pi nivryūḍham |sāmyo ktirapi sa rvotkarṣaphalādisāmyaviṣayā; apaśudranayādyavirodhaśca | uktaṃ ācāryaiḥ, bhāgavatatvena śūdrasyot karṣe brāāhṛṇasyāpi tevaivātkarṣa iti punarvaiṣamyam' iti sarvaṃ samañjātam | ataḥ suṣṭhūkaṃ śūdrasya vṛttikartavyayoraik yamiti || varṇadharmavibhāge mokṣaśāstre kimartha ityatrāha svesve karmaṇī ti | saṃsiddhi śabdasyātra paramapadaprāptiviṣayatvaṃ prakara ṇāt siddham | śāsvatam padamavyayam iti hi vakṣyati | yadvā siddhi śabdaḥ "naiṣkamryasiddham' iti vakṣyāṇa viṣayaḥ | tatparyavasānajñāpanāyatra paramaprāpyagrahaṇam | nanu svakarma niratasyāpi śūdrasya kathaṃ paramapadaprāptiḥ? tasya hi mokṣasādhanavidyāyāmanadhikāraḥ śīrīrake apaśūdrādhikaraṇe śikṣitaḥ || satyam; bhavavāntarādhikāradvārā paramparayā paramapadaprāptervivakṣitatvānna virodhaḥ | vidurādivat jātismareṣu janmāntaraprārabdhaparavidyāpratisaṃdhāyiṣu svakarmaṇāmakaraṇanimittapratyavāyapirahārārthaṃ sākṣātsaṃsiddhiyogyatvaṃ draṣṭavyam | yathoktaṃ bhagavatā śonakena, dharma vyādhādayo'pyanye pūrvābhyāsājjugupsite | varṇāvaratve saṃprāptāḥ saṃsidiṃdha śramaṇī yathā iti |nanu parimitaphalapradānasamarthendrādyārādhanarūpāṇāṃ tattadvarṇāśramakarmaṇāṃ kathaṃ paramapadaprāptihetutmityatrottaraṃ svakarmanirata iti | yathe tyatya pratinirdeśatvāt ta cchabdaḥ prakāraparāmarśītyāha tathā śṛṇviti | sarvakāraṇabhūtaḥ sarvāntaryāmī paramātmā svasṛjyasvaśarīrabhūtendrādivācakaiḥ śabdairāmnāyata iti tatsamārādha natvāt saṃsaddhisādhanatvaṃ varṇāśramadharmāṇāmupapannamityucyate yataḥ pravṛtti riti ślokena | pravṛtti śabdasyātra ceṣṭāmātra paratvavyudāsāyāha utpattyādike ti | cetanācetanavāci bhūta śabdasamanvitaḥ pravṛtti śabdo'tra viśeṣakābhāvāt sarvavidha vyāpārasaṃgrāhaka iti bhāvaḥ | sarvavidhakāraṇatvopayukta ākāra ucyate yena sarvamidaṃ tata miti | tatam; niyantṛ tveneti hmadayam | ta miti parokṣatayā nirdiṣṭaḥ kathaṃ mā miti vyākhyāyata iti śaṅkāyāṃ yata ityanuvādasya prāptya rthaṃ purovādaṃ smārayati matta eve ti | kāraṇatvasarvādhikatvasarvavyāpitvasarvaniyantṛtvādiṣu yathāsaṃbhavaṃ vacanāni yojanāni || evaṃ varṇāśramadharmāṇāṃ svarūpeṇāparityājyatvaṃ paraprāptisādhanatvaprakāraśca darśitaḥ| atha teṣāmeva 'daivamovāpare yajñam' ityādyuktapradhānadharmayogena niyamaviśeṣādiyogena ca karmayogāntarbhūtānāṃ jñānayogādhikāriṇāmapyaparityājyatvaṃ prāguktaṃ pratyabhijñāpyate -- śreyān svadharmaḥ ityādibhiḥ| atra svadharma śabdo na varṇāśramaniyatadharmaparaḥ, tathā sati paradharma śabdena varṇāntarādidharmopādānaprasaṅgāt| na ca tat yuktam, tasya niṣidvatvenādharmatayā svadharmasya tatra praśasyataratvalakṣaṇaśreyastvavacanāyogāt; na hi pāpātpuṇyaṃ śreya iti kathyeta| ata eva "śreyo bhoktuṃ bhaikṣam" ityuktabrāhṛṇadharmabhūtapravrajyāpratiṣedho'yamiti cenna; tatprāptau niṣedhāyaugāt; aprāptau pāpātvadeva dattottaratvāt| āpatsvanantarā ca vṛttirdustyajā| ato'tra svadharmaparadharma śabdau prāgvat karmayogajñānayogaviṣayo vyākhyātau| eva mityārabhya svadharmaḥ ityantamekaṃ vākyam| anyathottaragranthānanvaprasaṅgāt| sva śabdasya jātivivakṣāvyudāsāyāha svenaive ti| svainaivopādātuṃ yogya ityuktaṃ vivṛṇoti prakṛtī ti | viguṇa śabdasya tyājyatvaśaṅkāparatvamāha viguṇo'pī ti | gatyantarābhāktādamukhyakalpatve nānumato'pītyarthaḥ | sva śabdanirdiṣṭātkarmayogārhādanyo'tra paraḥ; sa ca jñānayogārha ityabhiprāyeṇāha indriyajye ti| sapramādasya svanuṣṭhitvaṃ kathaṃ syādityatrāha kadāci diti | svabhāvaniyata mityatra jātiniyatatvaśaṅkāvyudāsāyāha tadeve ti | yathāviṣatarunimbatintriṇyādijātānāṃ jantūnāṃ svabhāvaniyata āhārā iti bhāvaḥ | kilbiṣa śabdo'trāniṣṭatamatvadyotanāya saṃsāraśabdena tatphalaryantatayā vyākhyā taḥ | jñānayoganiṣṭhāsaṃbhāvitaniṣedhāya vā, viśeṣaniṣedhaḥ śeṣābhyanujñāpara ityabhiprāyeṇa vā''ha jñānayogas ye ti || arthāntaraparatvaśaṅkāvyudāsāyā''darātiśayavivakṣayā, punaruktiparihārāya ca tṛtīyādhyāyoktaṃ smārayatī tyukta m | sahajatvena | vāsanāniyatatvādityarthaḥ | tataḥ kathaṃ tyājyatvābhāva ityatrāha sukara miti | doṣa śabdena pāpa vivakṣā na yuktā; vihite tadayogāt | tathā ca na tyaje diti na yuktam, pāpāṃśasya sarvaiḥ parityājyatvāt; ataḥ kāyakleśādimātragarbhatvamiha sadoṣatvamityucyate, tāvanmātre'pyalasānāṃ tyājyatābudghi syādityabhiprāyeṇāha saḥdukhamapī ti | etena kāpilamatānvāroheṇa sadoṣamapītyanuvāda iti vyākhyāntaraṃ nirastam | mumukṣoḥ kathaṃ śāstrīye śreyasvena cokta kṣudrakleśāsahatvena tyājyatābud ? ataḥ prasaṅgābhāvāt pratiṣedho na yukta ityatrāha jñānayogayogyo'pī ti | api śabdo'nyasya kaimutyajñāpanārthaḥ | akleśopāyadarśane svādhikāramapratisaṃdhāya tatra pravṛttiḥ syāditi tato niyamyata ityarthaḥ | saduḥkhatvanarduḥkhatvalakṣaṇavaiṣamyamanvāruhrāpramādatvavādirniyama uktaḥ; atha saduḥkhatvamapi dvayossamānamitye tayucyate sarvārambhā hī tyardhaina | karmārambhāḥ jñānārambhāśce tyanena sarva śabdasyātra prakṛtaśāstrīyakātsnaryaparatvamāha | duḥkha sāṃmye sati kimanyataraniyamena,kathaṃ ca jhrnaṭatattasya heturityatrāha iyā niti | karmārambheṣu kāyakleśamātram; jñānārambheṣu tu atyāsannatve'pi kaphoṇiguḍāyamānapratyagviṣayānveṣaṇena indriyamanoniyamanaprayāso duḥkhatmaka iti bhāvaḥ || sarvātrāsakabuddhiḥ ityukte'pi punaḥ vigataspṛhaḥ ityetat phalasaṅganivṛttirūpatyāgasahapaṭhitakartṛtva tyāgaviṣayatvaucityāt spnādiṣvapi svātmani kartṛtvānusandhānapasaṅganivṛttirūpatyāgakāṣṭhāvivakṣayetyāha ātmakartṛtve vigataspṛha iti | saṃnyāsenādhigacchatī ti na jñānayogādiparam; karma na tyaje diti prakṛtānanvayāt, adhyāyarambhoktasaṃnyāsaviṣayatvaucityāccetyabhiprāyeṇāha evaṃ tyāgādananyatvena nirṇītene ti | atra naiṣkamryasiddhi śabdo na mokṣaviṣayaḥ, sidiṃdha prāpta ityādinā punaḥ kavryavidhānāt; nāpi jñānayogamātraviṣayaḥ, paramā miti viśeṣaṇāt; naiṣkamrya śa bdamātreṇa ca tadvivakṣopapatteḥ | ato'tra jñānaniṣṭhāphalaprārambho vivakṣita ityabhiprāyeṇāha paramāṃ dhyānaniṣṭhā miti| naiṣ kamryasya siddhamiti samāsavaśāt paramatvaviśeṣaṇaśaktyā vā siddhaṃ vivṛṇoti jñānayogasyāpi phalabhūtā miti| uktārthaparatvamuttaragranthānuguṇyenāha vakṣyamāṇadhyānayogāvāptimi tyādinā | nirgatakarmā niṣkarmā, tasya bhāvo naiṣkamrya miti vyutpatiṃta vyanakti sarvendriyakarmoparatirūpā miti || sidiṃdha prāptaḥ ityasyoktānuvādatāṃ saprakārahetunirdeśenāha āprayāṇādi ti | sidiṃdha prāptasya brāhṛprāptya bhidhānāt tadvyatiriktaviṣayatvajñāpanāya dhyānasiddhi mityuktam | yathe tyasyānantaragranthānusāreṇa puruṣavyapāropādeya prāpakaprakāraparatāmāha yena prakāreṇa vartamāna iti | me nibodha | matto niścayenāvadhārayetyarthaḥ | parame phale hru pāyo nitiṣṭhati; atastadevopāyaparyavasānābhūmitayā niṣṭhetyucyata ityabhiprāyeṇāha tadeva brāhṛ viśeṣyata iti | jñānaśabdasyātrānantarocyamānadhyānaviśrāntimāha dhyānātmakasye ti || buddhi śabdo'tra prastutabrāhṛśabdābhipretaviṣayabuddhigocaraḥ, tasyāśśuddhiścāsamagraviṣayatvasaṃśayaviparyayarūpa doṣarāhityamityāha yathāvasthitātmattvaviṣaye ti | dhṛtye ti pūrvoktasaprakārasāttvikadhṛtiparāmarśamāha viṣayavimukhī karaṇene ti | atra dhṛtyā manoniyamanaṃ karmoktam; api ca pūrvameva tyaktaviṣayasya rāgadveṣau vyudasye ti vaiṣayikarāgadveṣayovryudāsasyāpi tādātvikaviṣayatvāya, vairāgyaṃ samupāśritaḥ ityanena punaruktiparihārā ya cāha tannimittā viti | etena viṣayāsannidhānaphalaṃ pradarśitam | yadvā viprakṛṣṭeṣvapi sūkṣmasaṅgo niroddhavya iti bhāvaḥ | vivikta tvaṃ rahitatvam;tat prakṛtopayogena viśinaṣṭi sarvaidhryānavirodhibhirvivikte deśa iti | laghvāśī ityanena pūrvoktaṃ "nātyaśnataḥ' ityādikaṃ smāryata ityāha atyaśanāśanarahita iti | dhṛtyā''tmānaṃ niyamya ce tyādinā yatavākkāyamānasaḥ ityasya punaruktiparihārāyāha dhyānābhimukhīkṛtakāyavāṅmanovṛtti riti | kāyasyābhimukhīkaraṇaṃ sthirāsanādiparigrahaḥ; vācastu praṇavādivyatiriktavarjanam; manasastu śubhāśrayālambanam | uktānāṃ dhyānayogaśeṣtvamāha evaṃbhṛtassanni ti | nitya śabdavivakṣitamāha āprayāṇādaharahari ti | rāgadveṣau vyudas yeti vaiṣayikarāgadveṣayovryudāsokteḥ, vairāgyaṃ samupāśrita ityetat ābhimānikaviṣayam | tatra samyagupāśrayaṇaṃ pūrvasiddhasyāpi jhrtasyaṭasamyagavasthāpanamityabhiprāyeṇa virāgatāṃ vardhayanni tyuktam | evamahaṃkārādivimocane'pi draṣṭa vyam | śarīramanaḥprāṇādibalānāṃ yogavirodhitvābhāvāt vāsanābala miti viśeṣitam | darpo'trāhaṃkārabalahetuko'ṅ kīkāraḥ | yogitvaśāntātvādinimitto'pi darpastyājyaḥsa, dṛpto dharmamatikrāmati', iti smaraṇāt | manovākkāyavyapāranivṛttyāderuktatvāt | śānta śabdo'tra śamahetuviśeṣapara ityāha ātmanubhavaikasukha iti | indriyavyapāroparatiḥ kodhādinivṛttiśca bāhrasukhanisspṛhatvāt; tacca prabhūtātmasukhalābhāditi bhāvaḥ | ukteṣu sarveṣu dhyānayogasyāṅgitvamāha evaṃbhūto dhyānayoga kurvanni ti | dhyānamevātra yogaḥ, dhyānena vā yogaḥ | antaraślokārthaparāmarśena brāhṛśabdasyātra śuddhātma viṣayamāha sarvabandhe ti | evaṃ karmayogādisādhyapratyagātmānubhavasya parabhaktyadhikārapādakatvamucyate brāhṛbhūtaḥ iti ślokena | tada bhiprāyeṇa paraśeṣataikasbhāvatvasyāpyāvirbhāva uktaḥ | yogasādhye brāhṛākhyamiha brāhṛtvamit yabhiprāyeṇācchinnajñānāvirbhāvoktiḥ | śeṣatvasya svarūpānubandhitvaṃ prāgevoktamityāha itastvanyā miti| "rāgādidūṣi te citte nāspadī madhusūdanaḥ ityādyuktaparabhaktyanarhatānivṛttiḥ prasannātme tyucyata ityāha kleśakar mādibhirakalmaṣasvarūpa iti | ādi śabdena vipākāśayogrrahaṇam; tayorapi kāluṣyarūpatvāt; kleśakarmavipākhayaiḥ avidyā'smitādayaḥ pañca kleśāḥ; karma puṇyapāparūpam; jātyāyurbhogāḥ vipākāḥ; āśayāḥ saṃskārāḥ | "yasmin sthito na duḥkhena guruṇā'pi vicālyate' iti prāguktaṃ na śocatī ti parāmṛṣṭam | tathā, "yaṃ labdhvā cāparaṃ lābhaṃ manayate nādhikaṃ tataḥ' ityuktaṃ na kāṅ kṣatī ti | smāritam | atra na hmaṣyatī ti pāṭhāntaramaprasiddhatvādanaṅgīkṛtam | tatrātmānubhavasukhena bāhravaitṛṣṇyaṃ tāvajjāyate; paramātmanastu pratyāgātmano'pyadhikasukhatayā śrutatvāt tadanububhūṣā sithāyinītyabhrāyeṇa madvyatiri kta p miti?ṭa śabdaḥ | śokakāṅkṣānudayahetuḥ sama ityucyata ityabhiprāyeṇa anādaraṇīyatāyāṃ sama ityuktam | tul yonādara ityarthaḥ | parāvaratattvavivekaphalam anyānādarasādhyaṃ vyanakti nikhila miti | vastujāta mityanena brāhṛādi stambaparyantānāmeva mervapekṣayā māṣasarṣapādīnāmivāvāntarotakarṣasyānādarayogyatvaṃ sūcitam | tṛṇa vaditi | na hi ratnaparvatamārurukṣoḥ palālakūṭe saṅgaḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ | atra mac chabdena parabhaktyutpattivivṛddhayarthatayā pūrvatra, śāstrāntareṣu ca prapañcitānāmupāsanadaśāyāmanusaṃdheyānāṃ ca ākārāṇāmabhipretatvamāha ma ya sarveśvara ityādibhiḥ | sarveśvara iti | īśitavyasya baddhasya kiṃ tatābhūtaiḥ īśitavyāntarairiti bhāvaḥ | nikhilajagadudayavibhavalayalīla iti | 'kāraṇaṃ tu dhyeyaḥ' iti hi śrutiriti bhāvaḥ| yadvā karaṇakalebapradānādibhirmahorakārake caturvidhabhūtahetubhūte tasmin tiṣṭati sṛṣṭisaṃhārakarmatayaivāvasthitaḥ ko'nyaḥ samāśrayaṇīya iti bhāvaḥ| nirastamamastaheyagandha iti| na hrasmin yathāvatpratīte vastvantareṣvivāvajñāvaimukhyādikāraṇamastīti bhāvaḥ| anavadhike tyādi| ekaikaguṇaprakarṣo'pi citākarṣarakaḥ; kimutaivaṃ saṃbhūta iti bhāvaḥ| yadvi paraṃ sulabhaṃ ca, tadeva hrāśrayaṇīyamiti saulabhyopayuktaguṇānāmapyatra saṃgrahaḥ| lāvaṇyāmṛtasāgara iti śubhāśrayavigrahaguṇopalakṣaṇam| śrīmatī ti| śrīhiṃ sarveṣāvāśrayaṇīyā; sā'pyenaṃ nityamāśriteti hmadayam| śrīyate śrayate ceti śrīśabdo niruktaḥ| matupnityayoge| śrutiśca, "hnīśca te lakṣmīśca patnyau" ityādikā| smaryate ca "nityaivaiṣā jaganmātā viṣṇośśrīranapāyinī" iti| etenopāsyatvaprāpyatvādikaṃ sarvaṃ sapatrīkasyeti jñāpitam| āmananti ca rahasyamnāya vida imamevārtham, "nityasannihitaśaktiḥ"iti| puṇḍarīkanayana ityavayavasaundaryopalakṣaṇam| "tasya yathā kapyāsaṃ puṇaḍarīkamevamakṣiṇī| tasyoditi nāma| sa eṣaḥ sarvebhyaḥ pāpmabhya uditaḥ| udeti ha vaisarvebhyaḥ pāpmabhyaḥ, ya evaṃ vedaḥ" iti sarvapāpavimokṣa kāmasyopāsanārthatayā pumaḍarīkākṣatvamapyupadiṣṭam| cakṣuṣā tava saumyena pūtā'smi ityādiṣau ca tadvikṣaṇasya pāvanatamatvamucyata iti bhāvaḥ| bhuktyutpattyādau sarvamidamekataḥ; svāmitvaṃ caikataḥ; na cāsāvekonasarvasvāmītyabhiprāyeṇāha svasvāminī ti||54|| tatphalamāhe ti| avyavahitaṃ vyavahitaṃ ceti śeṣaḥ| pūrvagranthoktadagatkāraṇatvalikṣitasarveśvarākhyaghamryabhiprāyeṇa ya ityasyārthamāha svarūpata iti| vidhiniṣedharūpaśodhakavākyavasitasarvavidyānusaṃdheyasvarūpanirūpakadharmayoghaḥ svabhāvata iti nirdiṣṭaḥ| svanirūpakadharmābhāve anirūpitasvarūpatayā niḥ svabhāvameva vastu syāt| 'svarūpaśabdaḥ svarūpanirūpakadharmaparaḥ, svabhāvaśabdastu saulabhyaparaḥ' iti kecit| yāva cchabdo hi prakarṣamanikarṣaparāmarśayogyākāraviṣayo yukta ityabhiprāyeṇāha guṇato vibhṛtito'pi yāvāścāha miti| guṇa śabdo'tra nirūpitasvarūpaviśeṣakajñānaśakyādisamastadharmaviṣayaḥ| yāvān yaśce tyanayovryutkrameṇa vyākhyānaṃ budvayārohakramapradarśanārtham| tattvata ityasya yāvān yaśce tyatrānapekṣaṇāt abhijānātī tyatra saṃśayādivyudāsāya tadapekṣaṇācca tattvato'bhijānātī ti yojitam| māṃ tattvato'bhijānātītyu ktasyaiva māṃ tattvatojñātve nubhāṣāṇamupāyabhūtasyāpi svādutamatayā sudurlabhatvenadarātiśayārtham| tattvato jñātve tyanenaiva ānantaryasidvayarthahetupauṣkalyajñāpakānuvādasya sidvatvāt, tadanantara mityanenaiva praveśasyānantaryakaṇṭhokteḥ, bhaktyā tvananyaye tyādau praveśe'pi hetutayā bhaktereva prāguktatvācca tato bhaktito māṃ viśate ityevānvayo darśitaḥ| praveṣṭumiti prāguktaikāthryajñāpanāya parasmaipadasidvaye ca praviśatī tyuktam| yathāvajjñānamapi kāṣṭhāprāptabhakteḥ| anyonyāśrayaṇaṃ ca bhakteḥ parvabhedāt parihmatam| saiva tu tathāvidhāvasthā sākṣāt mokṣasādhanamityāha tattvata ityādinā| darśana śabdenānubhāṣaṇāt tattvato'bhijānātī tyasya sākṣātkāraparatvaṃ vyañjitam| 'parabhaktyā'pi tattvajñānameva sādhyam; tadeva tu sākṣānmokṣasādhanam' iti kuddaṣṭimatamapākaroti atre ti| eva kāreṇa darśanavyavacchedaḥ| yadyapyatra bhaktiśabdo vyavahitaḥ, tattvajñānaṃ tvavyahitam -- tathā'pi vyavahitaparāmarśa eva yuktaḥ; anyathā tattvato jñātve tyādinā punaruktiprasaṅgāt| atra darśanajanakabhaktyanuvāde prayojanābhāvāt saiva taduttarāvasthā parāmṛśyata iti bhāvaḥ| prāguktaṃ hetumāha bhaktyā tvananyaye ti| ayamabhiprāyaḥ -- upakramanyāyat pūrvaṃ prabalam; spaṣṭāspaṣṭayośca spaṣyānusāreṇānyat gamayitavyamiti||55|| pūrvatra jñānaniṣṭoktā, anantara karmaniṣṭocyata iti śaṅkāvyudasāya pūrvatrāpi karmaniṣṭāyā -- mevāvāntaraviśeṣavipaktimanuvadan saṃgatimāha eva miti| vipāko'tra pūrvaślokadvayoktaparabhaktiparajñānaparamabhaktiparyantaḥ| vihitakarmaṇāṃ pūrvamuktatvāt sarvakarmāṇyapī ti niṣidvānuṣṭhānaṃ bhagavadananyatātastutyarthamupakṣipyata iti svairābhilaṣiśaṅkarādimatamapākaroti idānīṃ kāmyānāmapi karmaṇā miti| sarvaśabdo'tra śāstrīyeṣvevānuktasaṃgrahamārtha iti bhāvaḥ| tadeva vivṛṇoti na kevala mityādinā| pūrvaślokastha prāpyamevātrāpi saviśeṣaṇa pada śabdena nirdiṣṭamityabhiprāyeṇa nirvakti padyata iti||56|| uktaṃ paramapuruṣārthasādhanatvamanantaropāyānuśāsanaheturityāha yasmādeva miti| cetaśśabdasāphalyāya tadabhiprataṃ cetaso bhagavati karmasaṃnyāsakaraṇatvaṃ yena prakāreṇa, tamāha ātmano madīyatvamanniyābhyatvabudva yeti| atra cetaśśabdasyaivaṃ tātparyaṃ prācīnasaviśeṣaṇanirdeśena sthāpayati uktaṃ hī ti| adhyatmacetasā| paraśeṣatvādiviśeṣitayathātmagocarabuddhayetyarthaḥ| sarvaśabdena svarūpakātsnyavat anubandhikātsnyamapi prāguktaprakāreṇābhipretamityāha sakartṛkāṇi sārādhyānī ti| buddhiyogaśabdena mumukṣorasādhāraṇamakartṛtvānusaṃdhānādikaṃ sarvaṃ pratyabhijñāpyata pratyabhijñāpyata ityāha imameva buddhiyoga miti|| mañcittassarvadurgāṇī tyatrā mañcittaśabdena pūrvaślokoktasyaivānuvādāt tatrā ca buddhiviśeṣaviśiṣṭakarmavidhiparatvāt uttareṣvapi grantheṣu yuddhākhyasvadharmaprotsāhanasyaiva sphuṭatvādihāpi tadvivakṣāmāha evaṃ mañcittassarbakarmāṇi kurvanniti| mañcittatvamātrāsya vidheyatve anantaraṃ yuddhanivṛttyadhvasāyapratikṣepo na saṃgacchata iti bhāvaḥ| durgaśabdasya girivanajalādidurgeṣu prasiddhiprakarṣāt kṣatriyasya cārjunasyayuyutsostannistārāpekṣāsaṃbhavāt tadviṣayatvāśaṅkāmapyapākartuṃ pūrvāparānurodhena sāṃsārikāṇī ti viśeṣitam| matprasādādi tyanena vyutpattyanuśāsanaśrutismṛtyādiruddhāpūrvādikalpanāvyudāsaḥ, svasya phalapradāne pratibandhanivṛttyādimātrāsākāṅkṣatvaṃ ca sūcyata ityabhiprāyeṇāha matprasādādeve ti| evaṃ nityanaimittikakāmyarūpāṇāṃ karmaṇāṃ buddhiviśeṣeniyamādiyogena karmayogaśabditānāṃ paramparayā paripūrṇabhagavatprāptiparyantaṃ vipākamupapādya sarvathā karmayoga eva te kartavya iti nigamitam| atha tadakaraṇe pratyavāyamāha atha cedityardhena| hitavacanānādarasya nimittabhūtamahaṅkāraviśeṣamāha ahameva kṛtyākṛtyaviṣayaṃ sarvaṃ jānāmīti bhāvāditi| na śroṣyasīti śrūyamāṇe'pi śrutaphalanivṛttyabhiprāyam| vinaṅkṣyasītnenādikālamanuvṛttasyātmanāśasyottaraphe'pyanuvṛttirvivakṣitetyabhiprāyeṇāha -- vinaṣṭo bhaviṣyasīti| 'budvināśātpraṇaśyati' iti prāguktapratyabhijñānapanamiti bhāvaḥ| aśravaṇādinidānamāptāntarādisaṃbhavamapākurvan vinaṅkṣayasītyasya śāpavacanatulyatāvyāvṛttyarthe svasyaivāptatamatvakathanena svopadiṣṭasyārthasthitirūpātāyāmabhiprāyamāha na hi kaścidi ti| anye hi vaktāro mayā vācitāḥ parimitaviṣayaṃ kiṃcidvadanti; ahaṃ tu sarvasyādhikāriṇassarvavidhahitāhitavedī; yāni ca paroktāni śāstrāṇi, anuktāni ca cchandāṃsi, tānyapi madājñārūpatayaiva pramāṇabhūtānīti bhāvaḥ||58||
